4144.asset_description: A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.

4145.title: dive_4145
4145.asset_description: Two men in swimming shorts play with a ball in the shallow water of a sunny beach, sailing boats on the blue sea behind them. One man throws himself full length through the air to reach the ball and lands flat in the water with a big splash. Later he leaps up and kicks the ball over his own head with an overhead bicycle kick, both legs in the air. He lands in the water, then stands up in the shallows and raises both fists above his head in triumph while the other man bends over on the sand in the foreground.

4146.title: exhausted_4146
4146.asset_description: A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.

4147.title: hurry_4147
4147.transcript: Start the car, go, go, go!
4147.asset_description: At night in an empty car park in front of a fast-food restaurant, a man in a dark hoodie and cap runs towards a lit-up yellow arch sign. He grabs the sign, pulls it free and hurries back across the tarmac carrying the big yellow piece under his arm. He shoves it through the door of a waiting car, climbs in after it, and the last shot is his face inside the car, laughing, with the yellow sign filling half the frame.

4148.title: a_luxury_4148
4148.asset_description: In a concrete parking garage a man in a navy suit runs his hand slowly along the bonnet of a bright red sports car. He opens the door and lowers himself into the red leather seat, then reaches for the start button on the steering wheel and the dials light up. The car rolls out of the garage with its headlights on, and the last shot shows it standing alone in profile on an empty rooftop deck under a grey sky.

4149.title: a_giant_4149
4149.asset_description: An animated cartoon. A small fluffy beaver-like animal with big round eyes falls backwards through a nest of sticks, then tumbles through a grey sky far above the ground. It lands flat on its face on the scaly grey head of an enormous reptile that is floating in a misty lake in front of a pine forest. The little animal sits up, sees the reptile's huge yellow eye opening right under it, and screams with its mouth wide open before running away over the water.

4150.title: speed_4150
4150.asset_description: A dark green sports car speeds along a narrow country road, filmed from a camera held close to its side so the grass at the roadside blurs past. Close-ups show the rear wing with the badge on it, and a gold wheel with a yellow brake spinning fast just above the gravel. Another shot runs along the green bonnet towards the road ahead. At the end the car stands still on a sandy track by the dunes with the sea behind it, and a man in a brown t-shirt walks up to it.

4151.title: art_4151
4151.asset_description: A hand holds a bright pink marker over a pencil drawing of a sports car on white paper lying on a wooden table. The hand fills in the bonnet of the car with pink strokes, and the drawing slowly turns from grey lines into a solid pink car. A close-up shows the finished front of the car with its black air vents. At the end the finished picture of the pink car stands on a small wooden easel on the table, with a framed picture of a blue car hanging on the wall above it.

4152.title: a_vehicle_4152
4152.asset_description: A large black closed trailer stands on a gravel drive in front of green summer trees, filmed from behind. Its whole back wall begins to tip down slowly, turning into a ramp. As the ramp lowers, the dark inside of the trailer appears and a pale grey sports car is revealed standing inside it. The ramp comes all the way down to the gravel so the car could be driven straight out.

4153.title: a_highway_4153
4153.asset_description: Filmed from inside a car driving on a highway, the shot looks over the bonnet at a bright blue sports car with a big rear wing driving in the same lane ahead. The highway runs straight ahead with white lane markings and a metal crash barrier on the left, green fields and villages on both sides. In front of them stands a wall of grey rocky mountains with snow on the peaks and a long white band of cloud lying across the slopes.

4154.title: a_sport_4154
4154.asset_description: On an orange clay court at night, a woman in a black top, white skirt and blue cap serves a tennis ball. She throws the ball high above her head, swings the racket up and hits it, then runs forward into the court. Floodlights light the court, a green fence runs behind her and palm trees and a lit apartment block stand behind that, with two people watching from a balcony. She then waits with the racket in both hands and plays a forehand back.

4155.title: clean_4155
4155.asset_description: In a tiled bathroom, a cartoon-like ginger kitten in a pink t-shirt stands at a toilet holding a white plate smeared with red sauce. It dips the dirty plate into the toilet bowl, then reaches up with one paw and presses the flush button. Blue water swirls round the bowl and the kitten swishes the plate through it. At the end the kitten proudly puts a shining white plate on top of a tall stack of clean plates, with the dirty sauce-covered ones beside it.

4156.title: approach_4156
4156.transcript: Look at this robot. It does dance moves, all this stuff. Do something fun, buddy. He's falling. Grab him! Grab him!
4156.asset_description: In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.

4157.title: race_4157
4157.asset_description: On a wet tree-lined avenue covered with fallen brown leaves, hundreds of runners in numbered bibs race past the camera on both sides. In the middle of the road stands a small old woman in a beige coat and scarf, holding up a large piece of white cardboard with the handwritten words RUN IF YOU THINK I'M SEXY. She stands completely still, smiling, while the runners stream past her towards the start arch in the background.

4158.title: giant_4158
4158.asset_description: An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.

4159.title: high_4159
4159.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from someone hanging in a harness, with their bare legs and blue-soled trainers dangling in the bottom of the frame. They sweep fast over a steep green mountain meadow, the grass blurring underneath them, and then the ground drops away and they are flying high above a valley. Dark pine forest runs down both sides, a small road winds through the fields below, and the grey rocky peaks of the Dolomites stand against a deep blue sky.

4160.title: disappear_4160
4160.asset_description: A red sports car with a big black rear wing stands on a narrow strip of tarmac running through orange desert sand, with electricity pylons along the horizon. The car accelerates hard away from the camera and throws up an enormous cloud of orange sand behind it that fills the whole screen. As the sand thins out the car is only a small red dot far down the road, and in the last shot the sand and haze have swallowed it completely and the road is empty.

4161.title: the_front_4161
4161.asset_description: Two old sports cars stand nose to nose on a concrete driveway in front of a tall green hedge. The camera holds on the front of an orange car on the left, with its round chrome headlight and chrome mirror, and the front of a yellow car on the right, with its indicator and chrome bumper. The camera moves slowly so the two fronts almost touch in the middle of the frame. At the end a man in dark blue overalls and a cap leans over the front of the yellow car and works on it.

4162.title: a_plaza_4162
4162.asset_description: A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.

4163.title: talk_4163
4163.transcript: I have always loved mechanical things. The Lamborghini Miura was the first real supercar. You do not just drive it, you have to tame it. It makes you feel in charge.
4163.asset_description: A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.

4164.title: a_brake_4164
4164.asset_description: A green Lamborghini takes a corner on a race circuit, running over the red-and-white kerb. A close-up then fills the frame with one spinning black wheel: a big red brake caliper is clamped on the dark disc behind the spokes and the yellow wheel-nut turns in the middle. The car is seen from behind on the damp track with its wide rear wing, and the camera finally pans off into a blur of grass and tarmac.

4165.title: speed_4165
4165.transcript: The most important thing is the connection with the car. Every action gets an immediate response. This thing is pure fun, like entering a different dimension.
4165.asset_description: A young blond man, filmed from the passenger seat of a sports car, drives along a mountain road while he talks; through the side window beside him the trees and the verge rush past as a green blur. The shot cuts outside to a yellow supercar coming fast round a bend below a rock face and a wall of pine forest, then back to him at the wheel.

4166.title: enter_4166
4166.asset_description: Outside a stone villa with clipped hedges in the evening sun, a man in a black tank top walks up to a red Ferrari, opens the low door and lowers himself into the red leather seat. A close-up shows his hand on the switches beside the steering wheel and the lit instrument dials. He then sits behind the wheel, looking straight ahead through the windscreen.

4167.title: exit_4167
4167.asset_description: A point-of-view ride on a chestnut horse in an orange bridle along a wet black-sand beach under a grey sky. The horse walks straight towards a black cliff and into the mouth of a sea cave, and the frame goes almost completely black except for the outline of the horse's ears. A bright doorway of daylight appears ahead, and horse and rider come out again onto the open black beach with a green headland beyond.

4168.title: slow_4168
4168.asset_description: A split-screen cartoon of the old fable. In the top half a brown hare bounds over a grassy hill, then sits down, then lies flat on its back asleep. In the bottom half a tortoise plods forward step by step with a purple butterfly beside it and never stops. Behind them the sky turns from green daylight to an orange sunset and then to a starry night with a crescent moon, and the tortoise is still walking.

4169.title: a_look_4169
4169.asset_description: A man in an Alaska cap and a black hood films himself from a canoe on a wide green river with bushes along the bank. Two brown bears are swimming in the water behind him and one of them comes right up alongside the boat. He keeps his face to the camera and turns only his eyes for a long sideways look at the bear beside him, then relaxes into a grin as it swims past.

4170.title: save_4170
4170.asset_description: An animated hen leads four yellow chicks across a frozen lake, one chick carrying a white daisy. The ice splits into sharp plates and gives way; the hen and a chick drop into the blue water below and sink among the bubbles. The hen swims up and breaks the surface holding the soaked chick against her chest, lifts it out onto solid ice, and stands over all the chicks huddled together again.

4171.title: creep_4171
4171.asset_description: A grey wolf steps out of dense dark leaves onto a stony riverbank and comes slowly towards the camera with its head low. The shot cuts to a close-up of a brown hen, then to two yellow chicks beside a green bamboo tube on the gravel. Back on the wolf, it lies down with its muzzle flat on the wet stones, its amber eyes still following what is happening in front of it.

4172.title: an_escape_4172
4172.asset_description: A grass field burns at dusk in an animated film. A hen snatches up her nest of chicks and flies low over the fire, then lands in a river and pushes through the current with the nest held above the water. She wades out on the far bank, sets the chicks down and drops onto the stones, worn out, while the wildfire still glows on the hillside behind her.

4173.title: a_chase_4173
4173.asset_description: A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.

4174.title: defend_4174
4174.asset_description: A hen carries three yellow chicks in her wings out of a burning barn, beating her wings at the flames in the doorway. Later, under a full moon over a pine forest, the three chicks sit alone on the grass while mice and a red fox creep out of the dark towards them. The hen plants herself in front of the chicks and spreads both wings wide to block the way.

4175.title: sneak_4175
4175.asset_description: In deep snow at sunset a brown hen creeps low along a drift past a pile of sleeping wolves, one of them curled around a pale egg-shaped stone. She burrows into the snow until only her red comb shows above the surface, waits there, and then stands up covered in snow with a hard stare. The last shot has her out in the open on the pink snow, facing two wolves between bare black trees.

4176.title: glow_4176
4176.asset_description: Inside a dark burrow a yellow chick holds a glass jar with a single firefly glowing inside it, and the small flame of the insect lights up its face and its huge eyes. The chick carries the jar to the round mouth of the burrow and looks out at a whole forest filled with thousands of drifting sparks under a full moon. The hen comes and stands beside it in the glow.

4177.title: a_mouth_4177
4177.asset_description: A hen runs over a grassy hilltop at sunset carrying a small cloth sack, then climbs a sheer grey rock face with the sack in her beak. At a ledge she tips grain out of the sack into a nest where three grey hawk chicks stretch up with their mouths open wide to be fed. At night the adult hawk lands in front of her beside the sack, wings spread and eyes hard on her.

4178.title: generous_4178
4178.asset_description: A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. At the bottom of the hole a family of mice gathers round a big heap of corn lit by a candle.

4179.title: a_birthday_4179
4179.asset_description: A white-haired woman in a blue blouse sits at a table behind a large white cake with blue piping and three silver candles shaped as a 1, a 0 and a 0. Hands hang a colourful HAPPY BIRTHDAY banner on the black wall behind her and balloons show at the edges of the frame. Wearing a small tiara and a pair of pixel sunglasses, she blows the candles out one after another and then laughs at the camera.

4180.title: mistake_4180
4180.transcript: What are you doing? I'm walking the dog. That's an alligator. Your dog is right here. Oh, I forgot my glasses.
4180.asset_description: An elderly woman in a pink shirt walks a full-grown alligator on a red leash down a tiled colonnade in the sun. A young man carrying a small black puppy stops her and points out that the animal on the leash is an alligator and that her actual dog is right there in his arms. She looks down at it, says she forgot her glasses, and carries on walking.

4181.title: offer_4181
4181.asset_description: In an empty car park at sunset an old woman in a bright pink cardigan sits on a red mobility scooter. Someone in front of her holds out a round turquoise cake covered in rainbow sprinkles on a white board and presses silver 1, 0 and 0 candles into the icing. She drives the scooter after the cake, laughing, and reaches out both hands for the plate as it is held towards her.

4182.title: paint_4182
4182.transcript: It is Grandpa's 100th birthday. Time to surprise her with a huge gift.
4182.asset_description: A young man in a cap crouches on a big garden lawn and sprays purple paint onto the grass through a hose-fed spray gun, leaving coloured shapes behind him. He then leads an elderly white-haired woman, blindfolded with a red cloth, across the freshly painted grass. She takes the blindfold off, gasps with both hands at her face, then sits and lies back on the lawn laughing while a drone rises above her. The camera pulls up to reveal the whole lawn painted as a giant picture reading HAPPY 100 BIRTHDAY GRANPA with orange stars and blue gift boxes.

4183.title: gift_4183
4183.transcript: Time to surprise grandma with the best birthday gift ever. Surprise! Happy birthday, young lady. I love you.
4183.asset_description: A young man walks an elderly white-haired woman along a garden path towards a gift box taller than she is, wrapped in white paper with a wide red ribbon and a big red bow. He points at it and she pulls the front panel open like a door. A second young man steps out of the box holding a huge bunch of red heart-shaped balloons and spreads his arms. She raises her hands to her face, then hugs him tightly while the first man stands smiling beside them.

4184.title: bring_4184
4184.asset_description: A small curly apricot-coloured poodle puppy stands on a living-room carpet over a white dome-shaped ball machine with a yellow tennis ball sitting in its opening. The puppy takes the ball, the machine shoots it away down the room, and the puppy runs off after it. It comes back down the carpet with the ball in its mouth and drops it into the hole in the top of the machine, then waits for the next shot. The same round repeats.

4185.title: press_4185
4185.asset_description: On a yellow woven placemat in a kitchen sits a small grey crocheted mouse with white eyes, pink ears, pink feet and a long pink tail. A hand lowers a white ceramic mug onto the mouse's back and lets go. The mug's weight pushes the mouse's body flat so that only its head, feet and tail stick out from under it, and the mug stands there like it is resting on a coaster. Behind it a plate of waffles with raspberries stands on the table.

4186.title: return_4186
4186.asset_description: On a blue tennis court in bright sun, an apricot goldendoodle stands next to an orange and white egg-shaped ball machine placed on the service line. A tennis ball is hit over the net towards the dog. The dog runs off across the court after it while a person stands waiting at the far baseline. The dog comes back to the machine with the yellow ball in its mouth, drops it into the opening on top and stands beside the machine waiting for the next ball.

4187.title: dead_4187
4187.asset_description: Four parrots sit in a row on the back of a beige sofa in front of white curtains: a grey African grey, a white cockatoo with a yellow crest, a blue and gold macaw and a small green parrot. A hand holds a blue and white toy pistol up at them from below and 'shoots' one bird after another. Each parrot in turn flops sideways onto the sofa and lies there motionless with its feet in the air, playing dead, until the whole row has fallen over.

4188.title: slope_4188
4188.asset_description: A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.

4189.title: empty_4189
4189.asset_description: In a wooden-floored hallway a hand holds a black dog bowl full of brown dry food and pushes a small white pill down into the middle of it, then covers the spot with a dollop of white yoghurt. A black and white husky comes to the bowl and eats. When it lifts its head the bowl is put down on the floor: all the food and the yoghurt are gone and only the single white pill is left lying on the bare bottom of the bowl. The husky sits in the doorway and stares into the camera.

4190.title: meet_4190
4190.asset_description: A ginger and white cat sits on a low stone ledge outside a zoo enclosure, at the black iron bars. On the other side a huge male lion with a dark mane walks straight up to the bars and lowers its head until its face is right in front of the cat, the two noses almost touching through the bars. A lioness comes up behind and bares her teeth. The cat stays sitting where it is; the lions turn and walk away across the muddy enclosure, and the cat sits calmly at the bars with visitors watching in the distance.

4191.title: tower_4191
4191.asset_description: A young man in a black t-shirt jumps up and down with his arms spread wide on the concrete of a launch site at sunset. Behind him, filling the whole frame, stands an enormous stainless-steel rocket lying on its transporter, so big that he only reaches the height of its lower fins. The shot cuts to a low angle looking straight up the shining rocket into the pink evening sky, then to the rocket standing tall in silhouette between two palm trees with the sun behind it. Back at the transporter he jumps again with both fists in the air.

4192.title: fish_4192
4192.asset_description: A bald eagle glides low straight towards the camera over flat grey-green sea water, with a dark forested shore behind it. It holds its wings out wide and drops its yellow feet, watching the surface. As it reaches the camera it swings its talons forward, skims the water, and lifts away with a silver fish gripped in both feet, water spraying behind it.

4193.title: underground_4193
4193.asset_description: On the brick-paved forecourt of a large brick country house, a whole section of the paving tilts up on a hinge like a huge trapdoor. A dark green Porsche sports car reverses down the opening onto the platform below the paving. The brick lid lowers back over it until the forecourt looks solid again. The last shots are inside the space below the drive: the car parked in a concrete room lit by warm orange wall lights, with the brick ceiling above it.

4194.title: ride_4194
4194.asset_description: On a large mown lawn at golden hour, a grown woman in sunglasses, a white t-shirt and white trainers sits in a tiny pink toy jeep, far too small for her, with her legs folded up over the bonnet. She drives it slowly across the grass past a huge old oak tree, filmed from a vehicle following behind her. She steers around, waves an arm, and carries on away from the camera towards a weeping willow, a row of tall poplars and two wooden sheds in the evening light.

4195.title: break_4195
4195.asset_description: A first-person shot from the seat of a red mobility scooter driving down an empty asphalt road between warehouses, straight into a low sun. The rider's hands are on the handlebars and a basket sits on the steering column. The steering column starts to come loose and sinks down; the basket and the handlebars drop away. In the last shots the scooter has come apart completely: a wheel, the basket, the red body panels and the handlebar lie scattered on the road in front of the rider, whose feet are still on the footplate.

4196.title: bucket_4196
4196.asset_description: A cartoon: a round white character leans over a lit candle that stands in a small grey metal bucket on a bed of straw in a stone cellar. It blows the candle out and the room goes dark, leaving only the bucket and the smoking candle in the gloom. The scene cuts to a bedroom where the same character lies asleep in bed under a blue duvet with a red cap on. A digital clock shows 6:10, four phones lie on the duvet and light up with alarms, and a framed poster on the wall reads WAKE UP. CHASE GOALS. REPEAT. The character sleeps on with its mouth open, drooling.

4197.title: late_4197
4197.asset_description: A cartoon: a round white character with a red cap lies in bed under a blue duvet in a sunlit bedroom, an alarm clock on the bedside table. It picks up its phone, sees 7:01 on the red screen, frowns, puts the phone down and goes back to sleep with a happy smile. Time passes, the light in the room turns brighter. It picks the phone up again and the screen now reads 10:50. Its eyes go wide, it throws the blue duvet up into the air and shoots out of the room, leaving the bare mattress, the flying blanket and a puff of dust behind.

4198.title: deep_4198
4198.asset_description: A first-person shot on a narrow concrete pier over bright turquoise sea. The person walks up to a round shaft in the concrete and looks straight down into it: a dark green mossy hole going far down out of sight. They lower themselves in and drop down the shaft, the walls rushing past, the round opening of daylight shrinking above their black trainers. At the bottom the shaft opens under water and they come out over pale sand with orange coral patches on the seabed, still looking down at their own feet.

4199.title: drag_4199
4199.asset_description: A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.

4200.title: gold_4200
4200.asset_description: A fast drone shot at sunset. It sweeps over a dry clifftop past a single wide tree, where a woman in a white dress stands looking out to sea. It tips over the edge and dives towards a turquoise bay with a natural rock arch in the headland, then races low across the water past a lone swimmer. In the last shots the camera skims the sea surface straight towards the sun on the horizon, and the water and the cloudy sky are one sheet of deep warm yellow light.

4201.title: upright_4201
4201.asset_description: Two riders on blue dirt bikes ride side by side across a wide beach at sunset. The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.

4202.title: belly_4202
4202.asset_description: Two dachshunds lie flat on their backs on a sunny concrete patio with their bellies turned up to the sun and their legs flopped out. A hand comes into the shot holding a white kitchen turner and hovers it over the nearest dog's belly, as if about to flip it like something cooking. The dogs do not move; a third dachshund in a green collar walks up to the spatula at the end.

4203.title: rescue_4203
4203.asset_description: A shirtless man in neon green swim shorts stands over a shark stranded in the wet sand at the edge of a turquoise sea. He grips it by the tail, hauls it backwards through the shallow water until it is deep enough to swim, lets go, and steps back to watch it move off on its own into the waves.

4205.title: carry_4205
4205.asset_description: A golden hamster comes along a sunlit garden path with a white daisy held in its mouth. It stumbles and goes flat on its face on the paving, the daisy still with it, lies there a moment with its eyes shut, then pushes itself up, sits back on its haunches and holds the daisy against its chest, facing the camera in the low evening light.

4206.title: badge_4206
4206.asset_description: A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.

4207.title: deliver_4207
4207.asset_description: A hamster in a pink bow lounges on a small sofa in a dim living room, laughing and then scrolling on a phone. A second hamster in round glasses comes in carrying a pizza box and sets it down on the low table in front of the sofa. The two press their cheeks together, then sit side by side wrapped in a checked blanket, each holding a slice of pepperoni pizza and eating while the television flickers behind them.

4208.title: snack_4208
4208.asset_description: A hamster sits on a grey sofa in a dim room and works through one small meal after another straight to camera: a cheeseburger with a red paper cup of soda, a red pot of instant noodles eaten with chopsticks, a pink tub of yoghurt with a spoon, a corn dog covered in ketchup, then a slice of strawberry cream cake with a fork, ending with cream on its nose. Finally it lies flat on its back on the sofa with its belly up, crisps scattered all around it and an open bag of Lay's tipped over on the floor.

4209.title: sleep_4209
4209.asset_description: Two hamsters lie on a thick white fluffy blanket in a warm, dimly lit room strung with fairy lights. The one on the left wears round glasses and taps at a small silver laptop, still awake and working. The one on the right has a white sheet face mask over its face and a pink bow headband, and lies on its side with its eyes shut, not moving, deep in sleep while the other works on beside it.

4210.title: hold_4210
4210.asset_description: A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.

4211.title: cheek_4211
4211.asset_description: A hamster in a fluffy pink bow headband goes through a skincare routine at a white bathroom basin. It drinks through a straw from a pink tumbler, presses the pump of a yellow soap bottle, then washes and pats its face with both paws. It takes a cotton pad from a blue TONER PAD box, squeezes drops from a pink Facial Serum pipette over its head, and finishes by pressing both paws into its round cheeks, with two drops of serum still sitting on them.

4212.title: brown_4212
4212.transcript: Remember, top with white looks elegant. Wine with camel looks romantic. Mocha with ivory looks soft. Plum with grey looks striking. And sage with cream looks fresh.
4212.asset_description: A woman and a man stand side by side in a bright white panelled room in front of a cream sofa, posing to camera. Their matching shirt-and-trouser outfits change from one look to the next: both in deep chocolate brown, then cream with a light brown shirt, then tan brown, then dark brown again, and finally pale grey with a beige shirt. The woman changes her small handbag with every outfit so that it matches, and the two lean together and smile between changes.

4213.title: red_4213
4213.transcript: Remember, black with gold is expected, but black with deep green looks richer. Chocolate with lavender looks interesting, and red with emerald looks striking.
4213.asset_description: Two women pose together in a white panelled room in matching floor-length satin evening gowns with a high slit. The gowns and accessories change from look to look: black gowns with gold heels and small gold bags, then black gowns with bright green heels and a green bag, then chocolate satin gowns with lilac heels and lilac bags, and finally deep red gowns, one with a long cape sleeve, worn with emerald necklace and earrings and a green clutch.

4214.title: blue_4214
4214.transcript: Remember, light blue with white looks good, but light blue with brown is unbeatable. Chocolate with cream looks luxurious and forest green with camel looks next level.
4214.asset_description: A couple pose side by side in a white panelled room next to a potted olive tree, changing outfits between shots. They start in matching light blue: she in a light blue satin shirt tied at the waist with white trousers and a light blue bag, he in a light blue linen shirt with white trousers. Then she wears a blue draped top with brown flared trousers while he wears a brown polo with light blue trousers, then both are in chocolate brown and cream, and finally both wear dark green cable-knit jumpers, hers over a camel skirt with tall suede boots, his with camel chinos.

4215.title: orange_4215
4215.transcript: Remember, Carol with white looks fresh but Carol with dewy looks striking. Powder pink with grey looks chic and olive with rust looks rich.
4215.asset_description: A couple pose in a white panelled room, their outfits changing from shot to shot. First she wears an orange halter top with wide white trousers while he wears a white linen shirt with orange trousers. Then she is in an orange vest with navy wide trousers and he in a navy shirt with the same orange trousers. Next both are in pink, hers an off-shoulder puff-sleeved top with grey trousers, his a pink linen shirt with grey trousers. Finally she wears a rust top with a pleated olive skirt and he a sage shirt with rust trousers.

4216.title: white_4216
4216.transcript: Remember, if she is wearing red, he goes all black. Main character energy. If she wears white, olive and cream, old money. And if she wears black, tapen and chocolate, quiet luxury.
4216.asset_description: A couple pose together in a white panelled room in front of a cream sofa. In the first look she wears a deep red satin gown and he an all-black shirt and trousers. Then she wears a sleeveless white tiered cotton dress with white heels while he wears an olive shirt with cream trousers, and they turn to face each other. In the last look she wears a long fitted black dress with black heels and he a tan shirt with dark brown trousers, his arm around her waist.

4217.title: police_4217
4217.asset_description: A corgi drives a small green go-kart straight down the middle of a quiet suburban street of brick houses, its tongue hanging out and its paws up on the steering wheel. Behind it a white police car with POLICE across the bonnet chases it with its blue and red lights flashing, getting closer and closer until it fills the shot right behind the kart, while the corgi keeps driving without looking back.

4218.title: engine_4218
4218.asset_description: A corgi sits at the wheel of an old rust-orange tractor and drives it down a narrow road through green vineyards on a sunny day. The camera stays in front of the tractor, filling the frame with its big ribbed radiator grille, round headlamps and upright exhaust pipe. Halfway through, a thick cloud of black smoke bursts from the exhaust pipe as the motor is worked harder, and the tractor keeps rolling towards the camera past the vines and a stone farmhouse on the hill.

4219.title: beast_4219
4219.asset_description: Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.

4220.title: clean_4220
4220.asset_description: A man in a black t-shirt stands beside a white sports car parked on a road through dry golden hills at sunset. He lifts the front lid and leans in, then works over the bodywork with a grey microfibre cloth, wiping the paint in long strokes in close-up until it is spotless. Close shots follow of the wing mirror and of the rear spoiler rising, and then the car pulls away and drives off down the empty road into the low sun.

4221.title: couch_4221
4221.asset_description: A small green cartoon lizard carries a white bowl of colourful star-shaped cereal across a dark living room to a big grey couch, licking its lips. It climbs up the side of the couch with the bowl, gets the bowl onto the cushion, then pulls itself up and settles into the corner of the couch. It tucks a plaid blanket around itself, picks up the remote control, and sits back against the cushions eating from the bowl with the light of the television flickering on its face.

4222.title: wave_4222
4222.asset_description: A small green cartoon gecko stands in a bright circle of light, seen as if through a peephole. It raises one hand and waves at the camera, then breaks into a dance, spinning and throwing its arms out. It settles, folds its arms across its chest and grins with its eyes shut, then leans right up to the lens until its face fills the frame.

4223.title: spicy_4223
4223.asset_description: A green cartoon gecko leans over a white bowl heaped with small red chilli peppers and starts eating them. Its eyes bulge, its skin turns from green to orange to bright red, and a jet of flame shoots out of its open mouth over the bowl. It dives into a tall glass of water and sits curled up inside, still glowing red. Finally it slumps out of the bowl onto the table, back to green, dripping wet with its tongue hanging out.

4224.title: toilet_4224
4224.asset_description: In a warm, softly lit hallway with a rug and a potted plant, an enormously fat green cartoon lizard waddles up to a doorway and has to squeeze its round belly through the frame. The door swings shut, and a small dark sign on it reads WC. The hallway sits quiet for a few seconds. Then the door opens again and the same lizard comes out completely slim, throwing both arms in the air with a delighted open-mouthed grin.

4225.title: dish_4225
4225.asset_description: A golden hamster sits on a white kitchen counter beside the sink, eating a green scouring pad out of a small round white dish. A white box like a phone box is set down next to the dish and a second hamster peeks in from the right. The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.

4226.title: hunt_4226
4226.asset_description: A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.

4227.title: friendly_4227
4227.transcript: Goso. How are you, buddy? You know his name. That's Goso. Have a good day, guys. Nice meeting you. Let's go, boys.
4227.asset_description: A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.

4228.title: shore_4228
4228.asset_description: A man in a khaki shirt climbs into a dark blue helicopter on a sunny airfield. The camera flies low over pine forest and steep green mountains towards a bright turquoise lake. He stands on the grassy shore with his arms spread wide facing the water and the grey rock walls behind it. He then cracks two eggs onto a flat black pan on a small camping stove set on the rocks by the lake, and finally sits at a low wooden table eating the cooked eggs with sliced bread and tomatoes.

4229.title: free_4229
4229.asset_description: A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.

4230.title: seat_4230
4230.transcript: Evening. Where y'all coming from? Oh, you know, we were just out there hunting squirrels. Why does your friend look like that? Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing. Code 3.
4230.asset_description: At night, a torch shines into the open window of a dark red pickup truck. A golden retriever in a camouflage jacket and cap sits upright in the driver's seat with a paw on the steering wheel, staring back at the camera. In the seat beside it a dachshund in an orange hat sits stiffly. Nobody moves for a long moment. Then the shot cuts to the truck's red tail lights speeding away down an unlit country road.

4231.title: window_4231
4231.transcript: You know why I pulled you over? I don't know. But something's wrong with the stop sign. It won't turn green. Step out of the vehicle. Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing.
4231.asset_description: At night the camera looks at the closed side window of a dark red pickup truck. The glass is completely fogged up, with only vague golden shapes moving behind it. The window clears and shows two golden retrievers in the cab, both wearing baseball caps, one with a paw up on the door, as pale smoke drifts out around them. They sit there staring out. Then the truck pulls away and speeds off down a dark road.

4232.title: show_4232
4232.transcript: Hey buddy, do you like Mesa? Do you like Ronaldo? Can you show us Ronaldo's overhead kick?
4232.asset_description: At a marine park with palm trees and empty rows of stadium seating, a shirtless man crouches at the edge of a big turquoise pool holding a large silver ball and talks to a bottlenose dolphin resting at the wall. The dolphin lifts its head and listens, then backs off into open water, launches itself high into the air upside down and strikes the ball away with its tail. The man leaps up with both hands on his head, mouth wide open, watching the ball fly off into the blue sky.

4233.title: stone_4233
4233.asset_description: A drone films a tall bridge built of stone blocks, its arches and piers rising out of a green jungle gorge, with an enormous waterfall pouring down the cliff directly behind it. A freight train with a blue locomotive and dark red wagons rolls slowly across the top of the stonework. The camera pulls back to show the full height of the falls, the water breaking into white threads over the rock while the train crosses in front of them.

4234.title: closet_4234
4234.asset_description: In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.

4235.title: cast_4235
4235.asset_description: A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.

4236.title: attract_4236
4236.asset_description: Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. Both men turn their heads to follow her, still holding the heavy screen between them, and one nearly loses his grip. They set the television down and stand with their hands on their hips, watching her walk away.

4237.title: barn_4237
4237.transcript: Give it to Verspy. Good job, buddy.
4237.asset_description: Inside a long barn with grey metal stalls down both sides of a concrete aisle, a toddler in jeans and a cream jumper toddles up to a wooden crate full of carrots and pulls one out. He carries it down the aisle, holding it up in the air, to where a black horse has its head out over a stall door. The horse stretches down and takes the carrot from his hand, and the little boy claps his hands and laughs.

4238.title: roast_4238
4238.asset_description: Two hands rinse a raw rack of lamb ribs in a fast mountain stream, with green hills and grazing horses behind. The rack is then laid on a flat stone slab set over glowing red coals and slowly browns, steaming, with the sun low over the hills. A man inflates a big white tent on the grass with an orange pump. Inside the tent, on a patterned carpet, two men sit at a low wooden table and eat the roasted ribs, which are served on a bed of lettuce with cherry tomatoes.

4239.title: port_4239
4239.transcript: Ready, my friend? It's my first time. Okay, easy, easy. No more tricks. Take me to the tower.
4239.asset_description: A first-person shot shows two gloved hands holding leather reins that run to a seagull flying just ahead, harnessed like a horse. The gull carries the camera over a huge suspension bridge half lost in fog, then drops down and races along a narrow strip of green water between two big red cargo ships tied up at a dock. It skims through the spray, and finally levels out over the harbour towards a white lighthouse with a city skyline behind it.

4240.title: identical_4240
4240.asset_description: In a carpeted living room next to a white curtain, one husky rolls on its back with its paws in the air while a second husky stands over it, nosing at it. The two of them then stand side by side facing each other, almost identical black and white dogs with the same markings and the same pale blue eyes. One lifts a paw and paws at the other's chest. The camera closes in on one of them looking straight into the lens.

4241.title: pilot_4241
4241.asset_description: A young man in a white pilot's shirt with gold striped shoulder boards and a green headset with a boom microphone sits in the cockpit and looks into the camera. The view swings forward through the windscreen: deep blue sky above a flat white deck of cloud stretching to the horizon. The aircraft sinks into the cloud until everything outside is featureless grey, then breaks out low over flat ground. Finally the nose lines up with a grey runway and the centre line and markings rush past underneath.

4242.title: pass_4242
4242.asset_description: A ginger-and-white cat and a tabby cat sit side by side on a dark polished tiled hallway floor, looking up at the camera. A tall white metal safety gate blocks the doorway behind them. The ginger cat walks up to the gate and slips between its bars into the dark room beyond. The tabby then crosses to a small square cat flap set low in the white wall next to the gate, pushes its head through and squeezes its whole body out, until only its striped tail is left in the hallway.

4243.title: pay_4243
4243.asset_description: A black cat in a red apron works behind a street hot dog stand while a husky stands at the grill behind it turning sausages with tongs. A customer's hand holds a turquoise bank card out to the card reader on the counter. The cat lays a sausage into a long bun, then squeezes a zigzag of ketchup along it from a red bottle, and finally lifts the finished hot dog up to the camera.

4244.title: charge_4244
4244.asset_description: Filmed from inside a car at sunset. On a gravel track beside a wooden fence a big brown longhorn bull walks along with a small white dog next to it, kicking up dust. The bull turns on the dog and they tumble together in a cloud of dust. Cut to two young men in the car, mouths wide open screaming and laughing. The bull then runs straight down the track towards the car, horns forward, and pushes its huge shaggy head right up against the open car window until its nose and horns fill the whole frame.

4245.title: slide_4245
4245.asset_description: A long concrete aqueduct wall runs through a jungle of tall palm trees, with water spilling over its edge as a wide waterfall. Young men lie on their backs in the shallow water on top of the concrete channel and slide along it with their arms flung out, throwing up spray. They then stand under the falling water at the foot of the wall, the white torrent pouring over their heads and shoulders. A drone shot pulls back to show the whole mossy wall, the sheet of falling water and one man still sliding along the top, surrounded by green jungle.

4246.title: blue_4246
4246.transcript: Sometimes you just gotta add them to your video. Ready? See? They just, you know.
4246.asset_description: Inside a wooden aviary with wire mesh walls in a green wood, a young woman in a green T-shirt and a baseball cap holds a large peacock in her arms and laughs. The bird's deep blue neck and chest fill most of the frame, its crest standing up on its head and its scaly clawed feet dangling against her arm. It leans its head in towards her face, and at the end stretches its long blue neck straight towards the camera until the shining blue feathers fill the shot.

4247.title: well_4247
4247.asset_description: A drone looks down on a huge flat field of bright green rice. In the middle of it sits a round stone well full of dark water, with a narrow footpath leading to it through the crop. A line of boys in red shorts stands along the well's stone rim; one after another they jump in, each landing with a white burst of spray. The last shot is straight down from above: five of them float on their backs in the round pool of water in a star shape, the green field all around.

4248.title: indoor_4248
4248.asset_description: A huge artificial wave pool inside a hall, with a steel roof, rows of ceiling lights and windows along the upper wall. A big turquoise wave rolls across the pool and a person on an orange board rides down its face before the white foam swallows them. The wave collapses into churning white water that fills the frame, and the person is left swimming through the foam. Staff in red stand watching on the concrete deck above.

4249.title: back_4249
4249.asset_description: A first-person view from the back of a flying red dragon. Two hands grip a saddle horn in the bottom of the frame and the dragon's broad red back, covered in rows of dark spikes running down the spine, stretches away in front. The dragon glides over green valleys, blue lakes and waterfalls, then tips forward and dives towards a canyon where two waterfalls fall into a river. It raises its head and blows a burst of fire up into the sky with its wings spread wide, and finally levels off and glides towards a golden sunset over a wide lake.

4250.title: warehouse_4250
4250.transcript: Okay, now back up slowly. Tranquilo, despacio. I don't know what you're saying. Speak English. Dios mio! I'm clocking out.
4250.asset_description: A tall storage warehouse with long aisles and racking stacked to the roof with wrapped pallets. In the foreground a chihuahua wearing a yellow hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest stands on its hind legs looking off to the side. Behind it a golden retriever drives an orange forklift carrying pallets of bottled water, while another small dog in a hi-vis vest walks down the aisle. The forklift catches the stack and the pallets of water burst apart, spilling packs of bottles all over the concrete floor. The chihuahua turns to the camera with wide eyes.

4251.title: space_4251
4251.transcript: This is your side, and this is my side, okay? Okay. Where am I supposed to put my clothes? Here, put them here.
4251.asset_description: An animated walk-in wardrobe. A hand points along a completely bare wooden shelf and an empty hanging rail on one side of the room, then sweeps across to the other side. The camera pulls back to show the whole wardrobe crammed with pink and purple clothes on the rails and folded in stacks on every shelf, with a deep heap of clothes covering the floor. A muscular cartoon man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers stands in the middle of the heap staring at it, and the shot closes in on his shocked face.

4252.title: concrete_4252
4252.asset_description: A back garden with a large above-ground pool standing on a wide concrete patio, its slabs marked out by straight joint lines. A young man in sunglasses lies on a patterned Persian rug spread on the concrete, propped on one elbow under a small black umbrella, sipping an orange drink through a straw. Behind him another man in a white T-shirt scrubs the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush, pushing white soapy foam across the slabs. More rugs lie drying on the concrete and the whole patio is covered in suds and water.

4253.title: wash_4253
4253.asset_description: A motocross rider sits on a green dirt bike in a wet paddock, caked from helmet to boots in thick brown mud, so that the goggles and the whole suit are one solid brown crust. Two mechanics in team shirts and caps work on him with a pressure hose: one wipes the mud off the helmet with a cloth while the other kneels and blasts water over the rider's legs and the bike. Brown water runs off in sheets and the green bodywork of the bike appears clean again under the mud.

4254.title: counter_4254
4254.transcript: One iced latte with oat milk. Ma'am, we only do fried chicken. No, sweetie. I said oat milk. The customer is always-- Fried pigeon, limited time.
4254.asset_description: An animated fried chicken shop at dusk. A grumpy ginger cat in a white chef's hat and a stained white apron stands behind the metal counter, with lit menu boards of fried chicken above and a deep fryer full of bubbling oil set into the counter in front of it. A pigeon stands on the counter arguing with the cat, which scowls back with narrowed green eyes. The pigeon then flaps wildly, tips over the edge and drops into the bubbling fryer. A single feather floats down and the cat stares at it open-mouthed.

4256.title: scratch_4256
4256.asset_description: A grey kangaroo stands upright on a green hillside pasture under a grey sky, with gum trees and a fence in the distance. A person's hand reaches in from the side and scratches the kangaroo's chest and neck with the fingers. The kangaroo half closes its eyes and leans into the hand, then slowly sinks down and lies flat out on the grass, stretching its long back legs and heavy tail behind it while the hand keeps scratching its head and neck.

4257.title: tight_4257
4257.asset_description: An animated pond scene. A baby panda and a small green turtle swim underwater below a big lily pad, blowing streams of bubbles, while a grumpy fish watches from behind. They shoot up out of the water and fly through the air above a sunlit bamboo forest with their arms and legs flung out and shocked faces. Then the panda sits on a huge floating lily pad with the turtle clamped in a tight hug against its chest, arms wrapped right around the shell; the grumpy fish pokes its head out of the water below. The last shot shows the panda squeezing the turtle close among pink water lilies.

4258.title: steel_4258
4258.asset_description: A long curved steel slide runs down a green mountain meadow, its polished grey chute filling the bottom half of the frame, with dark pine forest and hills behind. A spotted fawn lies curled up in the steel chute at the top of the slide. It sits up and looks straight down the slide at the camera with its ears out, settles back down into the chute, then gets to its feet and walks off into the tall grass beside the slide.

4259.title: face_4259
4259.asset_description: A stop-motion woolly sheep with a curly white fleece, a fluffy tuft on its head and an orange knitted scarf stands against a bright blue sky dotted with white clouds. It starts with a flat, bored face and heavy eyelids, then opens its mouth wide in a shout that shows its square teeth. Its face settles into a hard frown, the eyebrows pulled down over the eyes, and the camera pushes in until only the scowling face fills the screen.

4260.title: figure_4260
4260.asset_description: A dark bedroom at night, lit only by a small bedside lamp and the glow of a tablet. A man lies in bed under a thick cream knitted blanket watching the tablet, its light on his face, with a golden retriever lying on the bed beside him. In the lit doorway behind them a dark human figure appears and stands still, only its outline visible against the blue light of the hall. The man falls asleep with his head back and the tablet resting on his chest while the figure keeps standing there, then he is awake and watching the tablet again with the dog still beside him.

4261.title: sunny_4261
4261.asset_description: A rectangular garden pool with a blue rim and clear turquoise water stands on a lawn in bright sunshine, with a row of small conifers and a dark fence behind it. Two Jack Russell terriers swim in the pool pushing a big red ball with their noses. One paddles across the pool nudging the ball ahead of it towards the camera, water sparkling in the sun, while the second dog swims behind. At the end the red ball rests against the sunlit edge of the pool in close-up with the second terrier still paddling towards it.

4262.title: wildlife_4262
4262.asset_description: A mother brown bear and two cubs walk along a wide grey sand flat at low tide, below a steep mountainside streaked with snow, with pale glacial water behind them. A black raven stands on the sand nearby, spreads its wings and hops aside as the cubs trot past. The family walks on along the shoreline and away from the camera.

4263.title: admire_4263
4263.asset_description: Two small fluffy cartoon birds, one green and one blue, sit side by side on the shiny floor of a bright shop, eyes shut and bored. A tall pink bird with an enormous swept-up quiff struts past above them. Their eyes fly open and they follow her with a wide, dazzled stare, then turn to each other with a knowing, impressed look.

4264.title: volleyball_4264
4264.asset_description: A point-of-view shot down a quiet suburban street lined with parked cars and clipped hedges under a blue sky full of white clouds. The camera holder's ringed hands push a yellow and blue volleyball up out of frame; a person in white clothes standing further down the road sets it back, and the ball drops into the waiting hands again.

4265.title: calm_4265
4265.asset_description: A green cartoon parrot with a blazing red crest storms into a wood-panelled living room, wings spread and beak open in fury. A large blue parrot gets off the sofa and folds a wing around it. The red crest sinks and drains from fire-red to pale yellow to soft green, and the angry bird stops shouting, leans into the hug and closes its eyes.

4266.title: energetic_4266
4266.asset_description: A shaggy grey dog tears across a wide, wet dark-sand beach below green cliffs on an overcast day. It wheels round, sprints up the grassy dune straight at the camera until its fur fills the screen, then throws itself down in the long grass and rolls on its back with all four legs in the air, a collar round its neck.

4267.title: neat_4267
4267.asset_description: A small white Pomeranian stands on a dark grooming table in front of a window looking onto a sunny green garden. A groomer works round it with scissors, snipping the straggly hair on its back and legs; little tufts of white fur drop onto the table. The dog pants happily, screws its eyes shut while its face is cupped and shaped, and ends up with a perfectly round, smooth, even coat.

4268.title: fan_4268
4268.asset_description: In a pale living room a big brown dog sits bolt upright on the sofa like a person, front paws resting on a small black and white football, head turned to a wall-mounted television showing a live football match. A man in checked pyjama trousers lies stretched out on the sofa behind it, half watching. A low table in front holds white roses in a vase and two mugs.

4269.title: dry_4269
4269.asset_description: A woman in a bright patterned tunic and blue headscarf stands over a raised bed of bone-dry earth in a courtyard full of terracotta pots. The soil is pale and split into a web of deep cracks. Wearing gardening gloves she tips water from a clay jug and then from a brass watering can; the water vanishes straight into the cracks, spreading dark wet patches until the whole bed is soaked and brown.

4270.title: slow_4270
4270.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from inside a go-kart: a driver in a bright striped racing suit grips the small steering wheel and speeds along a sunlit tarmac circuit with red and white kerbs, tyre barriers and eucalyptus trees, another kart running ahead. Then a duck waddles out onto the track in front, and the kart drops from full speed to a crawl and creeps along behind the bird until it has crossed.

4271.title: athlete_4271
4271.asset_description: A sprinter in a yellow and green vest drives out of the starting blocks on the red track of a packed Olympic stadium, body low and arms pumping. He straightens up, lengthens his stride and runs at full speed down his lane while the camera tracks alongside him, the crowd and the white stadium roof behind.

4272.title: gold_4272
4272.asset_description: A woman in a plain white shirt and black trousers stands in a clothes shop between rails of colourful dresses. One by one she puts on shining gold pieces: big gold hoop earrings, then fine gold chains at her neck, then a thick stack of gold bangles on her wrist, then a red belt with a heavy gold buckle. She finishes the look with a wide straw hat, sunglasses and two bags and presents herself to the camera.

4273.title: collision_4273
4273.asset_description: An illustrated street scene at dusk. A dark blue saloon has run head-on into the side of a beige hatchback in the middle of a crossroads; the blue car's bonnet is folded up and smoking and one hubcap has rolled away across the road among scattered broken glass. A man in a brown jacket throws both arms up in shock while a man in a green coat runs to the hatchback's driver door. Bystanders watch from the pavement in front of lit shopfronts.

4274.title: damage_4274
4274.asset_description: In a sunny supermarket car park a white delivery van has run into the back corner of a grey car. The car's rear wing is caved in and the tail light is smashed against the van's bumper. Both drivers, in matching blue work shirts, get out and clutch their heads in dismay, then lean over the car's boot photographing the crushed panel with their phones and filling in a form.

4275.title: complain_4275
4275.asset_description: A shopping centre car park in bright sun. A white car has hit the rear side of a grey saloon, tearing a long crease through the wing and cracking the tail light, with black debris on the tarmac. An older woman in a light blue shirt grabs her head, shouts, and then keeps pointing and talking at the damage and at the young man beside her, while he crouches to photograph the torn panel with his phone and writes on a form propped on the other car's boot.

4276.title: elderly_4276
4276.asset_description: A very old woman with white hair, in a lilac coat and scarf, walks slowly up a narrow cobbled street of tiled houses with a wooden walking stick. A young man in an apron and a nurse in blue scrubs walk on either side of her, each holding an arm, and several neighbours follow behind. At the top they help her up the stone steps to a blue tiled doorway, and she turns round at the door, smiling, with the little group gathered round her.

4277.title: accountant_4277
4277.asset_description: A woman in a white shirt and grey cardigan sits at a desk buried under thick stacks of receipts and invoices, lit by a desk lamp at night. She frowns over a long till receipt held up in one hand, runs a red pen down a ruled ledger full of columns of figures, circles one number in red, taps the big black calculator, and finally throws both fists in the air in triumph.

4279.title: theatre_4279
4279.asset_description: An art-deco poster of a theatre interior. A man in a gold and black geometric suit stands alone in a bright spotlight on the stage, one hand pressed to his heart and the other flung out, head thrown back as he declaims. Heavy crimson and gold curtains are swagged back on either side of the stage, and rows of empty seats stretch away into the dark behind him.

4280.title: filming_4280
4280.asset_description: A retro poster-style illustration of a film set. A woman with wavy auburn hair, in a long golden off-the-shoulder gown, stands in front of a flat coloured backdrop with tears running down her cheek, one hand at her face and the other lifting her skirt. A big studio lamp on a tall stand shines on her from the left, a boom microphone hangs in from the right, and an empty wooden director's chair stands beside her.

4281.title: change_4281
4281.asset_description: A guide in a khaki shirt stands in dense green rainforest holding a leafy twig with a bright green chameleon on it, grinning into the camera. He slides a piece of rough brown bark under the animal; it steps across onto the wood and its skin turns from green to a striped orange-brown that matches the bark exactly. He stares at it wide-eyed and delighted.

4282.title: shelter_4282
4282.transcript: It's him. He's all yours. Let's go home.
4282.asset_description: A couple crouches at a wire kennel door inside an animal rescue centre and greets a tan dog through the mesh; a staff member in a green polo shirt opens the kennel and the couple hug the dog; at the front desk the same woman stamps their adoption paperwork; the couple then walk the dog out on a red leash down the bright corridor and out through the exit.

4283.title: cooking_4283
4283.asset_description: An outdoor evening cooking class under strings of fairy lights: a chef in whites tosses food in a wok over a tall gas flame while the class, all in aprons, lean over the counter watching with their hands under their chins; she sets a finished plate of stir-fry down in front of them and the whole class claps and cheers.

4284.title: rush_4284
4284.asset_description: A pencil sketch of a man dashing out of the front door of a flat: a slice of toast clamped in his teeth, a travel coffee cup and a briefcase in one hand, his jacket half pulled on over an untied tie, his free arm thrown out after a set of keys flying through the air, both shoelaces trailing loose behind him, with coats on hooks and shoes scattered by the door.

4285.title: adult_4285
4285.asset_description: A grown man knots his tie in front of a mirror in a flat, drinks coffee standing up, sits at the kitchen table signing his way through a thick stack of bills and documents, shoulders a work bag and leaves through the front door, then walks to work in a stream of office commuters crossing a city street.

4286.title: fan_4286
4286.asset_description: A cartoon of a woman slumped back in a striped deckchair on a lawn under a blazing sun, sweat running down her face, waving a folding paper fan at herself; a tall glass of iced lemonade stands on a wooden side table beside her, the flowers behind her droop, and a ginger cat lies flat out asleep in the shade.

4287.title: view_4287
4287.asset_description: An estate agent in a green blazer with a lanyard and a folder opens the door of an empty flat and waves a young couple in; she pulls the sheer white curtains aside and opens the balcony door onto a city skyline, and the three of them stand looking out; in the hallway she hands the couple a set of keys and they laugh with delight.

4288.title: target_4288
4288.asset_description: A young archer stands on an open grass steppe drawing a recurve bow back to her cheek with one eye squeezed shut in concentration; the shot cuts down the range to three round black-and-white bullseye targets standing in the grass with green hills behind them, then back to her holding her aim while teammates in tracksuits watch from behind.

4289.title: cold_4289
4289.asset_description: A cartoon of an oversized wall air conditioner blasting a wide white stream of freezing air down into a bedroom; a young woman in a T-shirt and shorts is blown back onto her heels with her hair standing straight up and her mouth open in shock, sheets of paper fly off the desk and the curtain whips sideways, while warm sunlight glows outside the window.

4290.title: cool_4290
4290.asset_description: A heavy-set man in a sweat-soaked blue shirt lies slumped on a sofa fanning himself with a magazine and complaining about the heat; he points a remote at the wall air conditioner above him, the shot cuts to the unit switching on, and he stands up under it with his arms spread and his eyes closed as the cold air brings his temperature down.

4291.title: forehead_4291
4291.asset_description: A bald man in a blue shirt with dark sweat patches lies back on the sofa of a bright living room and rolls a cold glass across his forehead, groaning; he looks up at the wall air conditioner, raises the remote and switches it on, then stands with his arms flung wide under the vent with his face tipped up, while the family cat watches from a shelf.

4292.title: breeze_4292
4292.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a young woman standing in a sunlit meadow with her eyes closed and her face tipped up; huge dandelion clocks in the foreground are shedding clouds of white seed parachutes that drift sideways across the picture on the moving air, her hair is lifted to one side, and golden sunbeams slant down through the grass and wildflowers.

4293.title: jet_4293
4293.asset_description: A watercolour of a twin-engine passenger jet climbing steeply away just after take-off with its landing gear still down, filling the sky above an airport; below it runs a long runway with centre-line markings, an orange windsock on a pole, a lit runway edge light, and in the distance the control tower and terminal with parked aircraft, all under peach-coloured evening clouds with a flock of small birds.

4294.title: low_4294
4294.asset_description: A plane spotter in a keffiyeh with a DSLR on a strap stands at an airport perimeter fence looking up and grinning; a twin-engine airliner crosses just above the fence behind him, and then a far bigger four-engine jumbo passes directly over his head with its landing gear down, so close that its belly and wheels fill the whole frame while he ducks and laughs.

4295.title: photograph_4295
4295.asset_description: In the desert beside an airport, a man in a grey thobe and keffiyeh with a camera round his neck points up at an airliner coming in over the sand and the perimeter fence; he lifts the camera to his eye and shoots as the green-and-white jet passes low overhead with its gear down, then turns back to the lens grinning as the plane rolls out on the runway behind him.

4296.title: signal_4296
4296.asset_description: An illustrated view down from an airport control tower at sunset: ground marshals in orange vests stand on the apron with both arms raised holding marshalling wands to guide the aircraft in, a tug tows a train of baggage carts past a dropped suitcase, fuel tankers cross the taxiway, airliners sit at their jet bridges, and beyond the grass another plane lifts off the runway under a windsock.

4297.title: departure_4297
4297.asset_description: A young traveller with a grey neck pillow and a rolling suitcase turns to the camera in a small airport lounge with a propeller plane parked outside; she then rides an escalator down through a huge terminal beneath an enormous departures board covered in flight listings, past rows of luggage trolleys and crowds, and past an indoor waterfall with airliners lined up at the windows behind it, her mouth open in amazement.

4298.title: straight_4298
4298.asset_description: In a school gym a boy in white PE kit shuffles his trainers forward until his toes touch a coloured line painted on the parquet floor; the camera then pans along a whole class of boys standing shoulder to shoulder with every pair of shoes exactly on the same line, forming one perfectly straight row, while a teacher in a red tracksuit with a whistle walks down the line checking it.

4299.title: react_4299
4299.asset_description: A curly-haired young man sits in a living room with a big fluffy ginger cat on his lap; as he strokes it his eyes go red and streaming and he sneezes into a paper tissue; a woman in denim lifts the cat off him and carries it across the room, and he keeps sneezing and wiping his nose while she holds the cat at a distance.

4300.title: rubbish_4300
4300.asset_description: An inked comic-book panel of a narrow night-time alley between two brick tenements: metal dustbins in the foreground are heaped over the rim with crumpled paper and waste, a hooded figure runs down the wet cobbles clutching a satchel, a ginger cat leaps off a dumpster lid, steam pours from a grate in the ground, and fire escapes and washing lines criss-cross the dark blue sky above.

4301.title: gap_4301
4301.asset_description: A young traveller with a backpack and a camera walks away down a whitewashed blue lane in a Moroccan medina hung with drying laundry, then turns into an extremely tight slot between two blue-painted walls; he edges through the narrow space almost sideways with a wall at his chest and his back, looking up at the sliver of sky above him, and squeezes out of the far end laughing.

4302.title: emergency_4302
4302.asset_description: A neon-lit city street at night in heavy rain. An ambulance with red and blue roof lights stands in a flooded road, its rear doors thrown wide open and the bright interior visible. Two paramedics in reflective coats push a wheeled stretcher up to the open back of the vehicle. Bystanders in hooded coats watch from the pavement while traffic light streaks reflect in the wet asphalt.

4303.title: medical_4303
4303.asset_description: A sunny narrow street of old apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A white emergency vehicle marked with orange stripes and blue star-of-life symbols is parked at the kerb with its blue lights flashing. The camera moves in on the bonnet and windscreen, then two crew members in yellow high-visibility jackets walk across the road carrying a red bag toward a cafe terrace where people sit at tables.

4304.title: football_4304
4304.asset_description: Golden evening light on a suburban street. A bearded man in a cream-and-brown varsity jacket and a grey cap has just released an oval brown ball, which hangs in the air at the top right of the frame. Behind him a white clapboard house flies a striped flag from its porch, a chrome-sided diner stands across the road and an old muscle car is parked at the kerb.

4305.title: boy_4305
4305.asset_description: A backyard party at sunset. A man in a denim shirt and backwards cap flips burgers on a smoking barbecue. He then turns and holds out a plate with a huge stacked burger to a small boy in a striped t-shirt, who throws his fists up and shouts with delight. The man plays catch on the lawn with a leather glove, and finally sits on the tailgate of a red pickup while the guests behind him cheer with raised cups.

4306.title: prison_4306
4306.asset_description: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.

4307.title: banner_4307
4307.asset_description: A hand-drawn night scene in a packed stadium stand. Four long strips of cloth in brown, blue, dark red and gold stream sideways from tall poles above the terrace against a starry blue sky. Below them rows of people in winter coats, scarves and flat caps stand with their hands on their chests, mouths open in song; white puffs of breath show in the cold air.

4308.title: supporter_4308
4308.asset_description: A floodlit football terrace at night. Rows of men and women in dark winter jackets stand shoulder to shoulder, singing with their heads back and their hands pressed to their chests, breath steaming in the cold. Behind them hundreds more hold club scarves in dark red, blue and yellow stretched above their heads in a long line up the stand.

4309.title: anthem_4309
4309.asset_description: Close-up of a footballer in a green and gold shirt standing in a line before a match at night. She has her hand flat on her chest and sings, tears running down both cheeks and her eyes red. Her team-mates stand beside her doing the same. A flag flies from a pole behind her, and the packed stand of spectators also stands with hands on their hearts.

4310.title: emotional_4310
