4310.asset_description: A footballer in a green shirt stands in a floodlit stadium, her face wet with tears and her mouth open as she sings. Her team-mates stand in a line with their arms around each other's shoulders, singing toward the packed stand where a green flag waves. The camera returns to her; she is crying too hard to go on and covers her eyes with her hand.

4311.title: young_4311
4311.asset_description: An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

4312.title: loud_4312
4312.asset_description: A cartoon of a man in a red and blue tracksuit and blue gloves standing on empty sand dunes under a violet sky. He leans forward, cups both hands around his open mouth and calls out. Four curved yellow arcs are drawn in the air in front of his mouth to show the sound travelling out across the empty desert; there is nobody else in the picture.

4313.title: pub_4313
4313.asset_description: A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.

4314.title: orange_4314
4314.asset_description: A watercolour of a bright holiday flat seen from the open front door, the key still in the lock. A young man with a backpack wheels a large suitcase in across the terracotta tiles. At the far end a woman pushes open the louvered balcony doors onto a blue sea view and the net curtains billow inward. On the tiled kitchen counter in the foreground stands a bowl holding four round orange fruits and a bunch of purple grapes; a beige sofa with folded towels sits beside it.

4315.title: price_4315
4315.asset_description: A woman in a beige trench coat walks through flats one after another. First a cramped room with a bed pushed against the wall, a boiler above it, a radiator and a small cooker by a narrow window. Then a small living room with a grey sofa and a balcony door, where she sits down and the caption 1,200 EUR appears over her. Finally she stands in a vast empty glass-walled floor high above a city, turning to look around with her mouth open as the caption 10,000 EUR appears.

4316.title: sorry_4316
4316.transcript: I'm so sorry. My fault, all mine, needed for less.
4316.asset_description: An office desk by a window. A young man in a knitted vest and glasses sits with his head bowed low over the desk, holding a wrapped bunch of white and yellow tulips; a large brown puddle of spilled coffee covers the laptop keyboard beside him. He sits up, grimaces at the mess and points at himself as he speaks, then mops the keyboard with a cloth. A woman colleague comes and stands over him with her arms folded; he bows deeply and holds the tulips up to her, and she takes them.

4317.title: apologize_4317
4317.asset_description: A cafe table by a window. A man in a camel coat and a woman in a black polo neck both freeze open-mouthed as spilled drink spreads across the wooden table and soaks the open sketchbook in front of her. He leans in talking fast, pulls napkins from the holder and blots the wet page, then lifts the book clear. He comes back with a cup of coffee, sets it down in front of her and speaks with his hands open; she turns to him and smiles.

4318.title: applause_4318
4318.asset_description: A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.

4319.title: blend_4319
4319.asset_description: A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.

4320.title: plan_4320
4320.asset_description: A watercolour of a bright studio with tall windows. A man in a light blue shirt leans over a large wooden table covered with big sheets of technical drawings showing rooms and walls in fine line. He steadies a metal rule with one hand and draws along it with a yellow pencil. Rolled-up sheets, a second pencil, an eraser and an angled desk lamp lie on the table, and a small white card model of a flat-roofed house stands on a base board at the right.

4321.title: model_4321
4321.asset_description: A glass-walled office. A woman in a headscarf and a beige blazer leans over a large technical drawing, holding a rule down and marking it with a yellow pencil while two colleagues lean in on either side. She then stands at a table holding a miniature city built in beige card and plastic, with tiny tower blocks, low houses, roads, green lawns and little trees, and reaches in to adjust one of the small towers. Finally she stands outdoors in a yellow hard hat, holding a drawing up in front of a real cluster of tall glass towers.

4322.title: dance_4322
4322.asset_description: A charcoal and pencil sketch of a street scene: a man in a dark suit and a woman in a long dark dress dance a tango in the middle of a cobbled street, her body arched back against his arm, their faces almost touching. Behind them a musician in a flat cap sits on a wooden chair playing a bandoneon. A flag with a sun in the middle hangs from a pole on the left, and tall wooden houses with balconies line the street.

4323.title: lane_4323
4323.asset_description: A photograph of a narrow cobbled lane running between rows of brightly painted corrugated-iron houses — red, blue, yellow — with a yellow iron balcony above on the left. The lane narrows away towards a low sun at the far end. In the middle of it a couple dance: a man in a brown waistcoat holds a woman in a long grey skirt in a dance hold, both leaning into a long step.

4324.title: vast_4324
4324.asset_description: A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.

4325.title: cattle_4325
4325.asset_description: A colourful illustration of an open grassy plain. A young man in a wide-brimmed hat, poncho and baggy trousers stands with his back half turned, whirling a set of weighted cords above his head. A brown horse rears up in a cloud of dust behind him on the left. Across the middle of the plain several dark cows graze in a loose group, and behind them stand purple mountains. On the right a light-blue and white flag flies from a pole beside a saddle blanket with a gourd and a metal kettle on it.

4326.title: wood_4326
4326.asset_description: A photograph taken at sunset on a flat grassy plain with a low white farmhouse in the distance. A man in a black beret and a work shirt lifts a heavy iron grill rack loaded with racks of ribs off a long open fire pit, sending a shower of orange sparks up. The pit below is full of burning logs and a thick bed of pale ash. A rough wooden table on the left holds a mate gourd with a metal straw, and the pit itself is framed with thick wooden beams.

4327.title: barbecue_4327
4327.asset_description: Outdoors at sunset, a young man tends a large grill covered with sausages and racks of ribs over glowing embers. Behind him a long table with a white cloth is lined with friends and family sitting on both sides, drinks and plates in front of them, watching and clapping. He spoons green herb sauce over the meat, cuts into it with a long knife, then lifts a piece on the knife towards the camera with his mouth open in delight while the people at the table cheer.

4328.title: rug_4328
4328.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a living room. A young woman has flopped backwards into a large floral armchair with her legs thrown up over the back, feet in the air, and has just tossed a yellow cushion up above her — it hangs in mid-air over the chair. A tall floor lamp stands to the left, a mug sits on a small wooden side table to the right, and a big window with curtains fills the background. On the pale floor in front of the chair lies a patterned rug with a fringed edge, and a second cushion has landed on the floor beside it.

4329.title: furniture_4329
4329.asset_description: Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

4330.title: march_4330
4330.asset_description: A photograph of a wide dirt parade ground under a clear blue sky. Rows and rows of young soldiers in matching tan uniforms and brown boots move forward in step, all with the same leg swung out and the same arm thrown straight up in front of them. One soldier at the front wears a tan helmet. Behind them the ranks stretch back to a long concrete wall with coloured flags on poles above it, and dust rises around their boots.

4331.title: march_4331
4331.asset_description: A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.

4332.title: arrest_4332
4332.asset_description: A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.

4333.title: platform_4333
4333.asset_description: A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.

4334.title: studio_4334
4334.asset_description: An oil painting of a bright, cluttered work room. A woman in a paint-spattered white smock stands at a tall wooden easel by a large window, a wooden palette loaded with yellow, blue and red paint balanced on her arm and a brush raised to the canvas. Blank stretched canvases lean in stacks against the walls and the easel, framed paintings hang behind her, jars of brushes stand on a stool and a low table, and squeezed tubes of paint lie on the table beside her.

4335.title: ask_4335
4335.asset_description: In a tiered lecture hall a young woman in a mustard jumper and round glasses sits at a desk in the middle rows, throws one arm straight up and speaks towards the front, eyebrows up. Around her the other students sit taking notes. Then more and more hands go up around her, until in the last shots the whole hall — row after row of students — has a hand in the air, all looking towards the front and speaking at once.

4336.title: instructions_4336
4336.asset_description: In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.

4337.title: phone_4337
4337.asset_description: An anime-style drawing of an office corridor with glass-walled meeting rooms. A young woman in a teal trouser suit hurries straight towards the camera with a mobile phone wedged between her ear and her shoulder, mouth open in mid-sentence. She clutches a stack of buff folders against her chest with one arm and balances a cardboard tray of four takeaway coffee cups on the other hand. Loose sheets of paper and pens fly out behind her, and two colleagues stand talking further down the corridor.

4338.title: cash_4338
4338.asset_description: A comic-style night scene in the rain. A wet grey cash machine is set into a concrete wall, its screen glowing pink and blue, a bank card sticking half out of the card slot at the top. A fan of banknotes is spraying out of the money slot in the middle of the machine, and one more note flutters away through the air on the left. A young woman in fingerless gloves reaches for the flying note with one hand while her other hand rests on the keypad. Behind her the wet street reflects neon city lights.

4339.title: bank_4339
4339.asset_description: A woman in a beige blazer pushes a card into the slot of a cash machine on a busy street, then keys something in. The clip cuts to her walking up to a row of cash machines inside a bright hall, each set into the wall under its own lit sign, and then to a longer row of machines with different bank logos above them where travellers with suitcases stand waiting to use them. Finally she stands in front of one of the machines fanning a thick stack of banknotes in both hands, mouth open in delight.

4340.title: chips_4340
4340.asset_description: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.

4341.title: flee_4341
4341.asset_description: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.

4342.title: haul_4342
4342.asset_description: A pencil-sketch attic under sloping roof beams. A young woman in a work shirt and loose trousers has both hands on the rope handle of a heavy wooden trunk and is dragging it across the bare floorboards towards the viewer, leaning her whole weight back and bending her knees. Dust rises in clouds around the trunk and off the torn dust sheet it has pulled off the furniture. Behind her stand two stacked suitcases with an oil lantern on top, a rocking chair, rolled rugs and a small dirty window; cobwebs hang from the beams in the foreground.

4343.title: laughter_4343
4343.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon of a bright child's playroom. A young woman with a brown ponytail in a rainbow-striped jumper spins on the spot with three small children hanging off her: a boy on her back, a toddler girl held out at arm's length in the air, and another girl clinging to her leg. All four have their mouths wide open, eyes screwed up, heads thrown back. A polka-dot party hat and a rainbow lollipop fly out of the spin. Balloons float at the left, cushions are scattered on the floor, and a wooden toy box full of teddy bears and building blocks stands by the wall.

4344.title: affection_4344
4344.asset_description: A warm, sunlit home kitchen photographed from the doorway. An older woman in a patterned apron stands behind a younger woman in a flour-dusted apron and hugs her from behind, both arms wrapped round her chest, their cheeks pressed together. Both are laughing with their eyes closed; there is flour on the younger one's face and on their hands. On the wooden kitchen island in front of them sits a black baking tray of golden pastries just out of the oven, with steam and a metal mixing bowl beside it. Open shelves of jars and spices line the walls, ladles and knives hang on rails, and an oven with a checked tea towel stands to the left.

4345.title: joy_4345
4345.asset_description: A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.

4346.title: hop_4346
4346.asset_description: A photographic outback scene at sunset. A man in a wide-brimmed bush hat and dusty work clothes walks across bare red sand with a canvas duffel bag slung over one shoulder, turning to look back over his shoulder at the camera; his boot kicks up a puff of red dust. Behind and to his right a mob of five or six grey kangaroos is bounding past through the spinifex grass, each caught in mid-air with its long tail out behind it and its back legs tucked under. A huge red rock monolith glows orange in the low sun on the horizon, with scattered trees and dry golden grass in front of it.

4347.title: ferry_4347
4347.asset_description: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.

4348.title: athletic_4348
4348.asset_description: A photograph of a wide sandy beach on a clear day. A woman in a plain black one-piece swimsuit runs up out of the shallows with a pale, well-used surfboard clamped under her right arm. Her hair is wet and pushed back, her arms and legs are muscular, one foot is off the ground and sand sprays out from under her heel. A wave curls and breaks behind her. Two red-and-yellow patrol flags stand in the sand on either side of the frame, and a wooden lifeguard tower sits on the grassy dune behind.

4349.title: guard_4349
4349.asset_description: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.

4350.title: bell_4350
4350.asset_description: An illustrated alpine scene. A boy in a flat cap, white shirt and red waistcoat runs down a dirt track waving a thin stick above his head, driving a small herd of brown-and-white cows ahead of him. Each cow has a big brass bell hanging from a wide collar under its neck, drawn large and golden in the foreground. A wooden chalet with a stone base and a shingled roof stands on the slope behind them. The meadow is full of small white, yellow and blue wildflowers; further down the valley there are haystacks, barns, a blue lake and snow-capped peaks under heavy purple clouds.

4351.title: marble_4351
4351.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.

4352.title: turn_4352
4352.asset_description: A bold comic-book illustration of a skier coming down a steep white slope. She wears a red, white and blue race suit, a blue helmet and mirrored goggles, and is leaning hard into a change of direction: her knees are bent, her body is tipped over towards the inside of the curve, both skis are up on their edges and a thick wall of snow sprays up off them to her left. Both poles trail behind her and speed lines streak down the slope. Above and behind, a cable lift carries red and yellow cabins over dark pine trees, with white mountain peaks and a few clouds in the blue sky.

4353.title: dessert_4353
4353.asset_description: A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.

4354.title: kick_4354
4354.asset_description: A woodcut-style illustration of an autumn wood in ochre, orange and brown. A woman in a chunky knitted jumper, a long knitted scarf and lace-up boots leans back against a thick tree trunk with one hand, swings her right leg forward and sends a fan of dry orange and red leaves flying up off the path in front of her. More leaves spiral down from the bare branches overhead. A squirrel sits on a fallen log beside the leaf-covered path further back, and acorns and chestnuts lie among the leaves in the foreground.

4355.title: adorable_4355
4355.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon seen from above. A round-cheeked baby with one curl of hair, huge shining eyes and a wide open smile lies on its back on a white playmat printed with stars and little animal faces. It wears a pink top and a mint-green nappy, and it is waving both fists in the air and kicking its bare feet up so the toes point at the camera. A pink and blue rattle hovers just above it, still shaking. Adult hands reach in towards the baby from both bottom corners, and teddy bears, folded blankets and soft toys lie around the edge of the mat with sparkles drawn in the air.

4356.title: sore_4356
4356.asset_description: A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.

4357.title: canvas_4357
4357.asset_description: A watercolour of a young woman stopped on a stony mountain trail, seen from behind and slightly to the side, her brown hair blowing across her face as she looks back down the path. She carries an enormous pale khaki rucksack made of thick woven cloth, painted so the weave and the creases show, with brown leather straps, buckles and a stitched patch on the lid, and a dented tin mug clipped to one side. One loose strap hangs down and trails on the ground behind her. The narrow path winds away below through rocks and pine trees, with blue ridges of hills and tall white clouds behind.

4358.title: heavy_4358
4358.asset_description: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.

4359.title: can_4359
4359.asset_description: A black-and-white retro cartoon of a city pavement. A wide-eyed boy in a white shirt and dark shorts has tripped and is falling backwards, both white-gloved hands flung out and his mouth open in shock, one shoe kicking up in the air. In front of him a big paper grocery bag has split down the side, and its contents are flying out: three round metal tins with ribbed lids and paper labels, a baguette, a sliced loaf, a jar and several apples, with a stream of liquid spraying out of one tin. Another apple bounces along the pavement to the right. A curved street lamp, a shop awning, a blank hanging shop sign and two blurred passers-by fill the background.

4360.title: purse_4360
4360.asset_description: A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.

4361.title: shop_4361
4361.asset_description: A woman in a bright floral dress stands on a sunny city street holding up two big brown paper shopping bags, one in each hand, grinning. She then walks through a shopping centre past lit storefronts with bags hanging off both arms, adds more bags and totes, and finally rides up an escalator hugging a pile of paper bags to her chest.

4362.title: belt_4362
4362.asset_description: A neon-lit illustration of an airport arrivals hall at night. A long metal conveyor belt curves through the middle of the frame carrying suitcases and bags along it. A hooded traveller lifts a hard-shell suitcase off the moving belt; behind the railing a crowd with umbrellas waits and watches, lit by pink and blue screens overhead. Empty luggage trolleys stand along the wall.

4363.title: appear_4363
4363.asset_description: A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.

4364.title: dough_4364
4364.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a young woman and an older woman shape pale balls of dough and set them in rows on a baking tray dusted with flour. The older woman opens the oven and they slide the trays of raw dough inside. Later the oven is opened again and trays of golden baked croissants come out steaming, filling the table.

4365.title: fresh_4365
4365.asset_description: An older woman pulls a tray of just-baked golden rolls out of the oven in a country kitchen. A younger woman in a red apron turns to the camera holding a warm loaf of bread in one hand and a berry tart in the other, mouth open in delight. The table fills with steaming rolls, croissants, loaves and pies straight from the oven, and both women throw their arms up beside it.

4366.title: job_4366
4366.asset_description: A watercolour of a man at work in a bakery. He wears a flour-dusted apron over rolled-up sleeves and holds a long wooden peel with two golden loaves on the end, sliding them out of a glowing brick oven. Smoke drifts up, baguettes hang from a rail, finished rolls sit on the shelves behind him and sacks of flour stand below. He is smiling as he works.

4367.title: dry_4367
4367.asset_description: An ink-style drawing of the side of a wooden apartment building. Big white sheets and shirts are pegged out on lines strung between the balconies, billowing in the wind. A person in a grey robe leans on the iron balcony railing looking down at the street, with potted plants beside them, telephone poles and swirling clouds behind.

4368.title: light_4368
4368.asset_description: A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.

4369.title: tape_4369
4369.asset_description: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.

4370.title: safe_4370
4370.asset_description: A black-and-white noir illustration of a bank interior. The huge round steel door of the strongroom stands open at the back, its thick locking wheel and bolts showing, with neat stacks of banknotes on the shelves inside. In the foreground a man in a hat slides a bundle of notes across the marble counter to a clerk behind brass railings, while another man in a long coat walks across the chequered floor.

4371.title: lobby_4371
4371.asset_description: A woman in a dark suit pushes through the glass doors of a bank. At the counter a clerk feeds banknotes through a counting machine. She then walks into the wide marble entrance hall, a big information screen on the wall and a row of staffed desks along the side. At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.

4373.title: gather_4373
4373.asset_description: A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.

4374.title: electric_4374
4374.asset_description: A cartoon of a barber's shop. The barber, in apron and waistcoat, stands over a seated customer holding a buzzing electric clipper in his right hand, its yellow cable trailing down to the socket and little motion lines coming off the head, while in his left hand he holds a plain wooden comb. Behind him are a big oval mirror, a striped barber's pole and shelves of bottles.

4375.title: rough_4375
4375.asset_description: A charcoal drawing filling the frame with the outer skin of a tree trunk: thick ridges, deep cracks and hard flaking plates, with patches of lichen. A hand at the right pulls a long broken strip away from the trunk, and small crumbs fall from it against the pale background.

4376.title: noise_4376
4376.asset_description: A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.

4377.title: basement_4377
4377.asset_description: A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.

4378.title: shower_4378
4378.asset_description: A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.

4379.title: tub_4379
4379.asset_description: A stained-glass style picture of a woman cleaning a bathroom. She leans over a big white roll-top bath in yellow rubber gloves, scrubbing the inside with a stiff brush. The bath is full of white suds and they are spilling over the rim in a wave onto the tiled floor around her bare feet. A brass tap and shower fitting sit at the head of the bath, a towel hangs on the rail and a washbasin stands in the foreground.

4380.title: fill_4380
4380.asset_description: A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.

4381.title: warm_4381
4381.asset_description: A pastel cartoon beach on a bright sunny day. Striped parasols and towels are spread out over the yellow sand, with a bucket and spade beside one of them. A girl in a swimsuit and wrap skirt runs barefoot along the water's edge with her hair streaming behind her, while a beach ball bounces beside her. Seagulls glide overhead and a big sun hangs over the sea.

4382.title: salmon_4382
4382.asset_description: A black-and-white charcoal drawing of a grizzly bear standing upright in a shallow river. A large salmon leaps out of the water in front of it with drops flying off its body, and the bear reaches out with its claws to grab the fish. Pine trees and mist fill the background.

4383.title: thick_4383
4383.asset_description: In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.

4384.title: bounce_4384
4384.asset_description: A pastel cartoon bedroom. A girl in pyjamas is caught in mid-air above her bed, knees bent and hair flying upwards, having just sprung off the mattress. The duvet is flung up on one side and two pillows float in the air around her. A bedside table with a round lamp stands to the right.

4385.title: cost_4385
4385.asset_description: A price comparison of three beds. First a caption reading €50 over a bare mattress lying on the carpet, where a young man flops down and curls up on it. Then €800 over an ordinary double bed with a colourful patterned duvet, where a woman sits up smiling. Finally €20,000 over a huge four-poster bed in a dark red room, where a man in a silk robe throws himself backwards onto the covers.

4386.title: poster_4386
4386.asset_description: Three bedrooms one after another. The first is a small room whose walls are completely covered with band and film posters and fairy lights; a lad in a hoodie lies back on the bed next to an acoustic guitar. The second is a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman kneels and lays out a futon. The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.

4387.title: compare_4387
4387.asset_description: Three very different bedrooms are put side by side. First a teenager's room with a poster-covered wall and two guitars, where a lad throws himself onto a narrow bed. Then a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman unfolds a white futon on the floor. Finally a dark luxury hotel bedroom with wood panelling, where a man in a robe opens the curtains onto a sea view and drops backwards onto the enormous bed.

4388.title: daisy_4388
4388.asset_description: A soft cartoon meadow. A round cartoon bee with blurred wings hovers in the middle of the frame, trailing golden pollen from its legs. All around it grow big white daisies with fat yellow centres, some of them filling the whole bottom of the picture, along with a few pink clover heads.

4389.title: start_4389
4389.asset_description: A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. An official on the poolside waves an arm at him, he goes into the water and swims a length, then climbs out at the wall, picks up his goggles and walks away along the tiles looking furious.

4390.title: excitement_4390
4390.asset_description: A woman in a bright blue jacket stands in a hallway with her hands clasped together, bouncing and beaming as if she cannot believe what is happening. Then she is outside at dusk with a friend, laughing and hurrying along a road towards a lit-up arena, and finally the two of them are in the crowd under coloured lights, holding each other's arms and jumping and dancing.

4391.title: alone_4391
4391.asset_description: A woman on her own at home. She sings into a hairbrush and dances around her empty living room in a big jumper. Then she sits at a table with a whole pepperoni pizza in front of her and one lit candle, and takes a bite straight from the slice. Finally she carries the pizza box through to her bedroom and lies back across the bed by herself, smiling.

4392.title: fall_4392
4392.asset_description: A cartoon park in autumn. A man in a blue jacket and backpack has gone over the back of a wooden bench and is caught upside down in mid-air, arms out and one hand grabbing at a bin. His paper lunch bag and its contents fly out above him, orange leaves swirl around, and a fat pigeon on the back of the bench watches him go down.

4393.title: chat_4393
4393.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap sits on a wooden bench in a park, opens a paper bag of grain and scatters it on the path, and pigeons crowd around his feet. The shot moves to a seafront promenade with palm trees, where he sits on a metal bench by the blue sea with the bag still in his hand, and then he is sitting shoulder to shoulder with two other older men on the bench, all of them talking and laughing together.

4394.title: bend_4394
4394.asset_description: In a garden a woman holds a clear plastic strip in both hands and pulls the ends down so that it curves into an arch in front of her face, pulling a delighted expression. She does the same with a thick tree branch, hauling it down into a curve over her head. Then on the grass a girl in a leotard drops backwards into a full crab position with her whole body arched, while the woman crouches beside her with her mouth open.

4395.title: opponent_4395
4395.asset_description: Four friends sit around a coffee table playing a big fantasy board game covered in coloured miniatures. A woman with red hair leans over the board while the man beside her sips from a can. She reaches across and moves a piece into his territory, and he turns to the camera with his mouth wide open in disbelief while she smiles to herself.

4396.title: shock_4396
4396.asset_description: A couple sit on a sofa playing a board game with red and blue pieces spread over a map board. He points at the board and talks, drinking from a green can; she quietly reaches over and moves her red pieces. When he looks back at the board his eyes go wide and his mouth drops open, and she sits back with a small satisfied smile while he keeps staring.

4397.title: bike_4397
4397.asset_description: A young man in a green jacket films himself riding an old city bike through Amsterdam. He pedals over a brick street lined with narrow gabled houses and parked bikes, then along a canal with boats moored under bare trees, then past a brick building and in through a wide entrance. Inside he rides down the aisle of an enormous multi-storey bicycle park, racks of bikes stacked to the ceiling on both sides, and points up at them.

4398.title: advertisement_4398
4398.asset_description: A woman in cat-eye glasses stands at a bus shelter looking up with her mouth open in amazement. From a moving train window a large roadside billboard advertising a house slides past above the motorway. Then she is standing in Times Square at dusk, turning on the spot under towers of huge lit advertising screens and grinning up at them.

4399.title: dream_4399
4399.asset_description: At dusk a woman in a denim jacket stands at a lit bus-stop panel showing a giant cheeseburger, her mouth open and her hand on the glass as if she could eat it. From a car window a billboard slides past against an orange sunset, showing a big white house with palm trees and a pool. Then at night she stands alone in Times Square with her arms out, looking up at a stack of glowing screens advertising burgers and perfume.

4400.title: spot_4400
4400.asset_description: An anime-style drawing of a woman standing on a grassy clifftop above the sea, holding a battered pair of binoculars up to her eyes with both hands. The worn leather strap hangs down over her shoulders and her dark hair blows across her face. In each big round lens you can see what she has picked out far away: the open sea and a line of small birds flying over it.

4401.title: far_4401
4401.asset_description: A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.

4402.title: appetite_4402
4402.asset_description: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.

4403.title: layer_4403
4403.asset_description: A man in a grey jumper sits on a sofa in a sunlit living room and reaches for a folded blanket beside him. He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.

4404.title: injury_4404
4404.asset_description: A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.

4405.title: help_4405
4405.asset_description: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.

4406.title: smooth_4406
4406.asset_description: A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.

4407.title: healthy_4407
4407.asset_description: A young man in a neon sports vest stands at a kitchen counter and drops sliced banana into a blender jug already filled with chunks of mango, then adds raspberries and a big handful of fresh spinach. He clamps the lid on and runs the machine until everything turns into a thick orange drink, pours it into a tall glass and holds the full glass up to the camera.

4408.title: taste_4408
4408.asset_description: A man in a neon vest fills a blender jug with banana slices, mango chunks, raspberries and spinach, blends it to a bright orange smoothie and pours it into a tall glass. He lifts the glass, takes a long drink and pulls it away with an orange smoothie moustache on his upper lip, grinning at how good it is.

4409.title: blind_4409
4409.transcript: I can't see anything. This way?
4409.asset_description: At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.

4410.title: contest_4410
4410.transcript: Oh, I blinked. You blinked. Don't blink.
4410.asset_description: An extreme close-up of a wide-open eye opens the clip. Friends in a living room sit facing each other in pairs, nose to nose, eyes stretched wide, each trying to outlast the other without shutting their eyes. One pair after another is shown straining. Finally somebody loses, and the whole room bursts out laughing and points at the loser.

4411.title: treatment_4411
4411.asset_description: High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.

4412.title: block_4412
4412.asset_description: A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.

4413.title: smell_4413
4413.asset_description: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.

4414.title: struggle_4414
4414.asset_description: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.

4415.title: compliment_4415
4415.asset_description: In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.

4416.title: ticket_4416
4416.asset_description: At a check-in desk a small printer pushes out a long strip of boarding passes and a hand circles the gate number on it with a blue pen. A traveller with long braids takes hers, reads it and smiles, then holds the printed card against the scanner at the automatic gate until the light turns green. She walks down the jet bridge, through the aircraft door past the crew, and along the aisle looking for her seat.

4417.title: travel_4417
4417.asset_description: A blonde woman with a red backpack steps up through the doors of a tram, holding the handrail, and turns back to the camera from inside. Next she walks along a gangway onto a small blue and white ferry moored at a sunny harbour. Finally she climbs the aircraft steps onto a plane on the runway and turns at the top of the stairs to wave before going in.

4418.title: burst_4418
4418.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a woman in an embroidered blouse leans over a gas hob where a blue flame burns under a small saucepan. Beside it a big pot of water rolls at a full boil and white steam streams off the surface towards the window. She reaches for a huge lidded pot, lifts the heavy lid, and a thick white cloud of steam bursts up into her face; she rears back with her mouth open.

4419.title: row_4419
4419.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon of a girl in dungarees and a striped top sitting in a little wooden boat on a calm pond. She holds an oar in each hand, one blade lifted clear of the water and flicking up droplets, the other dipping in and leaving a swirl behind it. A golden puppy lies over the bow watching the water; lily pads, bulrushes, a small jetty and rounded hills fill the background.

4420.title: illustration_4420
4420.asset_description: An old book plate on yellowed, foxed paper inside a hand-inked border. In the middle, drawn entirely in fine brown pen strokes, is a single long thigh bone seen at an angle: the round ball at the hip end at the top right, the smooth shaft running diagonally down, the two knobs of the knee end at the bottom left. Dense cross-hatching behind it gives the shading and shadow.

4421.title: bone_4421
4421.asset_description: In a classroom a girl in a mustard jumper holds a small white bone up close to the camera between her finger and thumb, other pupils working at desks behind her. She turns to a hanging plastic skeleton and lifts a long thigh bone off a grey tray with both hands, turning it so the knobbly ends show; more long bones lie on the tray beside her. The scene cuts to a museum hall where she looks up open-mouthed at the huge mounted skeleton of a dinosaur and points up at its ribcage.

4423.title: barrier_4423
4423.asset_description: A sunlit desert checkpoint photographed from the side. A long red and white striped boom bar is raised at a steep angle across the top of the frame, its counterweight end low on the left. Under it a person in an olive jacket with a canvas backpack walks over a broad white line painted on the cracked asphalt, kicking up a small puff of dust. A white concrete marker post stands to the left, a plain wooden guard hut to the right, and behind them a chain link fence and bare brown mountains under a clear blue sky.

4424.title: border_4424
4424.asset_description: A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.

4425.title: order_4425
4425.asset_description: A comic book style drawing of a meeting room high in a futuristic city. A tall robot in a business suit leans right over a glass table, one metal hand slammed flat on the surface hard enough to send a cracking flash out from under it, the other arm flung out pointing at the screen on the wall behind him. His visor glows and his mouth is set in a hard grin. A cup has been knocked over and a pen has bounced into the air. Around the table three other robots shrink back, hands raised to their heads, glowing tablets in front of them.

4426.title: meeting_4426
4426.asset_description: A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.

4427.title: ceremony_4427
4427.asset_description: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.

4429.title: restaurant_4429
4429.asset_description: A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.

4430.title: kid_4430
4430.asset_description: A soft cartoon of a small child with thick curly brown hair, big brown eyes and pink cheeks, laughing with his mouth wide open. He wears a yellow t shirt, rolled up blue denim shorts, white socks and red trainers, and he is caught mid run with both arms flung out and one foot lifted behind him. In front of his other foot sits a large ball painted with red, blue and yellow stripes and dots. Behind him are rounded green trees, pale grass and a soft blue sky with two white clouds.

4431.title: score_4431
4431.asset_description: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.

4432.title: ignore_4432
4432.asset_description: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.

4433.title: bunch_4433
4433.asset_description: A loose pen and watercolour sketch of a doorstep at evening. A young man in a beige jacket stands side on in the foreground, glancing back over his shoulder with a small pleased smile, one hand in his pocket. In his other hand, held down behind his back, he grips the stems of a big bundle of flowers: red and pink roses and yellow blooms gathered together, with a single petal drifting away. Behind him the front door stands open with warm yellow light spilling out, a young woman inside clapping her hands to her face in delight, a lantern glowing on the wall and terracotta pots either side of the step.

4434.title: fair_4434
4434.asset_description: At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.

4435.title: exhibition_4435
4435.asset_description: In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.

4436.title: cheer_4436
4436.asset_description: A colour cartoon of a beach in Rio. A player in a yellow shirt, blue shorts and brown boots is upside down in mid air doing an overhead bicycle kick, sand spraying up behind his heel and a worn brown ball flying off above him. A green and yellow flag flies on a pole at the left, and behind the beach rise a green mountain topped by a statue with outstretched arms and the rounded peak of another headland. On the right three children stand with their arms thrown up and their mouths wide open, and on the left a boy watches with his mouth open too.

4438.title: parade_4438
4438.asset_description: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.

4439.title: festival_4439
4439.asset_description: A photograph taken at dusk in a narrow cobbled street between old colonial houses with lit windows and glowing wall lamps. In the middle a young drummer marches towards the camera wearing an enormous headdress of green, blue and gold feathers and a matching feathered shoulder piece over a bare chest, a big wooden barrel drum slung at his waist and a beater raised in his hand. Behind and beside him a whole band of drummers in bright shirts play more drums, dancers in gold costumes move among them, and paper streamers in green, yellow and pink fly through the air with bunting strung overhead and the low sun burning at the end of the street.

4440.title: strike_4440
4440.asset_description: In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.

4441.title: breath_4441
4441.asset_description: A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.

4442.title: shoe_4442
4442.asset_description: A hand-drawn illustration of a bright dressing room. A young woman in a long white gown with a veil spins on the spot, her wide skirt lifting and swinging out around her, and she holds a bunch of white daisies up in one hand. As the skirt swings up it uncovers her feet: she wears a pair of plain white shoes with a low heel, one flat on the carpet and one lifted behind her as she turns. Behind her are a tall gold-framed mirror, a bright window with cream curtains, vases of flowers and a dress bag hanging on a hook.

4443.title: wedding_4443
4443.asset_description: In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.

4445.title: bridge_4445
4445.asset_description: A young couple walk hand in hand through a wooden garden arch, then lean on a mossy stone wall looking out over the water at a long stone bridge with tall arches carrying a road across a bay. The camera drops to show three pairs of trainers standing side by side on the concrete, then the couple stand together at the red railings of a huge red suspension bridge, holding hands and looking up at its towers and cables as the road runs away from them across the water. The man turns to the camera by one of the red towers, laughing and pointing up at it.

4446.title: glass_4446
4446.asset_description: Inside a dark wooden pub, a smiling man in a grey coat leans across a wooden table and knocks his tall glass against another one held by the person filming. Both glasses are full of amber beer with a white head, and you can see the light coming straight through the clear glass and the drink inside. Behind him the pub is fitted with panels of frosted, patterned glass above the bar and beside the windows, with a dartboard, brass beer taps and other drinkers laughing in the background.

4447.title: wet_4447
4447.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.

4448.title: handle_4448
4448.asset_description: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.

4450.title: patch_4450
4450.asset_description: A cartoon of a children's bedroom with a wooden bunk bed. A laughing boy in blue dungarees carries a smaller boy upside down over his shoulder. The dungarees are worn out and have square patches of a different shade of cloth stitched onto the leg and the hip, the stitching drawn as a line of little dashes around each one. On the lower bunk lies a quilt sewn together from many differently coloured squares, and a cushion made of the same patched squares flies through the air above them, while toy trucks, wooden blocks, a rugby ball and a skateboard lie on the floor.

4451.title: teenager_4451
4451.asset_description: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.

4452.title: hurt_4452
4452.asset_description: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.

4454.title: tip_4454
4454.asset_description: A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.

4455.title: site_4455
4455.asset_description: A drawn scene of a piece of open ground where a house is going up. Metal scaffolding poles rise on the left over a half-built brick wall, a concrete mixer turns on its stand, and two wheelbarrows full of wet mortar stand on the bare earth. In the middle a man in an orange hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest kneels on the ground, spreading mortar with a trowel and setting a brick into place, with a spirit level lying along the top of the courses and a stack of spare bricks beside him.

4456.title: modern_4456
4456.asset_description: A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.

4457.title: crouch_4457
4457.asset_description: On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.

4458.title: disaster_4458
4458.asset_description: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.

4459.title: burning_4459
4459.asset_description: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.

4460.title: palm_4460
4460.asset_description: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.

4461.title: dig_4461
4461.transcript: My friends bury me in the sand! Only my head is out.
4461.asset_description: A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.

4462.title: funeral_4462
4462.asset_description: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.

4463.title: welcome_4463
4463.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon of the inside of a bus, seen from behind the passengers. The driver sits at the wheel in a dark blue uniform and peaked cap, smiling broadly with one hand raised in a wave to the people getting on. A ticket roll unspools from the dashboard beside him. In the foreground, a woman in pink, two small children and a boy holding a fluffy dog look up at him, one child waving back. Sunlight comes through the windscreen and the open door.

4464.title: read_4464
4464.asset_description: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.

4465.title: upstairs_4465
4465.asset_description: A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.

4466.title: aboard_4466
4466.asset_description: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.

4467.title: ham_4467
4467.asset_description: A woodcut-style illustration of a butcher at work behind his block. He wears a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a green striped apron, and has a heavy moustache. One hand holds a raw steak flat on a thick wooden chopping block while the other swings a big cleaver up above his head, ready to bring it down. Behind him a rail runs across the wall with strings of sausages and whole cured hams hanging from steel hooks, a slab of meat on the bone at the right, and three knives on a wall rack.

4468.title: porter_4468
4468.asset_description: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.

4469.title: cabinet_4469
4469.asset_description: A fine black-and-white pen drawing of a kitchen. A young man in a shirt and jeans stands on tiptoe and pulls open the tall wooden wall unit above the worktop, one hand on the swinging door and the other reaching up into it. The shelves inside are packed with stacked plates, tins and rows of preserving jars. Two jars have already tipped out and are falling through the air towards the floor, one past the tiled wall and one large in the foreground.

4470.title: store_4470
4470.asset_description: A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.

4471.title: height_4471
4471.asset_description: A dramatic painted illustration of a cable car high in the mountains. A red and cream cabin hangs from a thick steel cable, tilted as it swings past a steel lattice pylon capped with icicles, with snow spraying off the wheels. Passengers in winter clothes look out of the windows and one points ahead; a figure in a yellow jacket leans out of a lower window. Far below, snow-covered peaks and small fir trees fill the bottom of the frame, and a second cabin hangs tiny in the distance. Swirling purple and blue clouds fill the sky around it.

4472.title: altitude_4472
