4472.asset_description: A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.

4473.title: yell_4473
4473.asset_description: A black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon set in a desert. A tall saguaro cactus with a face and a daisy on its head stands on a rock, covered in long sharp spines, looking innocent. Beside it a small round-headed cartoon character in dungarees has just touched it: he holds up one bare hand with spark lines flying off the fingers, his mouth open in a yell and his eyes wide. He is already running away, one shoe flying off and puffs of dust behind his heels, under a blazing sun and desert buttes.

4474.title: menu_4474
4474.asset_description: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

4475.title: display_4475
4475.asset_description: A warm ink-and-sepia drawing of a small café on a rainy evening. In the foreground the barista pours a stream of milk from a steel jug into a cup on the wooden counter while steam curls off the espresso machine behind him. Cups, mugs and saucers are set out in rows on the shelves above the machine and stacked along the counter. A cake stand with a glass dome shows a cut sponge cake with one slice missing, and a blank chalkboard sign stands beside it. At a small round table by the window a woman in a coat lifts a cup to her lips, with rain and warm street lights outside.

4476.title: hall_4476
4476.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.

4477.title: month_4477
4477.asset_description: An illustration of a man in a colour-blocked polo shirt standing at a wall, lifting the top sheet of a pinned-up calendar with one hand and turning the page over with the other. The sheet underneath shows a grid of squares with one square ringed in red. A red marker hangs from a string beside the calendar and three blank notes are pinned to the wall below it.

4478.title: date_4478
4478.asset_description: A woman in a mustard jumper stands at a white wall next to a window with a big photo calendar hanging on it. She uncaps a red marker, leans in and draws a red ring around one number in the grid, grinning at it. She then scribbles a large cross over the ringed number, and finally turns to the camera beaming and points at the marked day with her finger.

4479.title: hard_4479
4479.asset_description: A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.

4480.title: curve_4480
4480.asset_description: A stylised woodblock-style illustration of a camel with a patterned saddle blanket striding along the top of a desert dune at sunset. The whole bottom half of the picture is one long sweeping ridge of sand that bends across the frame in bands of orange, red and cream, and the camel's neck and the swirling clouds above it repeat the same bending line. A red sun sits low behind it.

4481.title: focus_4481
4481.asset_description: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

4482.title: shoot_4482
4482.asset_description: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.

4483.title: log_4483
4483.asset_description: An illustration seen from behind of a woman in a red checked jacket running across a frozen lake, ice skates slung over her shoulder and a hockey stick in her hand. On the right bank stands a small cabin built of stacked round tree trunks with snow on its roof and smoke rising from the chimney, next to a Canadian flag on a pole. Snowy pines and a rocky peak fill the background and red maple leaves blow across the ice.

4484.title: dawn_4484
4484.asset_description: A man in a red checked shirt kneels in a wooden canoe on a still turquoise mountain lake, mid-stroke with a wooden paddle. Behind him a wall of snow-capped rocky peaks catches the first low golden light of the morning on its faces while the lower slopes and pine forest are still in cold shadow, and a moose wades in the shallows near the far shore.

4485.title: powerful_4485
4485.asset_description: A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.

4487.title: kind_4487
4487.asset_description: A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.

4488.title: document_4488
4488.asset_description: A large bearded man in a white shirt sits in a busy open-plan office with a telephone handset wedged against his ear. His desk is buried under printed forms and official papers, many of them already marked with big red crosses. He grabs a sheet, slams a rubber stamp down on it and leaves a red X across it, then bangs the stamp onto the ledger in front of him again and again, getting angrier until sheets of paper are flying up all around his head.

4489.title: wax_4489
4489.asset_description: A dark inked illustration of a woman leaning over a table and blowing hard at a tall candle in a metal holder. The flame is bent sideways by her breath and trailing smoke. Thick melted drops run down the whole side of the candle and pool on the holder, and beside it on the table lie a matchbox and the collapsed remains of an older candle that has melted into a puddle.

4490.title: prepare_4490
4490.asset_description: A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.

4491.title: below_4491
4491.asset_description: An illustration of an enormous layered canyon at sunset, drawn in bands of orange, red and brown. On a rock ledge at the right edge stands a tiny figure in a conical hat leaning on a walking stick. From up there the ground drops away in step after step of striped cliff to a narrow green river winding along the bottom of the canyon far underneath, with tall rock spires rising out of the depths and a red sun in the swirling sky.

4492.title: impressive_4492
4492.asset_description: A man in a long black coat carrying a cream folder walks across a wide cobbled square in the early morning light, scattering a group of pigeons that flap up around his feet. Behind him two rows of tall flag poles line the square and lead the eye to an enormous ornate stone building with a gilded dome and a statue on a column in front of it, lit gold by the low sun, with a red tram and cars passing along the road at its foot.

4493.title: struggle_4493
4493.asset_description: A black and white woodcut-style illustration of an old bearded seaman in a peaked cap on the deck of a ship in a storm at night. He is braced with both fists clamped on the spokes of the big wooden steering wheel, teeth gritted and leaning his whole weight into it to hold the ship on course while a towering wave curls over the rail behind him, rain slashes down and a lantern swings on its rope above his head.

4495.title: cost_4495
4495.asset_description: A three-part comparison shot on a suburban street. A young man in a hoodie and jeans leans proudly on the roof of a rusty old brown car while the caption 500 EUR sits over it. Cut to a woman in a business suit unlocking a clean silver saloon, captioned 20,000 EUR. Cut to a red Ferrari with both butterfly doors standing wide open, and a man in a tailored suit strolling up to it, captioned 500,000 EUR.

4496.title: lay_4496
4496.asset_description: A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.

4497.title: hand_4497
4497.asset_description: A soft illustration of a small village shop seen from the customer's side of the counter. A dark-haired young shop worker in a floral apron leans over the wooden counter and holds out a single coin between his fingers, while the customer's two open hands reach up from the bottom of the frame to take it. In his other hand he holds a jar he has just scanned. Behind him a conveyor belt carries apples, a pear, oranges and packets towards a paper grocery bag, and shelves of bottles and jars fill the wall.

4498.title: sign_4498
4498.asset_description: A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.

4499.title: visit_4499
4499.asset_description: A red-haired young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and a backpack films himself on a selfie stick as he goes round several castles. He runs up a steep grassy slope towards a stone tower and touches the old wall, laughing. The camera then sweeps through a castle courtyard hung with coloured banners, and finally he walks up a path through trees towards an enormous turreted castle on a hill, grinning back at the camera.

4500.title: quick_4500
4500.asset_description: A montage of people snatching things out of the air at the last moment. A young woman in a park pulls a falling tennis ball into her chest; a goalkeeper in green throws himself sideways and pins the ball to the grass in front of the goal; a young man in a kitchen shoots out a hand and grabs a plastic bottle before it hits the floor; a woman in a garden takes a whole watermelon out of the air with both hands; a boy lying on the grass stops a huge beach ball above his face with his hands and feet.

4501.title: insect_4501
4501.asset_description: A soft cartoon illustration of a plump green caterpillar with yellow stripes resting along a big green leaf in a sunny garden. It has a small smiling face with pink cheeks and a row of little round legs gripping the leaf. A bite-shaped piece is missing from the edge of the leaf just in front of it, with one crumb of leaf floating away. Behind it are rounded bushes, pink, blue and yellow flowers and sparkles of light.

4502.title: ceiling_4502
4502.asset_description: Three shots of people looking up at what is above them indoors. A man lies flat on a bed and stares up at a plain white surface with a single bare bulb on a round fitting. A woman on a sofa leans back and looks up at the wooden beams and rafters of a bright open room. A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.

4503.title: wish_4503
4503.asset_description: A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.

4504.title: success_4504
4504.asset_description: An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.

4505.title: backwards_4505
4505.asset_description: A bright cartoon of a small boy who has tipped his chair too far. He is caught mid-fall, leaning back with the blue and yellow chair going over behind him, both front legs off the floor and his trainers kicking up in the air. His eyes and mouth are wide open, his arms fly out to the sides, and motion lines show the chair swinging over. Beside him is the table he was sitting at, a green chair still standing, and a patterned rug on the wooden floor.

4506.title: comfort_4506
4506.asset_description: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

4507.title: tag_4507
4507.asset_description: An illustration of an airport check-in desk seen from behind the counter. A ground agent in a blue uniform and cap holds a long curling paper label and loops it around the handle of a battered brown leather suitcase that sits on the weighing plate. A second printed strip is already hanging from the handle. The passenger in a green jacket stands on the other side of the counter watching. Behind them the belt runs into a dark hatch, screens hang from the ceiling and three more travellers queue at a rope barrier.

4508.title: load_4508
4508.asset_description: A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

4509.title: weigh_4509
4509.asset_description: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.

4510.title: check_4510
4510.asset_description: A young woman in a khaki leather jacket stands in the middle of a busy airport hall under an enormous departures board full of flight times and destinations. She holds a boarding pass in both hands, looks down and reads it carefully, then lifts her head and scans across the rows on the board, frowning slightly as she compares the two. When she finds what she is looking for she smiles, drops her hands and walks away past the other passengers with their trolleys.

4511.title: service_4511
4511.asset_description: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

4512.title: list_4512
4512.asset_description: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

4513.title: suitcase_4513
4513.asset_description: A blonde woman in a khaki jacket stands with her suitcase in an airport hall in front of a wall of departure boards listing destinations and times. She reaches up and points at one of the rows, then looks down at her watch to see how much time she has left, opens her passport with the tickets inside and reads them, and finally looks back up at the board again with a satisfied smile.

4514.title: skill_4514
4514.asset_description: A cartoon restaurant kitchen. A grinning chef in a tall white hat and white jacket stands in the middle: one hand tosses a copper frying pan whose contents (a lobster, prawns, bell peppers, onion rings and mushrooms) fly up in a huge sheet of orange flame, while the other hand holds out a steaming wooden spoon. Behind him three other cooks in white hats watch him and cheer, one with a pot lid, one with a whisk, one with a knife. Copper pans hang on the wall and plated dishes with silver cloches wait on the pass under warming lamps.

4515.title: win_4515
4515.asset_description: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.

4516.title: hay_4516
4516.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon inside a wooden barn. A plump speckled brown-and-white hen has just launched herself off her nest and hangs in mid-air with her wings spread, eyes shut and beak open, loose feathers drifting around her. Below her sits a round nest built of dried yellow grass with three pale eggs in it and two more eggs on the ground beside it. The whole barn floor is covered in the same loose dried yellow grass and more of it is heaped in the stalls behind.

4517.title: pull_4517
4517.asset_description: A dark woodcut-style print of a Victorian rooftop. A young sweep in a flat cap and long coat braces himself on the steep slate roof, one boot on the tiles and one against the brickwork, and grips a rope with both hands, one high and one low. The rope runs up over the tall brick chimney stack and down into one of its clay pots. Thick black smoke pours out of the pots and blows across a grey sky, and the roofs and chimneys of the town stand behind him.

4519.title: ash_4519
4519.asset_description: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

4520.title: stretch_4520
4520.asset_description: An ink-and-colour illustration of the Great Wall. In the foreground a woman in a long blue coat and a scarf climbs a broad stone staircase carrying a painted paper lantern, and a red flag flies from the watchtower above her. Behind her the wall runs on and on in one unbroken line: over a green ridge, down into cloud, and up again over the far blue mountains until it disappears at the horizon. Pine trees cling to the slopes and swallows dart over the battlements.

4521.title: distance_4521
4521.asset_description: A photograph on the Great Wall at sunrise. A woman in a red jacket and black trousers walks straight towards the camera along the brick walkway with her arms held out wide, a cream paper parasol in her left hand. Behind her the wall drops away to a square stone watchtower, and beyond that the wall and its towers climb over one wooded ridge after another until they fade into the mist and the pale gold sun far away.

4522.title: tour_4522
4522.asset_description: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.

4524.title: fold_4524
4524.asset_description: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.

4525.title: help_4525
4525.asset_description: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.

4526.title: election_4526
4526.asset_description: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

4527.title: vegetable_4527
4527.asset_description: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.

4528.title: grave_4528
4528.asset_description: A woodcut of a village church at night. The tall stone tower with its pointed spire rises against a swirling blue sky with a crescent moon and stars; a bell hangs in the open window of the tower with its rope swinging, and a flock of black crows scatters away from it. Warm light shows through the pointed stained-glass windows and small figures in pale robes walk in through the open wooden doors. All around the church, leaning stone markers stand in the rough grass over the buried dead, with a bare tree on each side.

4529.title: color_4529
4529.asset_description: A woman in a long cream lace dress pushes open the heavy wooden doors of a small chapel and steps inside. In a large cathedral she takes a lit candle and touches it to the wick of another one on an iron stand until a row of flames burns beside her. Then she walks down the middle of the nave, and the whole stone floor and the pillars around her are covered in patches of red, blue, green and yellow thrown down by the stained-glass windows; she stops among them, looks up at the windows and turns slowly while the patches fall across her white dress.

4530.title: film_4530
4530.asset_description: A dark cinema drawn in black and white. At the front a wide screen glows bright blue with a blurred moving picture on it, and a broad beam from the projector cuts through the dark air above the rows of seats. Most of the seats are empty and a few silhouetted heads watch from the rows. In the middle a man has jumped up out of his seat and is hurling a bucket of popcorn into the air; the popcorn scatters through the beam and over the seats around him while the man in front of him ducks away.

4531.title: popcorn_4531
4531.asset_description: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

4532.title: trash_4532
4532.asset_description: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.

4533.title: court_4533
4533.asset_description: A photograph in a wood-panelled courtroom. A woman in a patterned dress stands in the middle of the floor in front of the bench and holds a large certificate with a ribbon seal up over her head with both arms, laughing. Behind her an older man in a suit and three other family members clap and wave small paper flags, two little boys among them, and paper confetti falls through the light from the tall window. A small flag stands on the desk beside a signed document, and seated guests watch from the front row.

4534.title: official_4534
4534.asset_description: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.

4535.title: lesson_4535
4535.asset_description: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.

4536.title: craft_4536
4536.asset_description: Close-up of two clay-covered hands shaping a wet pot on a turning potter's wheel. The upper part is already a smooth thrown neck with curled clay handles; the lower part is still a rough lump. Specks of wet clay are flung across the wooden wheel head and the bench. Behind, out of focus, wooden shelves hold rows of finished pots and lumps of raw clay, with wooden tools lying on a bench.

4537.title: clear_4537
4537.asset_description: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

4538.title: rest_4538
4538.asset_description: A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.

4539.title: cartoon_4539
4539.asset_description: A hand-drawn comic-style picture with thick black outlines, flat colours and motion lines. A grinning man with round white eyes, a patched apron, big yellow rubber gloves and brown shoes swings a mop across a blue-and-cream chequered floor. Sparkle stars and soap bubbles pop off the wet tiles. A grey mop bucket on castors, full of suds and fitted with a wringer, stands to the right. Behind him are office windows with a drawn city skyline, a potted fern and a radiator.

4540.title: equipment_4540
4540.asset_description: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

4541.title: filthy_4541
4541.asset_description: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

4542.title: agreement_4542
4542.transcript: Hmm, this one. We have a deal.
4542.asset_description: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.

4543.title: risk_4543
4543.asset_description: A pencil-and-charcoal drawing of a huge sea cliff seen from the side. The rock face is a sheer, layered wall dropping straight into the sea, where white surf boils around its foot. A single thin rope runs down the middle of the face, and a tiny figure hangs on it about halfway down, dwarfed by the rock. Seabirds wheel in the empty grey sky to the left; tufts of coarse grass grow on the ledges at the bottom right.

4544.title: contrast_4544
4544.asset_description: An illustration split straight down the middle into two opposite halves. The left half is burnt orange desert: cracked dry ground, bare dead trees, a white blazing sun and grey rocky hills. The right half is deep blue ice: jagged frozen slabs, snow-laden fir trees, falling snow and heavy grey cloud. Down the seam between them rises a column of white steam shot through with glowing blue lines. A metal machine stands on each side, one in the sand, one on the ice, and a metal platform runs along the bottom of the frame.

4545.title: strength_4545
4545.asset_description: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.

4546.title: surgery_4546
4546.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a doctor's consulting room. A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck stands with her back to us, one hand on a boy's knee. The boy sits on a green examination couch with his sleeve pushed up, holding his upper arm. Behind them are a cream cabinet with a tray of pens and papers, a blank framed notice on the wall and a potted plant. A blood-pressure cuff and its bulb lie on the counter in the foreground. Through the open door a woman and a small girl in yellow wait on chairs outside.

4547.title: waiting_room_4547
4547.asset_description: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

4548.title: late_4548
4548.asset_description: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.

4549.title: fuel_4549
4549.asset_description: A charcoal drawing in blacks and greys. A bare forearm grips the wooden handle of a shovel and tips its load of chunky black lumps forward; the lumps and a shower of black dust fall through the air onto a big heap of the same shiny black rock below. Behind is a dim brick cellar lit by a single bare bulb hanging on a flex. Some of the lumps have spilled out over the drawn border onto the pale grey paper.

4550.title: finally_4550
4550.asset_description: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.

4551.title: camp_4551
4551.asset_description: A campsite on a pine-fringed lake shore under a blue sky. A blond man in a red fleece stands beside a pitched orange dome tent, grinning, then bends down and crawls in head first. A green tent and another group of campers sit further along the shore. The orange tent sags, then folds flat with only his boots sticking out of the door. He sits up under the collapsed fabric, the whole tent draped over him, and looks round laughing.

4553.title: hair_4553
4553.asset_description: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.

4554.title: flame_4554
4554.asset_description: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.

4555.title: pine_4555
4555.asset_description: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.

4556.title: praise_4556
4556.asset_description: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.

4557.title: lap_4557
4557.asset_description: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

4558.title: support_4558
4558.transcript: Hey, hey. It's okay. We're here. Thanks.
4558.asset_description: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.

4559.title: console_4559
4559.asset_description: A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.

4560.title: crew_4560
4560.asset_description: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.

4561.title: command_4561
4561.asset_description: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.

4562.title: direction_4562
4562.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a wool jumper stands on an open moor of purple heather, holding an open brass pocket compass close to her face and frowning at the needle. She crouches down and holds it flat in both palms until it settles, then straightens up, sets her jaw and strides off across the heather. The last shot shows her at sea, gripping a large ship's compass in its binnacle with the horizon behind her.

4563.title: law_4563
4563.asset_description: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.

4564.title: cooperation_4564
4564.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a village barn raising on a summer meadow. A long line of villagers in waistcoats and caps leans back on a rope, hauling a big wooden roof frame upright, while an old man in a straw hat stands on the platform pointing and directing them. On the left, women in aprons carry trays of loaves and pies out from a trestle table under an awning; a girl holds a basket. Children run across the grass with buckets and tools for the men on the ladder, and thatched cottages sit behind.

4565.title: globe_4565
4565.asset_description: An anime-style painting of the inside of a spacecraft. A child in an orange spacesuit with a white life-support pack and a tether floats up to a big round porthole, seen from behind, with both gloved hands pressed against the glass. Filling the window is the earth as one enormous blue and green ball, wrapped in white cloud, with the land masses spread across it. Instrument panels with glowing screens and bundles of cable line the walls, and a strip of black starry sky shows through a second window above.

4566.title: summit_4566
4566.asset_description: A photograph taken at sunrise from the highest rocks of a mountain. A woman in an olive jacket and a climbing harness pulls herself up over the last granite slabs, one hand flat on the rock and the other arm swung up behind her, her hair blown across her face by the wind. Below and behind her, ridge after ridge of bare mountain drops away into a hazy valley with a pale river winding through it, and the ranges fade into blue haze at the horizon under a streaked dawn sky.

4567.title: ill_4567
4567.asset_description: A soft cartoon of a young woman standing in a bright room with a bookshelf, potted plants and a sunlit window behind her. She wears an olive green jumper over a white collared shirt. She has turned her head away, screwed her eyes shut and pulled up her arm to cough hard into the crook of her elbow, her cheeks flushed pink, with little motion lines drawn beside her face.

4568.title: continent_4568
4568.asset_description: A school yard with a giant world map painted across the tarmac in bright colours, each land mass a different colour. A girl in an orange hoodie and rainbow trainers jumps from land mass to land mass, landing squarely on the yellow one, then hopping on across the map. Her classmates in tracksuits stand in a wide ring around the edge of the map watching her. She finishes by landing with both feet on the white land mass at the bottom right and throwing her arms out wide, laughing at the camera.

4569.title: fry_4569
4569.asset_description: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

4570.title: chef_4570
4570.asset_description: Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.

4571.title: push_4571
4571.asset_description: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count. The boat runs down the skids and reaches the water, and the group ends up in a circle in the shallows, hugging each other and cheering.

4572.title: correct_4572
4572.asset_description: A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.

4573.title: secret_4573
4573.asset_description: A busy diner with red vinyl booths, white tablecloths and a violinist playing between the tables. An elderly woman in a grey suit sits at a booth and slides a folded napkin across the cloth. A man in a blue shirt and tie with a gold watch heaves a brown leather briefcase up onto the table opposite her. The two of them then sit behind raised menus, glancing sideways at each other. The camera pulls back to show the long tablecloth is draped over a wheelbarrow parked at the table, and under the cloth the barrow is heaped with banded bundles of cash; they reach across and shake hands over it.

4575.title: cold_4575
4575.asset_description: A reading room in a library, with tall wooden shelves of books and other students working at the tables behind. A young woman in a beige cardigan sits at a table with an open book, a pen, her glasses and a water bottle in front of her. She presses her hand over her mouth, her eyes watering and her face screwed up, then bends forward over the table and coughs hard into her fist and into the crook of her sleeve, several times. The students behind her keep reading.

4576.title: count_4576
4576.asset_description: A large hall with long tables covered in stacks of paper. A young woman in a green sari with a lanyard sits at one table, a pen in her hand, lifting sheet after sheet off a tall stack and marking a tally sheet on a clipboard in front of her. The camera pulls back to show dozens of people down both sides of the tables doing the same, each behind their own towers of paper, with observers standing along the walls. At the end she raises a hand in the air.

4577.title: country_4577
4577.asset_description: An ink drawing on aged paper. A woman in a blue robe and a conical straw hat stands on a rocky cliff edge with her arm stretched out towards the land below her. Beneath her lies a wide valley: a patchwork of green and gold fields, a broad river winding through it, small villages of tiled roofs, and a walled town on a hill in the distance. Snow-capped mountains close the horizon, birds fly below the cliff and tall grass leans in the wind in the foreground.

4578.title: crop_4578
4578.asset_description: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.

4579.title: abroad_4579
4579.asset_description: A woman in a denim jacket sewn all over with national flag patches grins into the camera from behind a spinning school globe. The shot cuts to her in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris with both arms thrown up, then to a selfie on the back of a scooter riding past green rice terraces in Bali, then to her standing on the crest of a desert dune at sunset with her arms spread wide, and finally jumping on the dune towards the camera.

4580.title: date_4580
4580.asset_description: A cartoon of a diner with a red-and-white checked tablecloth, a jukebox and neon signs on the wall. A boy and a girl lean their heads together over one tall milkshake glass topped with whipped cream and a cherry, each drinking through their own bent straw. Their hands are joined on the table in front of the glass, both are blushing, and a pink heart-shaped balloon floats above them.

4581.title: candy_4581
4581.asset_description: A cartoon of a den built out of blankets over a sofa in a sunlit living room. Inside it a boy in a blue hoodie holds up a lit torch and points at a stack of cushions, while a girl in dungarees kneels beside him laughing with her hand at her mouth as she eats a sweet. A striped bowl heaped with wrapped and jelly sweets floats between them, with loose sweets scattered around it, under a string of paper stars and hearts. Teddy bears sit on the sofa behind.

4582.title: measure_4582
4582.asset_description: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

4583.title: calf_4583
4583.asset_description: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

4584.title: trail_4584
4584.asset_description: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.

4585.title: crossing_4585
4585.asset_description: A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.

4586.title: crosswalk_4586
4586.asset_description: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

4587.title: cyclist_4587
4587.asset_description: A man in a red jacket films himself from the handlebars as he rides. First he sits on his bike on a sandy track between green fields, looking up at a level-crossing sign against a blue sky. Then he is stopped at the edge of a village road, one hand on the handlebar, watching cars go past a traffic light. Finally he is at a big city junction under tram wires, with traffic lights, cars turning and a crowd of people waiting on the far pavement, his mouth open in surprise.

4588.title: traffic_4588
4588.asset_description: A drawing of a city street at night in heavy rain, lit pink and blue by neon buildings and glowing signs. A young man in a long black hooded coat and white trainers strides across the striped crossing in the middle of the road. Cars are stopped on both sides of him with their headlights on, and other people in raincoats walk across in front of and behind him. The wet road throws back the coloured light in long reflections and rain streaks the air.

4589.title: pedestrian_4589
4589.asset_description: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.

4590.title: vacation_4590
4590.asset_description: A cartoon of the top deck of a big white passenger ship at sunset. A woman in a pink swimsuit leaps off the edge into the deck pool and throws up a huge splash. Around the pool stand rows of red, blue and yellow sun loungers under red-and-white striped parasols on the wooden deck, and a steward in a white uniform and cap carries a tray of cocktails along it. Two striped funnels rise behind, seagulls circle, and beyond the rail the sea is turquoise with a palm island and a big orange sun on the horizon.

4591.title: ship_4591
4591.asset_description: A woman in a straw visor pulls a suitcase up a metal gangway towards an enormous white passenger ship, its many decks of balconies and its orange lifeboats filling the frame behind her. She walks along the ship's wooden promenade deck with a keycard on a lanyard, someone dives into the pool on the top deck between the two funnels, and she eats at a buffet beside the panoramic windows with green cliffs sliding past outside. At sunset she stands at the deck rail with her suitcase as the ship sails through a bay of rocky islands.

4592.title: foot_4592
4592.asset_description: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

4593.title: hospital_4593
4593.asset_description: A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.

4594.title: together_4594
4594.asset_description: A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.

4595.title: cry_4595
4595.asset_description: A young man in a green hoodie sits on a sofa in a living room at night, sobbing. His face is wet, his mouth is pulled down and his eyes are screwed up. He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.

4596.title: nose_4596
4596.asset_description: A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.

4597.title: culture_4597
4597.asset_description: A watercolour of an evening folk festival under a canopy strung with paper lanterns. Two couples in embroidered shirts and waistcoats dance in the middle of a wooden floor; the woman in front spins so hard that her striped red skirt and the coloured ribbons in her flower crown fly out around her. On the right a fiddler draws his bow, in the foreground a drummer beats a big frame drum, and market stalls hung with pottery and woven cloth stand behind, where other people clap along.

4598.title: huge_4598
4598.asset_description: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.

4599.title: payment_4599
4599.asset_description: A close-up at a market stall in low evening sun. A hand tips a small drawstring cloth pouch upside down over a scrubbed wooden counter, and coins and folded paper notes in red, green and cream pour out of it and tumble through the air. A dozen coins have already landed and lie scattered across the boards. Brass balance scales, glass jars and a wicker basket stand blurred behind.

4600.title: exchange_4600
4600.asset_description: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.

4601.title: arrange_4601
4601.asset_description: A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.

4602.title: search_4602
4602.asset_description: A fine pen-and-ink drawing of a customs hall. An open suitcase on a metal bench shows neatly folded shirts and trousers; a uniformed officer in a peaked cap holds a rolled sleeping bag up above his head and squints at it. Beside him a worried traveller in a long coat stands with her hands clasped under her chin. To the right a second officer holds a spaniel on a lead, and the dog has its front paws up on the bench with its nose towards the case. Booths, striped barriers and a turnstile fill the background.

4603.title: road_4603
4603.asset_description: A road cyclist in a teal kit and a white helmet rides down a narrow tarmac road that winds through green tropical hills. The camera holds on him from the front as he drives on the pedals, then swings to the side as he tucks low over the handlebars; behind him the road curves away with a crash barrier along its edge. He leans hard through a bend, then straightens up on a long descent with mountains and cloud filling the horizon.

4605.title: wire_4605
4605.asset_description: A comic-style illustration of a red and cream tram running along rails set into a cobbled street. Its scissor-shaped arm is pressed up against the overhead line, and a burst of yellow lightning-bolt sparks flies off where the two pieces of metal touch. More lines run across the pink sunset sky to the corners of the frame. A girl in a yellow jacket leans out of an open tram window with her blue scarf streaming behind her, pigeons flap up from the cobbles in front of the tram, and a castle and a gothic tower stand on the hill behind.

4606.title: tower_4606
4606.asset_description: A young man in an olive jacket films himself with a selfie stick as he travels. First he stands on a stone bridge at sunrise, the river orange behind him and a domed church and a tall gothic tower on the far bank. Then he stands in a crowded square looking straight up at the face of an astronomical clock set into a stone tower, with pigeons bursting into the air around it. Finally he sits in a wood-beamed beer hall, lifts a litre tankard, drinks and laughs with the men beside him.

4607.title: copper_4607
4607.asset_description: Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

4608.title: crowd_4608
4608.asset_description: A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

4610.title: dad_4610
4610.asset_description: A warm illustration set in the hallway of an old house. A little girl in a red patterned dress and pigtails comes flying down the staircase, one arm swinging a leather school satchel, the other stretched out ahead of her. At the bottom a man in a tweed jacket and tie has dropped into a crouch with both arms wide open to catch her, grinning up at her. A grandfather clock, a coat rack with hats and coats, a patterned rug and the front door fill the hall behind them.

4611.title: daughter_4611
4611.asset_description: A young girl and her mother are baking together in a bright kitchen. Their hands crack an egg into a glass bowl of flour with a whisk in it. The girl, flour on her nose, holds up a crayon drawing of her family and shows it to her mother, who beams at her. They hug tightly, the drawing still in the mother's hand. Then the girl high-fives and dances with two men in the kitchen. The clip ends with several families walking hand in hand across a sunlit park.

4612.title: sell_4612
4612.transcript: Oh, wow. For you, the best.
4612.asset_description: A busy street market. A moustached stallholder in a shirt and waistcoat stands behind a huge pyramid of peaches and holds one up to a young customer, turning it in his fingers to show it off. The customer leans in over the fruit. The vendor then piles peaches into a cardboard box and hands it across the stall. Brass hanging scales sway above the display, other stalls and shoppers fill the street behind.

4613.title: earth_4613
4613.asset_description: An allotment garden under a grey sky. An older man in a flat cap and body warmer tips a black bucket of kitchen scraps onto a heap inside a wooden compost bin: carrot tops, apples and banana skins scatter over the surface. He then works a spade into the heap and lifts up great forkfuls of dark crumbly earth, turning it over so the older, rotted material underneath comes to the top. Raised beds of cabbages and a greenhouse stand behind him.

4614.title: hang_4614
4614.asset_description: A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.

4615.title: colorful_4615
4615.asset_description: A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

4616.title: wood_4616
4616.asset_description: A pencil sketch of a misty wood. Tall bare tree trunks rise on every side and thin branches criss-cross the pale sky, with fog drifting between them. In the middle a large stag with wide branching antlers rears up over a fallen mossy log, front hooves off the ground and head thrown back, its breath steaming in the cold air. Dry leaves swirl around its legs in the wind.

4617.title: fight_4617
4617.asset_description: A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

4618.title: charge_4618
4618.asset_description: A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.

4619.title: raw_4619
4619.asset_description: A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.

4620.title: overnight_4620
4620.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of an airport terminal in the middle of the night. A young man lies stretched across a row of metal seats with one arm flung over his forehead, a backpack beside him and a wheeled suitcase parked at his feet. Behind him more stranded passengers sleep across the seats, curled up in their coats. A big round clock on the wall reads about half past four. Beyond the black glass wall, planes sit on the dark apron. A cleaner pushes a mop cart down the empty concourse and a crushed paper cup lies on the floor.

4621.title: passenger_4621
4621.asset_description: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

4622.title: sigh_4622
4622.asset_description: A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.

4623.title: vote_4623
4623.asset_description: A cartoon of an election count. A tall wooden ballot box painted in red, white and blue stripes is tipped on its side above a long wooden trestle table, and folded paper slips pour out of it onto the tabletop. A heap of the slips has already built up in the middle and more flutter through the air. Smiling officials in suits and hats stand along both sides of the table with their hands out, ready to spread the pile and sort it. Behind a rope barrier a crowd of onlookers watches, and banners hang on the brick wall above them.

4624.title: majority_4624
4624.asset_description: A photograph looking down a packed town hall with a bare wooden floor and tall windows. More than a hundred people of all ages sit on rows of plain wooden chairs, and almost every one of them has a single hand raised straight up in the air to vote. Papers rest on their laps. A long empty table with stacks of paper and three chairs faces them at the front of the room. Sunlight falls in stripes across the floorboards between the rows.

4625.title: vote_4625
4625.asset_description: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

4627.title: leave_4627
4627.asset_description: A stout older man in a flat cap and shirtsleeves waves a white handkerchief above his head, three times over. First he stands beside a city tram stop as a long white tram slides away from the kerb past him. Then he is on a station platform under the overhead wires as a red and cream train pulls out along the track. Finally he stands alone on a stone quay in the sun, waving up at an enormous white cruise ship as it moves off its berth into the deep blue sea, a lighthouse in the distance.

4628.title: sad_4628
4628.asset_description: A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.

4629.title: endless_4629
4629.asset_description: A woodcut print in ochre, orange and brown. Sand dunes roll away one behind another, their curving ridges carved in fine parallel lines, until they blur into a flat line at the horizon with no end in sight. A tiny robed figure with a walking staff is climbing one of the ridges far off, no bigger than a thumbnail against the sand. In the foreground a bleached longhorn cattle skull lies half buried in the dune. A large stylised sun hangs in the empty yellow sky above.

4630.title: haircut_4630
4630.asset_description: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

4631.title: design_4631
4631.asset_description: A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.

4632.title: workspace_4632
4632.asset_description: A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.

4633.title: desperate_4633
4633.asset_description: A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

4634.title: reach_4634
4634.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a young woman with a backpack standing at the end of a sandy coastal path, seen from behind with both arms thrown up in the air. Below and ahead of her lies a colourful seaside town of pastel houses around a turquoise bay full of small boats, with hills and a warm orange sky behind. Wildflowers grow beside the path in the foreground.

4635.title: destination_4635
4635.asset_description: A girl in a denim jacket stands in front of a torn-out photo of a lighthouse stuck on a wall and draws a circle on it with a marker, pointing at it. She is then on a train, looking out at the sea while holding the same photo. Finally she stands on a grassy clifftop at sunset and holds the photo up in front of her, lining it up with the real white lighthouse in front of her.

4636.title: lighthouse_4636
4636.asset_description: A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.

4637.title: destroy_4637
