4637.asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and a yellow high-visibility jacket stands behind a red-and-white barrier and films herself in front of a red brick building. Behind her an excavator with a large claw tears at the top floor of the building; clouds of dust rise and bricks and beams fall into a growing heap of rubble. By the end the upper part of the house has gone and she holds up her phone showing the collapse.

4638.title: rubble_4638
4638.asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.

4639.title: liquid_4639
4639.asset_description: A woodblock-style illustration of a hand tipping a dark bottle over a kitchen sink. A thick blue-green stream pours out of the bottle's neck in a smooth curve and falls into the sink, where it breaks into swirling waves and masses of white foam. A brass tap sits on the left and two patterned plates lean in the soapy water on the right.

4640.title: detergent_4640
4640.asset_description: A man opens the blue cap of a rainbow-coloured bottle in a laundry room and pours thick blue liquid from it into the measuring cap. He pulls out the drawer of a white front-loading washing machine and tips the blue liquid in, then closes the drawer and starts the machine, which we see running with washing turning inside. At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.

4641.title: diet_4641
4641.asset_description: A young man in a blue apron stands at a white kitchen counter with an open box of two chocolate doughnuts on one side and a bowl of strawberries on the other, and points away from the doughnuts. He puts out three empty plastic food containers and fills them with chicken, quinoa, sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, then stacks the filled containers into a tall tower and sets the bowl of strawberries on top.

4642.title: pit_4642
4642.asset_description: On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

4643.title: production_4643
4643.asset_description: In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.

4644.title: excuse_4644
4644.transcript: I'm so sorry. Work. Right. Sorry.
4644.asset_description: A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.

4645.title: attach_4645
4645.asset_description: Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. They press a blue ball onto each end of a short rod to make a dumbbell shape, drop a red ball into a green cup piece, and push finished pieces down into the holes of the tray. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.

4646.title: divorce_4646
4646.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a wooden table seen close up. Two gold wedding rings lie on the bare tabletop. A large hand on the right has just set one ring down and is drawing back from it, while a second hand reaches in from the left towards the other ring. Behind them a city skyline is sketched in soft grey.

4647.title: spin_4647
4647.asset_description: In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

4648.title: examine_4648
4648.asset_description: An illustration of a consulting room in which a woman in a white coat crouches in front of a small boy sitting on the examination couch. She holds the disc of her stethoscope against his chest and rests her other hand on his head while she listens; the boy holds a teddy bear and looks worried. Behind them are an eye chart, a shapes chart, a lamp and a glass cabinet of bottles; a reflex hammer and a lollipop lie on a metal tray in front.

4649.title: teddy_4649
4649.asset_description: An illustration of a small boy in a striped jumper and jeans sitting on a green examination couch, hugging a brown plush teddy bear against his chest with both arms. A man in a white coat leans over him and holds a stethoscope to the boy's chest while resting a hand on his head. In the room there is a glass cabinet of medicine bottles, a fern on top of it, and a second stethoscope, a lollipop and instruments on the counter in front.

4650.title: reaction_4650
4650.asset_description: In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.

4651.title: marine_4651
4651.asset_description: A soft watercolour painting of the open sea at sunset. A grey bottlenose dolphin arcs through the air above the water, its body dripping, with a second dolphin breaking the surface just behind it. Below, green-blue waves catch the golden light and white spray rises where the dolphins left the water. The sky is peach and pink, with a low dark coastline on the horizon.

4652.title: compete_4652
4652.asset_description: At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.

4653.title: mud_4653
4653.asset_description: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

4654.title: doubt_4654
4654.asset_description: In a bright flat a woman stares hard at a wooden shelf that has just been screwed to the white wall, her brow furrowed and her mouth twisted in disbelief. Behind her a man holding a screwdriver smiles and gestures at his work. She raises a white mug, edges it slowly onto the shelf and lets go, watching to see if it holds. The shelf holds the mug; she steps back, folds her arms and looks at it sideways, still unconvinced.

4655.title: dress_4655
4655.asset_description: In a sunlit bedroom a bare-chested young man picks up a light blue shirt and pulls it on. He fastens the buttons one by one down the front, then swings a navy suit jacket over his shoulders and pushes his arms into the sleeves. He knots and straightens a dark tie at his collar, tugs the jacket into place, and finally stands in front of a mirror in the full suit, adjusting the tie one last time.

4656.title: mount_4656
4656.asset_description: A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

4657.title: drink_4657
4657.asset_description: In a busy covered street market a woman in an orange vest top sips iced tea from a clear plastic cup through a straw, her cheeks pulling in as she draws the liquid up. She then holds a whole green coconut in both hands and drinks from the straw pushed into its top, tipping it towards her mouth. Finally she lifts a plastic water bottle high, puts it to her lips and swallows in long gulps, then lowers it and breathes out, smiling.

4658.title: drive_4658
4658.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from inside an open-topped vintage car: two tanned hands hold the thin black steering wheel while the car rolls down a narrow cobbled village street between whitewashed houses with people walking ahead. The road opens onto a coastal highway with the blue sea and cliffs on the left, and the wheel turns as the car follows the bends. The camera then shows the driver herself, a woman in a colourful shirt and sunglasses, one hand on the wheel, looking out at the ocean as she drives along the clifftop road.

4659.title: car_4659
4659.asset_description: A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

4660.title: pile_4660
4660.asset_description: In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.

4661.title: fall_4661
4661.asset_description: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

4662.title: supply_4662
4662.asset_description: A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

4663.title: drop_4663
4663.asset_description: A pastel cartoon in soft pinks and greens. A hand in a blue sleeve squeezes the pink rubber bulb of a glass pipette held above a child's forehead. A single large rounded bead of clear liquid has just left the glass tube and hangs in the air, catching the light, with a smaller one still forming at the tip. Below it the child tilts her face up with her eyes shut tight and her mouth pursed, waiting for it to land. A labelled glass bottle stands on a shelf behind them.

4664.title: dose_4664
4664.asset_description: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

4665.title: accident_4665
4665.asset_description: A run of small mishaps, one after another. A black phone lies face down on a wooden kitchen floor where it has just landed. On a city pavement a girl holds an ice cream cone with only half a scoop left, the rest of it splattered pink on the ground beside her feet. In an office a woman in a blue blouse throws up her hands in panic as a whole file of white papers flies out of her arms and scatters through the air. In a kitchen a man's plastic bag splits and oranges, peaches and a jar roll out across the tiled floor. Finally a watermelon bursts open on a market street, pink flesh and juice sprayed in a wide splash, while shoppers jump back with their hands over their mouths.

4666.title: smash_4666
4666.asset_description: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

4667.title: plane_4667
4667.asset_description: Seen from directly below, a small white and red propeller aeroplane passes low across a clear blue sky and lets a wooden crate fall from underneath it. The crate floats down on a rainbow parachute into open green grassland, where a woman in a striped robe runs up laughing to take it. The aircraft banks and comes round again, its wings and propellers clear against the sky, dropping a line of further crates under coloured parachutes. It flies over a settlement of white round tents while villagers and horses gather in the grass and a woman spreads her arms wide beneath the falling loads.

4668.title: smell_4668
4668.asset_description: On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.

4669.title: laundry_4669
4669.asset_description: A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.

4670.title: roof_4670
4670.asset_description: Evening light over an Italian city. A young woman in a white dress stands on the flat roof terrace of an apartment block and hangs washing on lines strung across it. The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.

4671.title: machine_4671
4671.asset_description: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

4672.title: reed_4672
4672.asset_description: A woodblock-style illustration of a pond. A brown duck with an orange bill and orange webbed feet drops down onto the water with its wings spread, throwing up a tall white splash and rings of ripples. Two yellow ducklings paddle nearby. Both edges of the picture are filled with tall green reeds and broad water-plant leaves rising straight out of the shallow water, with hills and clouds behind.

4673.title: weak_4673
4673.asset_description: A black-and-white cartoon in an old gym. A skinny character with thin rubber-hose arms and legs tries to lift one huge dumbbell in one gloved hand. The weight drags his arm and shoulder down, his knees buckle, his face is screwed up and drops of sweat fly off his head. Racks of barbells and dumbbells and a much bigger dumbbell lying on the floor fill the room around him.

4674.title: shelf_4674
4674.asset_description: An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.

4675.title: careful_4675
4675.asset_description: A black-and-white cartoon of an Amsterdam canal street. A wide-eyed young man in a coat and a striped scarf races over the hump of a cobbled canal bridge on an old bicycle, so fast that both wheels have left the ground and he is flying. A wooden crate of tulips is strapped to the back rack and the flowers and petals are shooting out behind him. Tall gabled houses, parked bicycles chained to the railing and a houseboat on the canal fill the background.

4676.title: tradition_4676
4676.asset_description: A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.

4678.title: eat_4678
4678.asset_description: A run of close-up shots of different people eating. A bearded man bites into a dripping cheeseburger in a fast-food restaurant; a woman lifts a mouthful of ramen noodles out of a bowl with chopsticks and sucks them in; a man in a canteen forks food off a plate of fried fish, chips and salad; a boy with curly hair takes a bite out of an enormous triple cheeseburger held in both hands.

4679.title: delicious_4679
4679.asset_description: A young man in a turquoise T-shirt and a backwards cap sits at a metal counter in a busy taqueria, with cooks working behind him. Two tacos sit on paper in front of him. He bites into a folded taco, chews with his eyes closed and his eyebrows raised, licks the sauce off his fingers, eats the second one, and finally sits back with his hand on his chest over an empty paper smeared with red sauce.

4680.title: rider_4680
4680.asset_description: A photograph in the desert at Giza. A blonde woman with a beige scarf wrapped round her head and a loose linen shirt is climbing onto the back of a camel that is kneeling in the sand. She grips the wooden pommel of the leather saddle with both hands and swings one booted leg over the animal's back, kicking up a cloud of dust. Behind her stand the three great pyramids and the Sphinx in the dusty haze.

4681.title: lamp_4681
4681.asset_description: A traveller films herself through a trip in Egypt. First she rides a camel in front of the pyramids with a scarf over her hair. Then she walks through a covered bazaar where hundreds of coloured mosaic-glass lamps hang from the ceiling and the walls, glowing red, blue, orange and green; she reaches up, takes hold of a big blue glass lamp and turns it in her hand, laughing. Finally she stands on the deck of a wooden sailing boat at sunset with her arms spread wide.

4682.title: trader_4682
4682.asset_description: A photograph in an old stone-arched spice market. A young man in a striped galabeya stands behind his open sacks of goods and pours bright orange-yellow turmeric from a big brass scoop into a sack heaped with the same powder, catching the falling stream with his other hand. Around him are more sacks with neat cones of red, yellow and orange spice, dried herbs and ginger root, with brass lanterns and a carved wooden screen behind.

4683.title: rice_4683
4683.asset_description: A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.

4684.title: elbow_4684
4684.asset_description: In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

4685.title: repair_4685
4685.asset_description: A comic-style illustration on a building site. A young workman in a yellow hard hat sits on a metal stepladder in front of an open grey fuse box on a wooden wall, with a small screwdriver held in his teeth. He holds red-handled pliers in one gloved hand and a bundle of cut red, green and blue wires in the other, and looks up at the row of circuit breakers he is working on. Coils of cable hang over his shoulder and lie on the floor, with a tool belt on his hip and a work light behind him.

4686.title: repair_4686
4686.asset_description: A dark flat with no power. A woman in a yellow hard hat with a headlamp stands at a wall panel, holding a pair of pliers and a bundle of coloured wires. Close-ups show gloved hands stripping a red wire and pushing it into a circuit breaker set into a broken-open wall box. A family stands in the dark hallway behind her lighting the corridor with phone torches. She works at the fuse panel, then turns to the camera smiling as the flat lights come back on.

4687.title: embassy_4687
4687.asset_description: Dusk in a European city, seen through the bars of a tall black iron gate. Behind the gate stands a lit stone building with arched windows and a flag on a pole above the entrance. A woman in a beige trench coat stands at the gate and hands a stack of cream-coloured document envelopes through to a man in a dark uniform and peaked cap. A parked car and lamplit street are visible behind her.

4688.title: massive_4688
4688.asset_description: Two young men in yellow raincoats lean over the wooden rail of a small boat on a calm blue sea. A dark shape the length of the boat glides just under the surface beneath them. It blows a tall column of spray, then a barnacled humpback whale pushes its head and long ribbed throat up out of the water right beside the hull, rising higher than the men before sliding back down.

4689.title: boat_4689
4689.asset_description: A young man in a yellow raincoat leans over the varnished wooden rail of a small boat, an orange life ring hanging beside him. The water is grey-green and snow-covered mountains stand on the far shore. A dark shape rises under the surface and a barnacled humpback whale lifts its head out of the water alongside the hull. The whale slips back down and leaves a wide swirl of white foam turning on the water next to the boat.

4690.title: workplace_4690
4690.asset_description: A drawn open-plan office. A young man in a blue jumper with an ID card on a lanyard sits at a wooden desk in a cubicle and types on a laptop. A steaming mug of coffee, a potted plant and an open notebook sit on the desk; the cubicle wall behind him is a cork board with sticky notes and a printed sheet. Sunlight comes through a big window on the left. Behind him more people sit at their own desks with computers, under a wall clock and shelves of files.

4691.title: colleague_4691
4691.asset_description: A young man in a mustard jumper with a backpack and an ID card on a lanyard walks in through the glass entrance turnstile of an office building, smiling. In the open-plan office a bearded man carrying files walks up to him and they greet each other with a handshake and a clap on the arm. The young man then sits down at a desk in a long row of desks and works at a computer; other people are typing at desks around and behind him.

4692.title: product_4692
4692.asset_description: In a supermarket a worker in a green polo shirt and apron reaches into a cardboard box full of drink cans standing on the floor by a cold room door. He carries the cans to the aisle and lines them up on a shelf already packed with rows of colourful tins and cans. He straightens the front row so all the labels face out, then picks up the empty flattened box and walks off down the aisle between the full shelves.

4693.title: hire_4693
4693.asset_description: A painted scene in a corner office at sunset. A confident man in a grey suit and tie stands behind a big wooden desk, one hand on the desktop, and leans forward to shake hands with a younger man in a brown jacket who sits with his back to us in the visitor's chair. A signed folder, papers and a telephone lie on the desk between them. Through the wide window behind him is a city skyline with traffic in the streets below.

4694.title: contract_4694
4694.asset_description: In a bright office a woman with short white hair in a blue suit leans over a desk and spreads a printed document on a clipboard in front of a young man in a suit, pointing at the line where he has to sign. He takes a pen and signs it. They stand up, she puts a hand on his shoulder and they shake hands while the staff at the desks behind clap. At the end she leads him to a free desk with a small box marked Welcome on it, and the whole office applauds.

4695.title: chaos_4695
4695.asset_description: In a flat with a parquet floor a man lifts the body of a plastic bin off a full bin bag, then tips a cardboard box of odds and ends into a bigger box on the floor. He pulls a metal drawer out of a cabinet and empties that in too. By the end the whole living room floor is buried under a spreading heap of toys, boxed games, plastic tubs and building blocks, and he stands behind the emptied cabinet holding it, mouth open at the state of the room.

4696.title: encourage_4696
4696.asset_description: In a climbing gym an older woman with glasses chalks her hands and takes hold of a red grip on a bouldering wall. A group of young climbers stands on the mats below her, shouting up at her, punching the air and clapping. She pulls herself off the ground and works her way up the overhanging wall while they keep cheering, raising their arms and applauding as she reaches high above them.

4697.title: start_4697
4697.asset_description: A stark black, white and yellow illustration of a sprinter in the first instant of a race. He is driving out of the starting blocks in a packed floodlit stadium, front knee still on the track, back leg extended, one arm thrown up. A burst of yellow light and jagged lightning bolts explodes from the blocks where his foot pushes off, and white lines streak backwards along the lanes behind him. A spotlight beams down and the crowd is a silhouette in the stands.

4698.title: motor_4698
4698.asset_description: A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.

4699.title: machinery_4699
4699.asset_description: A painted factory interior. A man in a yellow hard hat, safety glasses and a work jacket stands in the foreground holding a clipboard with a technical drawing on it and points upwards with his other hand. Behind and above him rises a wall of old industrial machines: a giant toothed gearwheel on a shaft, riveted drums and pipes, round pressure gauges with coloured dials, control panels with buttons, and steel walkways, with steam drifting up between them.

4700.title: robot_4700
4700.asset_description: In a bright electronics lab a young man in glasses fits a black gripper onto the end of a jointed robotic arm bolted to the bench next to circuit boards and cables. He sits down at a sticker-covered laptop and types, watching the arm. The arm swings round on its own and holds out a white mug; he takes it, laughs and drinks from it, and two colleagues at the benches behind him raise their arms and cheer.

4701.title: ruin_4701
4701.asset_description: A young man in a bucket hat kneels on the wet sand beside a tall, carefully carved sandcastle with towers, battlements and arched gates; kite surfers are out on the sea behind him. The surf runs in around the base of the castle. Each wave eats away more of it: first the outer walls slump, then the towers collapse one after another, until only a shapeless lump of wet sand and one small stump are left in the foam, and he sits back on his heels looking at it.

4702.title: escape_4702
4702.asset_description: A brown and white goat pushes its head out between the boards of a wooden gate in a barn pen where other goats are standing. It works its horns and shoulders through the gap and squeezes its whole body out of the pen. Outside, a farmer in a straw hat lunges for it past a row of feed sacks but misses, and the goat gallops off down a red dirt track between rows of olive trees, growing smaller as it runs away.

4703.title: raise_4703
4703.asset_description: A man in a navy suit and a white hard hat presses a carved wooden sign into place above the door of a new stone building, then pulls a cord to drop the cloth covering beside it. Outside on the steps he hauls on a halyard and pulls a green flag up a tall white flagpole while a crowd of people in suits and hard hats claps and two drummers play. He then cuts a teal ribbon stretched across the steps and the crowd applauds.

4704.title: hat_4704
4704.asset_description: A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.

4705.title: band_4705
4705.asset_description: A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

4706.title: shout_4706
4706.asset_description: A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.

4707.title: patient_4707
4707.transcript: Look up, say uh-uh. - Uh. - All good?
4707.asset_description: A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.

4708.title: guide_4708
4708.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a dirt track winding through vineyards and olive trees towards a little chapel with cypresses on a hill. A cream and orange minibus is stopped at the roadside with its door folded open. A boy in a straw hat and backpack jumps down from the step with his arms out, another boy in a yellow shirt points up the track, and a woman in a green dress runs after them with a wicker picnic basket and a camera. Ahead of them on the track a man in a white shirt with a lanyard holds a wooden paddle high above his head so the group can see where to follow, and a second picnic hamper stands on the ground by the bus.

4709.title: group_4709
4709.asset_description: A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.

4710.title: arm_4710
4710.asset_description: Three people work out together on a path in a green park. An older woman in a bright red tracksuit stands in the middle between a young woman in a mint jacket and a young man in a grey hoodie. All three stretch both arms straight up over their heads with their palms open, then jog on the spot swinging their arms bent at the elbow, then swing both arms wide out to the sides at shoulder height. They keep smiling at the camera while other walkers and a dog pass under the fresh green trees behind them.

4711.title: effort_4711
4711.asset_description: A rower drives a narrow single scull across flat water in a navy racing suit. He hauls both oars through the stroke with his arms and shoulders straining, teeth bared and forehead screwed up. The camera closes in until only his face fills the frame: eyes squeezed shut, cheeks tight, mouth open and gasping, skin shining with sweat, hair stuck to his forehead. A line of spectators stands on the far bank under a blue sky.

4712.title: blow_4712
4712.asset_description: A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.

4713.title: goodbye_4713
4713.asset_description: On a stone quay in an old harbour, two men in black overcoats and flat caps hand a heavy brown leather suitcase down to a white haired old man in a long dark coat as he steps into a small wooden rowing boat. Along the harbour wall a line of villagers in headscarves, shawls and old fashioned coats stand pressed together with their hands lifted, waving at him. The boat pushes off and is rowed out of the harbour; the camera holds on it as it gets smaller and smaller on the flat grey sea until it is only a dark speck on the horizon.

4714.title: expert_4714
4714.asset_description: An elderly man in a tweed waistcoat and bow tie sits at a table in a hall full of onlookers, handling a painted porcelain vase in white cotton gloves. He lifts it up and tips it to look at its base, then screws a small brass eyeglass into his eye socket and studies the flowers painted on the side from a few centimetres away, turning the vase slowly in his gloved hands. He sets it down on the table, looks up at the couple sitting opposite and tells them what he has found while the crowd of older visitors behind him leans in, mouths open.

4715.title: watermelon_4715
4715.asset_description: A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.

4716.title: explore_4716
4716.asset_description: A man with a headlamp, a khaki shirt and a backpack pushes his way through thick jungle, ducking under hanging vines and climbing over roots on a muddy path, looking around him all the time. He then wades along a dark dripping rock tunnel with only his headlamp lighting the walls. He comes out on a wet boulder at the mouth of a cave: sunbeams cut down through the opening onto a turquoise pool with a tall waterfall pouring into it. He stands on the rock, machete in one hand, and throws his arms wide, staring up at what he has found.

4717.title: dark_4717
4717.asset_description: A man with a headlamp pushes between huge elephant ear leaves in a green jungle, then the picture goes almost completely black: nothing can be seen except the white glare of his headlamp and a faint outline of his face and shirt. He crouches in the blackness beside a wet rock wall, the small beam picking out drips and stones a metre in front of him. He walks on through the black tunnel towards a bright opening at the far end, a silhouette against the light, and steps out onto a boulder in front of a wide waterfall falling into a turquoise pool, where he spreads his arms and looks up.

4718.title: eye_4718
4718.asset_description: An extreme close up fills the screen with one brown eye: the white, the ring of brown around the black centre, the reflections of the ceiling lights and the long lashes above and below. A thumb comes in and gently pulls the upper lid open wider. An optician holds a small black torch beside the eye and shines it in, and the brown ring lights up amber while the black centre shrinks. The shot pulls back to show a young woman smiling in an optician's shop with walls of spectacle frames behind her, and finally the optician holds up a big cut through model of an eyeball beside her while she points at it and talks.

4719.title: chin_4719
4719.asset_description: A soft painted portrait of a young person filling the whole frame from the top of the head to the base of the neck. They have tousled mid brown hair, thick dark eyebrows, large brown eyes with small white highlights, pink cheeks and a small closed lipped smile. Below the mouth the rounded chin and the line of the jaw stand out clearly against the pale neck, and behind them is a blurred wash of green meadow and blue sky.

4720.title: funny_4720
4720.asset_description: A group of teenagers crowd a phone held at arm's length in a bright classroom and take turns pulling faces into it. A girl with curly hair pushes her lips out in a fish pout and rolls her eyes sideways. A boy in glasses shoves his face right up to the lens, then grins with his mouth wide open. A girl with rainbow braids stares with her eyes stretched as wide as they go and her lips pushed forward. At the end the three of them squeeze their heads together and burst out laughing at the camera, mouths wide open, one of them showing her braces, while classmates work at the desks behind.

4721.title: fade_4721
4721.asset_description: A woman in a soaking wet orange hooded raincoat films herself on a grassy hillside above a lake, grinning and pointing back over her shoulder at a full rainbow arching right across the grey sky. She turns to look at it, and second by second the colours grow weaker: first the left hand side thins out, then only a short faint band is left low on the right, and then the sky is empty and grey. She keeps standing there in the wet grass looking at the place where it was.

4722.title: sunglasses_4722
4722.asset_description: An outdoor garden party on a lawn, with a floral arch, string lights and a cream sofa behind. Guests in summer dresses and pale suits stand in a group; several of the women wear dark sunglasses. One by one the women swoon and sag at the knees while the others grab them under the arms and hold them up. A man in a beige suit fans himself with a white plate. By the end everyone is lying on the grass and on cushions, still fanning themselves with plates.

4723.title: fall_4723
4723.asset_description: An indoor trampoline park with a huge pit of coloured foam cubes. A man in orange shorts lies half buried in the cubes, laughing. Others run to the edge and drop off it, dropping through the air into the pit and disappearing under the blocks. More people leap in one after another, landing on their backs and sides among the foam, until several of them are lying in the pit surrounded by scattered cubes.

4724.title: laugh_4724
4724.asset_description: A woman in black sportswear at a trampoline park. She sits in a pit of red, blue, yellow and green foam cubes with her mouth wide open, laughing hard. She climbs out, walks along the ledge, then jumps back in and lands among the blocks, still laughing with her eyes screwed shut. At the end two women lie side by side in the foam pit laughing together.

4725.title: pizza_4725
4725.asset_description: A sunlit farmhouse kitchen where three generations make pizza together. A man stretches a disc of dough in the air while a small boy presses his own ball of dough on the floured worktop and a grandmother rolls out another with a wooden rolling pin. Then a woman and a man carry two finished margherita pizzas out of the oven. The scene moves outside at night to a long table under string lights, where a steaming margherita is set down in front of the whole family and everyone clinks glasses of red wine over the food.

4726.title: farmer_4726
4726.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap, checked shirt and rubber boots works his vegetable plot at sunset beside a sunflower field. He bends down and pulls carrots out of the dark soil by their green tops, then throws handfuls of grain out across a freshly seeded bed. He carries a wooden crate along the rows while a dog runs past, and finally stands behind a wooden hand cart loaded with cabbages, marrows and a crate of carrots, smiling and giving a thumbs up.

4727.title: father_4727
4727.asset_description: A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.

4728.title: sleep_4728
4728.asset_description: A woman in blue medical scrubs comes home through her front door at the end of a shift, hanging her keys in a bowl. She yawns hugely with her eyes screwed shut, peels off her grey jacket and drops her bag, yawning again and rubbing her face with her hand. She staggers to the sofa and drops onto it sideways, and the clip ends with her lying asleep on the cushions with her eyes closed and her phone beside her.

4729.title: afraid_4729
4729.asset_description: Two young women walk through a dark haunted-house corridor at a funfair, hung with fake cobwebs and strings of coloured lights. They cling to each other with their eyes wide and their mouths open, edging forward. A masked figure in a white mask appears in the corridor behind them and they bolt, running towards the camera through a black curtain. They burst out into the daylight of the fairground, still gripping each other's hands, panting with their hands pressed to their chests.

4730.title: committee_4730
4730.asset_description: A photograph taken from above of nine people in business suits seated around a large round wooden conference table in a formal wood-panelled room. Small national flags of different countries stand on the table in front of empty places, each beside a folder and a sheet of paper. The nine lean in from all sides of the table and stack their hands together in the middle, talking as they do it, while a loose sheet of paper falls through the air over the table.

4731.title: nation_4731
4731.asset_description: A flag-raising ceremony outside a large curved glass building. A woman in a grey uniform suit hauls on a rope and a flag climbs its pole above her. The shot widens to a long line of women in the same grey suits, each raising a different national flag on a white pole, so that the flags of many countries rise together in a row. Rows of officials in dark suits stand watching in silence, and the final shots show the whole semicircle of flagpoles in front of the glass facade with a large flag flying at the centre.

4732.title: build_4732
4732.asset_description: A man in a work shirt builds a wooden fence across a sunny back garden. He holds a squared timber post upright, then screws a horizontal rail into it with a cordless drill. He knocks a post into place with a yellow rubber mallet along a run of fence that already carries rows of vertical palings, checks the top rail with a spirit level, and works along a string line pegged into the fresh soil. At the end the finished fence runs the full length of the lawn and he leans over the top of it and smiles.

4733.title: temperature_4733
4733.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a boy lying ill in bed. He is propped on a pillow under a checked quilt with a glass thermometer in his mouth and a folded blue cloth laid across his forehead. His cheeks and nose are painted bright red and orange wavy lines rise from his head to show the heat coming off him. A lamp glows on the wooden bedside table beside the bed.

4734.title: care_4734
4734.asset_description: A young woman lies ill on a sofa under a thick grey blanket in a lamp-lit living room, her face flushed red and a thermometer in her mouth. An older woman sits beside her, holds the thermometer steady and reads a second one, frowning at the number. She puts a hand on the young woman's forehead to feel how hot she is, then lays a folded damp cloth across it and smooths it into place, staying at her side the whole time.

4735.title: punch_4735
4735.asset_description: Soldiers in camouflage uniforms train in hand-to-hand combat on a churned muddy field under a grey sky. A woman in uniform drives blow after blow with her gloved fists into a black padded shield held up by a man in front of her. He then grabs her from behind around the chest and they grapple, stumbling in the mud. Around them dozens of other soldiers do the same drill in pairs on grey mats laid over the mud, and at the end she stands close to camera throwing punches into the air, breathing hard.

4736.title: army_4736
4736.asset_description: A large group of soldiers in matching camouflage uniforms train together on sand and black mats under a grey sky. In the foreground a woman in uniform with her hair in a tight bun hits a black padded shield held by a comrade, her gloved fists up in a guard. Behind her rows of other uniformed soldiers work in pairs across the whole ground, and one lifts another clean off her feet and throws her over her shoulder onto the mats. The clip ends on the woman still punching, with dozens more soldiers drilling behind her.

4737.title: jug_4737
4737.asset_description: A sunny tropical back garden by a pool. A woman in swimwear holds a tall glass under a brass garden tap and lets the water run into it until it brims over. She then tips a grey metal jug with a curved handle and pours a long stream of water from it into a rainbow-striped watering can, and pours another jug of water into a big black bucket. Finally she stands over a blue inflatable paddling pool and fills it with a green garden hose while friends on sun loungers behind her cheer and raise their arms.

4738.title: everywhere_4738
4738.asset_description: A young woman kneels on the tiled floor of a small hostel room with bunk beds and digs frantically through a black backpack, pulling out handfuls of clothes and throwing them behind her. She lifts the mattress and pillow of the lower bunk and pushes her head under the bed frame to look underneath. A wide shot shows the whole room afterwards: clothes, caps and shoes lie scattered over the entire floor, from the door to the window, with almost no bare tiles left. She then sits in the middle of the scattered clothes holding a red passport, stares at it open-mouthed, and finally hugs it to her chest and laughs.

4739.title: discover_4739
4739.asset_description: A woman in a mustard cardigan with round sunglasses pushed up on her head leans over a second-hand stall in a busy street market, with lit shop fronts and passers-by behind her. She rummages through a heap of old objects piled on a wooden crate: cloth, hardback books, old film cameras, a brass jug and a mosaic lamp. She pulls a dark wooden case out of the pile, sets it down and opens the lid, and her mouth falls open: inside, on red velvet, lies an enormous cut diamond. She lifts it out with both hands and holds it up in front of the open case, grinning.

4740.title: wound_4740
4740.asset_description: A grey, overcast roadside scene drawn in comic style. A young man in a beanie and fingerless gloves kneels on the cracked tarmac and holds the forearm of a second person who is sitting in front of him wearing a cycling helmet and torn trousers. The second person's elbow and forearm are grazed open and bleeding red. The kneeling man holds up a sterile wipe packet he has just torn open; the empty wrapper flies away in the air behind him. An open green first-aid tin sits on the ground with rolls of gauze, plasters and scissors spilling out of it, a loose bandage roll unwinding across the tarmac. A bicycle lies on its side in the background and a figure watches from a distance.

4741.title: pull_4741
4741.asset_description: A young man in yellow waterproof dungarees stands in a small blue and orange wooden fishing boat on open sea below green cliffs. He leans right back with both hands on a fishing rod that is bent almost double, dragging the line up out of the water until a large silver fish breaks the surface on the hook and swings over the side of the boat. He then works a round landing net, hauling it up out of the water and swinging it in over a wooden crate on the deck, where several silver fish are already lying. At the end he lifts the full crate up towards the camera with both hands and grins.

4742.title: strong_4742
4742.asset_description: An outdoor bootcamp session on a grass field at golden hour, with pull-up bars, mats and kettlebells set out and a trainer and other athletes working in the background. A woman in a dark red sports bra and leggings, with visible arm and stomach muscles, swings two heavy battle ropes up and down with both arms, her jaw set. She then swings a large black kettlebell up between her legs with both hands, breathing hard. Finally she jumps up onto a tall wooden plyo box, lands on top of it, straightens up with her arms thrown open and shouts in triumph while the trainer claps behind her.

4743.title: flight_4743
4743.asset_description: A young man with headphones round his neck films himself in a window seat of an airliner. In the first shot the plane is racing along the ground past green fields and low houses outside the window and he grins into the camera as it lifts off. The shot cuts to cruising altitude at sunset: the wing and engine are lit orange above a floor of cloud, and he holds up a plastic cup of orange juice from the drinks trolley that a crew member is pushing past behind him. In the last shots it is night, and through the window a whole coastal city glows in orange lines of street lights far below as the plane descends; he turns from the window and claps his hands together with delight.

4744.title: relax_4744
4744.asset_description: A pale turquoise salt lake with bare desert hills behind it. A woman in an orange swimsuit and a wide straw sun hat lies on her back on the surface of the water, arms spread out, not sinking, with a yellow rubber duck bobbing at her shoulder. Behind her three more people lie on their backs in a row in the same way, two of them with their hands folded behind their heads and their eyes closed. The woman drifts, then opens a glossy magazine and holds it up above her face and reads it while she is still lying flat on the water, her feet sticking up at the front of the shot.

4745.title: flow_4745
4745.asset_description: A boy in a green t-shirt crouches on a bank of round pebbles beside a clear turquoise mountain river and sets a small white paper boat down on the water. The current takes it at once: the boat is carried out from the shallow pebbly edge into the deeper green water and moves steadily away downstream, turning slowly as the surface ripples past it. The camera follows it as it travels the length of the reach and passes under the arch of an old stone bridge, with white rapids visible upstream beyond the bridge, until the boy is left standing on the grassy bank watching it go.

4746.title: photographer_4746
4746.asset_description: A viewing spot at the end of an airport runway under a bright blue sky, with a row of parked airliners on the apron behind. Two men stand on a low concrete wall with big white telephoto lenses on tripods, one crouched behind his camera with his eye to the viewfinder, tracking a jumbo jet as it comes in to land; a third watches beside them. A young man with bleached hair in a denim jacket leans back in the foreground filming himself and staring straight up. The aircraft passes directly overhead, so low that its whole underside, four engines and lowered landing gear fill the frame, while the photographers swing their lenses up to follow it and the man raises one finger and points at it.

4747.title: seagull_4747
4747.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap and a dark knitted cardigan stands at the stern rail of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus at dusk, with the wake churning white behind him and a domed mosque and the city skyline on the shore. He holds a torn piece of bread in one hand and holds crumbs out in the other. One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.

4748.title: cloud_4748
4748.asset_description: A steady shot filmed through an aircraft window in flight. The white wing with its upturned winglet cuts across the frame against a deep blue sky. Below it, white masses of water vapour drift past far above the ground: at first scattered puffs with fields and roads visible in the gaps between them, then thicker banks, and by the end an unbroken white layer stretching to the horizon so that the land is completely hidden and only the flat white top and the blue sky above it can be seen.

4749.title: formation_4749
4749.asset_description: A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.

4750.title: clothes_4750
4750.asset_description: A woman in pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair kneels on a wide white bed in a high-rise flat and folds washing. She holds up a tie-dye t-shirt, lays it flat and folds it, then folds a grey lace top. A wicker basket of clean washing sits beside her. The folded items grow into neat stacks, and by the end the whole bed is walled in by tall towers of folded clothes in every colour.

4751.title: guide_4751
4751.asset_description: A woman in an orange jumper films herself while holding a yellow umbrella high above her head so the group behind her can see it. She walks backwards down a narrow cobbled lane between yellow and white houses, and a small group of visitors follows her. She leads them past a yellow tram on rails, along a busy street with more people trailing behind, and turns back to smile at them while a stray dog trots alongside.

4752.title: failure_4752
4752.asset_description: A young man in a white apron is baking in a bright kitchen. He looks worried at the hob, where a pale pancake sits in a frying pan and he prods it with a spatula. He pulls on black oven gloves and opens the oven, which glows orange inside. He lifts out a baking tray of biscuits that have come out completely black and cracked, holds it up, and leans over it with his face screwed up in disappointment.

4753.title: forgive_4753
4753.asset_description: Two young men stand on a suburban pavement beside a low brick wall with a road bike leaning against it. One in a navy hoodie stands with his arms folded tight and his jaw set, refusing to look up. The other, in black with a takeaway coffee cup, leans on the wall and talks to him steadily. The folded arms drop, the first one looks down and half-smiles, and the two step together into a long hug over the wall.

4754.title: protest_4754
4754.asset_description: An amateur football match on a worn grass pitch. A player in a dark maroon kit shoulder-barges a player in white off the ball and the white player goes down. The female referee in black points sharply at the offender. He turns to her with both palms raised, arguing and pleading that he did nothing. She raises a yellow card above her head; he keeps talking at her with his hands open, then walks off grimacing.

4755.title: fracture_4755
4755.transcript: I'll show you this. Oh, I see.
4755.asset_description: In a clinic a doctor in a white coat stands at a lit X-ray viewer showing the bones of a hand and wrist. She points a pen at a thin dark line running across one of the bones. The young man beside her leans in and looks at the line on the film. He then sits back with his forearm in a thick white plaster cast held up in a blue sling, winces, and holds the casted arm against his chest.

4756.title: france_4756
4756.asset_description: A woman with a red scarf rides a bicycle along a paved riverside path with a long baguette sticking out of the front wicker basket; the Eiffel Tower and a stone bridge over the river fill the background. She then walks between rows of a purple lavender field at dusk with her arms out, turning to laugh at the sky. Finally she sits under the red awning of a pavement cafe at sunset, biting into a croissant with crumbs on the paper in front of her.

4757.title: freedom_4757
4757.asset_description: A teenager in a plaid shirt leaps down a flight of stone steps outside a big brick building with both arms flung wide and his mouth open in a shout. He vaults over a metal farm gate onto a country lane at golden hour. He rides a bicycle down an empty road through open fields with both hands off the bars and his arms stretched out to the sides. At the end he stands with the bike on a grassy hilltop above a wide valley, tips his head back to the setting sun and throws his arms open.

4758.title: full_4758
4758.asset_description: A man in a cream sweater opens a tall fridge-freezer in a bright white kitchen and looks at completely bare shelves. The camera drops to an empty freezer drawer holding only one ice-cube tray. Then hands start loading the shelves: bags of frozen vegetables and berries, tubs, boxes and packets, until every shelf and drawer is packed. The last shot is a wide of the double doors open on a fridge stuffed from top to bottom while the man beams at it.

4759.title: baker_4759
4759.asset_description: Rows of pale baguettes on a wire rack slide out of a glowing bakery oven. Trays of croissants and pains au chocolat are pushed into a shop window while a crowd in winter coats watches from the wet Paris street outside. A man in a shirt and a flour-smeared apron picks up a baguette, holds it to his ear like a telephone, then turns to the camera grinning and holds it up in front of the bakery door.

4760.title: share_4760
4760.asset_description: On a sunlit cobbled street in Lisbon two teenagers stand face to face with a single ice cream cone between them; he hands it across to her and they slap hands. They then run together along the rails after a yellow tram. The scene cuts to a wooden jetty at sunset where a group of friends dance, then pull into one tight huddle with their arms around each other, silhouetted against the low sun.

4761.title: bacon_4761
4761.asset_description: On a frozen lake under a low winter sun a man in an orange hooded parka cooks breakfast on a small portable gas stove. A single egg fries in a black pan; he lays strips of streaky bacon in beside it and they curl and brown. The shot widens to a large flat pan holding rows of bacon rashers around a heap of fried potato chunks and two fried eggs, which he lifts towards the camera, steaming in the cold air.

4762.title: gallery_4762
4762.asset_description: A man carrying a leather briefcase walks through a doorway into a narrow white room hung with small framed drawings. He moves on into a larger white hall where other visitors stand in front of sculptures on plinths, and tips his head back to look up at a big block-coloured abstract canvas. The last shots put him alone in a vast glass-roofed hall, walking towards an enormous painting on the far wall and spreading his arms in front of it.

4763.title: gamer_4763
4763.asset_description: A young man slouches on a sofa with a controller, playing a racing game on a big TV. Next a young woman sits at a desk in a dark room lit by pink and green RGB lights, hands on a glowing keyboard and mouse in front of a game on the monitor. Then a whole living room of friends leans towards the screen with controllers up, shouting. It ends in a packed esports arena where the crowd stands and cheers as a champion is shown on the giant screen above the stage.

4764.title: sofa_4764
4764.asset_description: A young woman and a young man sit side by side on a dark green sofa in a plain living room, each holding a lit-up game controller and staring at the screen off camera. A blue bowl of crisps sits on the cushion between them. She jumps up onto the sofa with a fist in the air, cheering, and crisps scatter over the seat; he throws his head back laughing. They drop back down onto the cushions still playing.

4765.title: greenhouse_4765
4765.asset_description: A modelling-clay scene of a cottage garden. A woman in a straw hat and blue dungarees strides along a sandy path tipping a watering can, and a thick blue stream of water pours over a raised bed of tomato plants. Behind her stands a small greenhouse with a clay frame and pale glass walls and roof, with plants inside. A cottage with washing on the line, a wooden gate, seedlings, empty flower pots and a trowel fill the rest of the garden.

4766.title: garden_4766
4766.asset_description: An elderly woman in a straw hat, blue cardigan and a floral apron pushes open a wooden garden gate under an archway of roses and comes down the path. She walks between tall pink and white hollyhocks, then bends over a bed of tomato plants tied to bamboo canes and turns the ripe red fruit over in her hand. Further along she works between beds of marigolds and dahlias beside a wheelbarrow heaped with cut flowers, then stands in the middle of the beds and throws her arms open.

4767.title: gardener_4767
4767.asset_description: A woman in a wide straw hat, white shirt and a denim work apron with tools in the pockets clips a round clipped bush with a pair of long shears in a formal park garden. She works her way along a row of the round bushes, then swaps the shears for a metal watering can and pours a fan of water over a long bed of pink and white flowers. She finishes walking down the gravel path between the clipped bushes towards the camera, smiling, shears in her gloved hand.

4768.title: card_4768
4768.asset_description: A string of reaction shots in a living room strung with fairy lights. A woman claps a hand over her mouth beside a present with a red bow. A man on the sofa holds up two red-backed playing cards, eyes wide and mouth open, a game box on the table in front of him. A woman laughs with her mouth open, then covers her face as confetti falls around her over a board game. The last shot is the whole group on and around the sofa, all gasping at once at the board game on the coffee table.

4769.title: fence_4769
4769.asset_description: A woman in a denim cap with a plait, an orange fleece and a backpack holds the camera at arm's length on a canyon viewpoint at sunrise. Behind her a wooden post-and-rail fence runs along the rim, closing off the drop. She turns from the camera to the canyon, her mouth open, and swings her free arm out towards the orange-lit rock walls; then she claps her hand over her mouth and keeps staring out over the fence at the canyon.

4770.title: boarding_4770
4770.asset_description: A claymation airport departure area. A traveller with a backpack and a duffel bag walks through an open rounded door into a ribbed jet bridge tunnel. On the right an agent in a blue uniform and cap sits at a wooden desk with a monitor and raises a hand towards him. Blue rope barrier posts snake across the floor, rows of moulded seats stand empty and a white and red airliner waits outside the tall window.

4771.title: palace_4771
4771.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a bright green raincoat opens a series of ever grander gates. First a low white picket gate in a cottage flower garden, then a heavy wooden farm gate with sheep grazing behind it, then tall black iron gates opening onto an avenue of clipped hedges. Finally she grips a huge gold-painted gate and looks through it at an enormous stately palace, then turns to the camera smiling with the palace and its wide gravel forecourt behind her.

4772.title: flock_4772
4772.asset_description: An orange and pink sunset over a flat coastal marsh. An enormous mass of starlings wheels across the sky, thousands of dark specks moving as one body and changing shape from a curl to an S to a wide spiral. People stand along a wooden boardwalk watching; an older woman in a plaid coat and beret points up at the birds while a grey-haired man beside her stares open-mouthed at the sky.

4773.title: gathering_4773
4773.asset_description: A cobbled city square with cafe terraces and pastel townhouses. A young man stands alone in the middle of the square playing an accordion, his open case on the stones in front of him. A few passers-by slow down, then more stop, a cyclist halts, and within seconds dozens of people have collected around him in a wide ring. By the end a large crowd fills the square and everyone is clapping. A woman with a long red plait watches from the foreground.

4774.title: generation_4774
4774.asset_description: A cartoon garden scene under a blossoming apple tree hung with bunting. A white-haired old woman sits laughing in a floral armchair; a grown man in a shirt and brown trousers stands behind her laughing with his head back; a younger man holds a small boy in dungarees up in the air, and the boy throws his arms wide as a red and yellow beach ball flies above them. A scruffy little dog stands on the grass and a picnic table with a checked cloth sits to the right.

4775.title: newborn_4775
4775.asset_description: A bright living room with plants on the windowsill. A white-haired woman in a cream cable sweater sits on a sofa cradling a tiny swaddled baby whose face is still red and crumpled, only days old. She smiles down at it. A second older woman sits beside her and rests a hand on the bundle, then a teenage boy and a young woman lean in from either side. All four gather around the baby and finally look up at the camera, smiling, the infant still asleep in the great-grandmother's arms.

4776.title: polite_4776
4776.asset_description: A sepia engraving of a man standing on a tree-lined park path. He wears a long tailored coat over a waistcoat, a bow tie and a tall top hat, and has a waxed moustache. With one gloved hand he lifts the top hat off his head in greeting, smiling slightly at the viewer, while his other gloved hand rests on the curved handle of a walking cane. Bare trees and a railing line the path behind him.

4777.title: helpful_4777
4777.asset_description: A silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit moves through a city. He holds a cafe door open and waves someone ahead of him inside. In a marble shopping arcade he bends down and picks up a blue patterned scarf that a passer-by has dropped. At a rainy tram stop an elderly woman is standing with heavy paper shopping bags and loose oranges; he steps in and opens his black umbrella over her head. Finally, on a tram, he lifts his straw hat to a seated woman.

4778.title: workshop_4778
4778.asset_description: Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.

4779.title: germany_4779
4779.asset_description: A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.

4780.title: separate_4780
4780.asset_description: A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.

4781.title: marry_4781
4781.asset_description: An outdoor garden ceremony. A blonde bride in a white dress and veil, tears on her cheeks, slides a ring onto the finger of a groom in a black suit while he laughs with joy. They kiss under a tall flower arch. Confetti falls as they turn hand in hand and walk back down the aisle between rows of clapping guests, past flower arrangements and lavender, and at the end the whole wedding party throws their arms in the air and cheers.

4782.title: playground_4782
4782.asset_description: A sunny asphalt school yard fenced in behind a low building. A girl in denim dungarees with yellow ribbons in her bunches runs up and then hops along a hopscotch grid chalked on the ground, landing with both feet in the numbered squares. Other children swing a long skipping rope to one side, a boy bounces a ball at the back and a teacher watches from behind. At the end her friends rush in and pile into a laughing group hug around her.

4783.title: couple_4783
4783.asset_description: A young woman with curly hair carries a small chocolate cake with one lit candle up behind a young man sitting indoors; he turns and his mouth falls open. The scene cuts to an outdoor basketball court at sunset where he dribbles a ball with the low sun behind him, then to the same woman standing under the hoop holding up a handmade sign with a red heart on it and cheering. In the last shots the two of them stand face to face with white cake frosting smeared over their cheeks and chins, laughing, then lean into the camera together with a lit dome and Paris rooftops behind them.

4784.title: give_4784
4784.asset_description: A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

4785.title: terrace_4785
4785.asset_description: A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.

4786.title: sparkle_4786
4786.asset_description: A dark tropical beach at night. A woman in a white shirt stands at the water's edge where the breaking waves shine bright blue, and bends down towards them. She crouches and drags her fingers through the wet sand, and hundreds of tiny points of blue light flash on around her hand. She draws a curling spiral in the sand that glows blue and slowly fades. In the last shot she stands back as a wide sheet of water rushes in, the whole shoreline flashing with blue points of light under a full moon and palm trees.

4787.title: valuable_4787
4787.asset_description: A high-contrast black and white illustration of a prospector's hands, dark water and trees behind them. The two hands tilt a wide round pan at the edge of a river; water and grit spill over the near rim in a black stream. Inside the pan, picked out in bright yellow against the black and white drawing, lie two solid gold bars, a heap of rough gold nuggets and a scatter of fine gold grains, with one nugget lifted between finger and thumb and glinting above the pile.

4788.title: shocked_4788
4788.asset_description: A busy hair salon. A stylist with long braids leans down and cups her hand to the ear of a client sitting under a leopard-print cape; the client's eyes go wide and her mouth drops open. The client is moved under a dome hair dryer and the two keep talking closely. Two women in the background stare with open mouths at a man having his hair clipped by a barber. At the salon's front desk a receptionist looks up from her computer with her mouth open, then the stylist is back beside the client under the dryer, both wide-eyed.

4789.title: authority_4789
4789.asset_description: A wood-panelled office with a huge political map of Africa covering the back wall, stuck with coloured pins. A woman in a green suit sits behind a broad polished desk; a man in a dark suit stands beside her holding out an open folder, and she gestures with a rubber stamp in her hand as she speaks to him. An assistant with a tablet stands to one side while the man works at the map behind her. She signs a document, presses the rubber stamp onto it, closes the folder and sits back alone at the desk facing the camera.

4790.title: conflict_4790
4790.asset_description: A dark ink-and-wash drawing of a long boardroom table in a panelled government room with heavy curtains and flags. Two men lean in from opposite sides of the table, faces twisted, shouting and jabbing their fingers at each other. Papers are strewn across the polished wood and one sheet is still in the air. Other men in suits sit or brace their hands on the table between them, and a woman with a folder has stopped in the open doorway at the back of the room.

4791.title: papers_4791
4791.asset_description: A formal meeting in a tall wood-panelled room with a blue flag on a stand and daylight through a shuttered window. A woman in a dark suit stands and leans over the long table, setting down an open buff folder of documents in front of the others. Loose white sheets and a notepad lie on the polished wood beside a glass water jug. Five colleagues in suits, some seated and some standing behind the leather chairs, watch her place the folder.

4792.title: plant_4792
4792.asset_description: A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup.
