In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.

4793.title: sand_4793
4793.asset_description: A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.

4794.title: grandmother_4794
4794.transcript: - You can't even look in there.
4794.asset_description: A white-haired woman in a flowered apron and oven gloves lifts a hot tray of chocolate-chip cookies out of the oven in a wooden cabin kitchen while a small girl behind her presses her hands together and gasps. Two girls crowd in beside her and she hands each of them a cookie from the tray. She then sits in a wing armchair with a picture book open on her lap, one girl asleep against her shoulder and the other leaning in wide-eyed as she turns the pages. In the last shot she sits at the head of a long garden table with the girls and other adults, all clinking teacups over a plate of the cookies.

4795.title: bake_4795
4795.asset_description: In a pine kitchen an elderly woman in a floral apron pulls an open oven door down and slides out a tray of chocolate-chip cookies while two small girls bounce beside her with clenched fists and open mouths. In close-up her hands hold out two of the warm cookies and each girl bites into one. She then sits in an armchair knitting a blue square on needles with a wool ball in her lap and a girl dozing against her arm, and reads aloud from a picture book with her glasses on. The last shot is a garden table under fruit trees where she and the children sit around a cake stand and teapot.

4796.title: balance_4796
4796.asset_description: A boy in a cap and blue T-shirt runs along a gravel path past flower beds, then leaps into the arms of an elderly man outside a modern house, who swings him up off the ground. The boy and a white-haired woman tip a metal watering can together over pink dahlias in the garden. At a wooden garden table the boy leans on his elbows and carefully leans two playing cards against each other into a standing triangle, with more cards laid flat on the boards in front of him. The last shot is the whole family in the back garden, children at the picnic table and on a rug on the lawn.

4797.title: little_4797
4797.asset_description: At an outdoor restaurant on an Italian street a young waiter in a white shirt and dark apron stands over a checked tablecloth and grates a large block of hard cheese onto a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce. He keeps going, grinning, as the diner beside him leans in laughing and the cheese buries the pasta. The camera holds on the plate as the shavings pile higher and higher until the food has disappeared under a huge white cone of grated cheese that rises above the wine glasses. In the last shot he holds up the cheese block and grater beside the mountain of cheese and smiles at the camera.

4798.title: temple_4798
4798.asset_description: A woman in a white sundress and a straw hat walks up a stone path towards an ancient hilltop temple with tall columns in golden evening light, then runs down a narrow whitewashed alley under bright pink bougainvillea, then joins friends dancing arm in arm at a seaside table above a blue bay.

4799.title: tie_4799
4799.asset_description: An anime-style young man in a navy suit stands in front of a tall mirror and ties his black bow tie with white-gloved hands, grinning nervously with a sweat drop on his face; his jacket and a red rose lie over a wooden chair and an open suitcase sits on a dressing table behind him.

4800.title: groom_4800
4800.asset_description: A man in a black tuxedo straightens his bow tie in a hotel mirror while a second man watches, walks out through a white door into a garden, waits with his back to the camera in front of a large arch of white and pink roses with guests seated on the lawn, then turns and smiles with a white rose pinned to his lapel.

4801.title: tall_4801
4801.asset_description: A woman in a conical straw hat and a green apron waters a tray of tiny seedlings in a greenhouse, then waters tomato plants hung with red tomatoes, then stands beside a sunflower far taller than she is and looks up at its big yellow head.

4802.title: museum_4802
4802.asset_description: A uniformed guard walks through a marble museum hall past bronze statues in glass cases and framed paintings, raises a hand to hold someone back, opens a tall wooden door, points out the way for a family holding a map, then stands in the middle of the skylit hall with his arms folded while visitors walk past.

4803.title: bouquet_4803
4803.asset_description: A woman in a coat and a checked scarf arrives at an open front door holding a wine bottle and a paper-wrapped bouquet, hands the bouquet to the man who greets her, joins a table lit by fairy lights where food is served out of a red pan, and clinks a glass of white wine with the others.

4804.title: tour_4804
4804.transcript: Follow me. Whoa, shh, low. Whoa, yes.
4804.asset_description: In a town of blue-painted houses a young local man in a striped robe leads a small group of tourists through narrow lanes, pointing things out and waving them on; they squeeze past a donkey pulling a wooden cart, walk under a blue archway and come out into a busy sunlit square.

4805.title: church_4805
4805.asset_description: A young man in glasses stands by a large stone fountain in a Roman square staring open-mouthed at an open guidebook, with a domed church and an obelisk behind him; he holds the book up beside the fountain, sits on the wide steps of a columned church and points up at it, then looks out from a stone balustrade over the rooftops of the city and holds the open book up against the view.

4806.title: dome_4806
4806.asset_description: A young man in a white shirt stands in front of the Trevi Fountain holding an open photo book up against the carved figures and the green water, sits on stone steps turning its bright-tabbed pages, then stands at an iron railing above the city and holds the book up beside a great domed church on the skyline before hugging the book to his chest and smiling at the view.

4807.title: orange_4807
4807.asset_description: A man in a bright orange sleeveless sports top sits at a weathered wooden table on a sunny sports field and drinks a small glass of orange juice in one go, then lifts the whole glass jug and tips it up over his face, draining it in big greedy gulps, and finally puts it down and breathes out with the empty glasses and the empty jug in front of him.

4808.title: braid_4808
4808.asset_description: In a salon a stylist combs out a client's very long glossy black hair, then weaves a thick braid along the top of her head and down through the length of the hair; at the end the client stands up and swings the hair, which reaches almost to the floor, with the finished braid running over the crown.

4809.title: corridor_4809
4809.asset_description: A long narrow passage inside a flat, white walls on both sides, coat racks with jackets hanging on each wall and two long rows of shoes on the floor. A woman carries a laundry basket down the passage towards the camera; two men squeeze past her carrying a big cardboard box over a bicycle parked in the passage; at the end the passage is empty again, with only the shoes and coats and a blue door at the far end.

4810.title: post_4810
4810.asset_description: A bearded man in a checked shirt works outdoors on a sunny lawn beside a wire fence. He raises a hammer over his head and drives it down onto the top of a short round wooden upright. He kneels and sets the upright into a freshly dug hole in the earth next to a taller square one, then stands and swings the hammer down on it again to drive it into the ground, and wipes his forehead on his sleeve.

4811.title: teammate_4811
4811.asset_description: On a sunny beach volleyball court by the sea, two players clap their hands together in a high five in close-up. The camera pulls back to show six young players in bright sports tops standing in a ring in the sand under the net; they laugh, pile all their hands one on top of another in the middle of the circle, then throw both arms straight up in the air together.

4812.title: tidy_4812
4812.asset_description: A young man in a knitted vest holds up a blue shirt, slides a wooden hanger into it and smooths the shoulders and sleeves flat. He holds the finished shirt up straight so the collar and buttons sit square. He then carries it to an open wardrobe where a long rail of shirts hangs sorted by colour, from white through blue to orange and dark green, and slides his shirt into its place in the row, evening up the neighbouring shirts with his hand.

4813.title: harbour_4813
4813.asset_description: A young man in a wool jumper and rubber boots stands on a stone quay at sunrise with seagulls flying past. Behind him a small wooden boat is tied up on still water, then rows of white sailing yachts moored side by side; he runs his hand along a mooring line stretched from a yacht to the quay. Further along he leans on a rusty iron bollard with a thick rope coiled around it while a container ship is loaded by tall cranes and a tugboat crosses the water behind him.

4814.title: pick_4814
4814.asset_description: In a vegetable garden a hand takes a big red tomato off a staked plant hung with green and red fruit. A man drops the tomato into a wicker basket that already holds cucumbers and more tomatoes. In the next shot a man turns the soil with a spade and pale potatoes come up out of the dark earth. A woman in a headscarf kneels behind a full basket and holds a large potato up to the camera in surprise, and finally a couple tip a basket of peppers onto a wheelbarrow already heaped with tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers and potatoes.

4815.title: rub_4815
4815.asset_description: A woman in a cream blouse sits at a desk in a busy open-plan office with a monitor, keyboard and paper coffee cup in front of her. She presses her fingertips against both temples and moves them in small circles, screwing up her face. She keeps pressing, moving her hands up over her forehead and into her hair, then lowers her head into her hands and finally lays her head down on her folded arms on the desk while colleagues work behind her.

4816.title: heart_4816
4816.asset_description: A young woman in a neon yellow vest stands on an outdoor basketball court breathing hard with her mouth open after playing. She presses her flat hand onto her chest over her heart and looks down, still panting. A man in a green shirt comes up beside her, puts his hand on her shoulder and stares wide-eyed at the camera; the two of them then lean over the smartwatch on her wrist and both react in shock at the number on it while other players carry on with the ball behind them.

4817.title: drought_4817
4817.asset_description: A cartoon drawing of a burnt orange landscape under a huge spiralling sun. The ground in the foreground is baked hard and split into deep cracks, and a winding riverbed running through the hills has dried to a thick orange sludge. A shaggy dog lies panting in the last of it with its tongue out, a lone tree droops and melts like wax, and a man in a soaked shirt walks slowly forward wiping his forehead as heat lines rise off the ground around him.

4818.title: heel_4818
4818.asset_description: In a gym with a wooden floor, a finger points in close-up at a foot in a navy sock that has a thin stiletto spike fixed under the rounded back part of the foot, so the sock stands on a heel with no shoe around it. The camera pulls back to show three people in matching navy gym shirts trying to walk across the floor on these spikes, arms held out for balance, wobbling and laughing, one man in shorts leading and a woman and an older man following behind him.

4819.title: grateful_4819
4819.asset_description: A drawing of a wet cobbled street in the rain. A boy in a hooded raincoat crouches down and holds a big umbrella up over an elderly woman in a brown coat whose shopping has burst out of her bag. She is bent over next to him holding what is left of the bag; she is smiling warmly at him with her free arm laid around his shoulders while oranges, tins and a packet lie scattered in the puddles around their feet.

4820.title: same_4820
4820.transcript: Stress. Tim is coming today. Tim? Really? Then I'll go home and change. This is the strongest friendship.
4820.asset_description: Two young women meet face to face in a club with purple and pink neon lights behind them. They are wearing exactly the same patterned mini dress, and they stare at each other's dress with their mouths open. The blonde one shouts angrily at the other, then her face breaks into a smile as they talk it over; the dark haired one starts to cry and laugh at once, and the two of them fall into a long hug in their matching dresses.

4821.title: sunset_4821
4821.transcript: I bring your pizza. I am your sunshine today.
4821.asset_description: Filmed from inside a car looking out of the open window across an empty marked car park. The sun sits low on the horizon at the end of the tarmac and floods the whole shot with orange light, throwing a long shadow behind a woman walking towards the car. She is barefoot in a white summer dress and carries a flat pizza box in both hands; she comes up to the window smiling, leans in and hands the pizza box through it while the sun goes down behind her.

4822.title: message_4822
4822.asset_description: A young woman in a white summer playsuit sits on the edge of a bed typing on her phone with both thumbs and grinning at the screen. She carries on reading and typing standing in a bright kitchen, laughing at what she reads. Back in the bedroom she sits cross legged on the bed holding the phone and beaming into the camera, then throws herself backwards onto the covers kicking her legs in the air, and finally pulls the white duvet right over herself so only a foot sticks out.

4823.title: depth_4823
4823.asset_description: A freediver in a black wetsuit and long carbon fins hangs head-down far below the surface of deep blue open water, sliding down beside a pale guide rope that runs from the sunlit surface into the dark water below him. Small bubbles trail up from his mask towards the light above.

4824.title: pretend_4824
4824.asset_description: A girl in full equestrian competition kit - black show jacket, white breeches, tall black boots and a riding helmet - gallops on her own two legs across the sand of an indoor riding arena, holding a stuffed hobby horse on a stick between her knees as if she were riding it. She is laughing, and a wooden pole lies on the sand behind her.

4825.title: wipe_4825
4825.transcript: Wow, you cleaned this whole messy kitchen so well.
4825.asset_description: A wrecked kitchen is cleaned up. Spray foam is squirted over a black stove top covered in dried food, then a woman stacks dirty bowls and plates from a counter buried in washing-up, then a hand rubs a folded cloth over the white worktop in circles, and the last shots pan across the same kitchen completely clean and empty.

4826.title: dam_4826
4826.transcript: Wow, look how the dam starts to overflow.
4826.asset_description: A wide concrete dam wall sits across a green valley in the rain. Brown floodwater fills the reservoir behind it right up to the lip and pours over the top in two huge falls, crashing into the gorge below and throwing up white spray and mist. A small building and a road run along the crest of the dam.

4827.title: paint_4827
4827.transcript: Wow, you paint that sunset so beautifully.
4827.asset_description: A canvas on an easel holds a half-finished sunset over dark mountains. A hand drags a metal palette knife through a thick slab of bright orange paint, spreading it across the sky and leaving ridges of wet colour, then switches to a flat brush and blends the orange into the mountains until the sky glows.

4828.title: wall_4828
4828.transcript: Look, you paint that big wall green so evenly.
4828.asset_description: A man in a green T-shirt works across a tall bare plasterboard wall in an attic room, rolling dark green paint onto it with a long-handled roller. Half the wall is already an even green block, the other half is still grey plasterboard with white filler stripes, and a dust sheet covers the floor at his feet.

4829.title: chip_4829
4829.transcript: Wow, you scrape all that old paint right off.
4829.asset_description: Close-up of an old wooden surface covered in cracked, blistered cream paint. A hand pushes a wide metal scraper under the paint and small chips and flakes break off and fall away, leaving patches of bare orange wood, and the scraper keeps going until a large area is stripped.

4830.title: swim_4830
4830.asset_description: Two freedivers in black wetsuits and long fins move through clear blue open water along a thin vertical line. One is far below in the dark blue, the other kicks upward towards the bright surface, and by the end both are near the top with sunlight breaking through the water above them.

4831.title: hit_4831
4831.transcript: Watch him ball. Whoa, watch him hit the ball.
4831.asset_description: In a grassy back garden ringed by a wooden fence, a young man in a cap sets up over a coloured ball balanced on a batting tee, swings a blue aluminium bat and sends the ball flying high over the lawn. The camera follows the ball into the grey sky, and he stands watching where it lands among the other balls scattered on the grass.

4832.title: ridge_4832
4832.transcript: I walk right along the top of the world.
4832.asset_description: A helmet-camera view straight down at a climber's red suit and boots as he stands on a knife-thin snow ridge. The ridge runs away from him in a long narrow crest of trodden snow that rises to a summit point, with a solid white sea of cloud far below on both sides and the curved horizon and deep blue sky beyond.

4833.title: coast_4833
4833.asset_description: A follow-cam view behind a skateboarder in a helmet and gloves riding down an empty coastal road at sunset. The road curves along the side of a dry hillside, and on the right the land drops away to the sea, which runs out to a golden horizon. The rider crouches, puts a hand out through the bends and keeps rolling down towards the water.

4834.title: toy_4834
4834.asset_description: Two teenage boys lean over a wooden table with their elbows on it, watching a black plastic battle dish. Inside it a yellow spinning top and a purple spinning top race around the bowl, knock into each other and keep spinning, and both boys grin and laugh as they follow them.

4835.title: city_4835
4835.asset_description: A shaky running camera chases a figure along a city pavement at night. Lit shop windows and neon signs run down one side, parked cars and traffic lights line the road on the other, and tall apartment blocks with lit windows stand at the end of the street under a deep blue sky.

4836.title: saw_4836
4836.transcript: He can carve a big bear out of the wood.
4836.asset_description: In a wood, a man in a blue T-shirt and work gloves cuts into a standing tree trunk with a chainsaw. A life-size bear is already emerging from the pale wood, and he saws around its shoulders and body, sending a spray of sawdust out to the side while the bark below is cut away to free the bear's legs.

4837.title: table_4837
4837.asset_description: A group of friends sit around a long wooden dining table by a bright window, covered with dishes: a whole roast chicken, a pizza in its box, bowls of salad, pasta and fries, a round loaf of bread and glasses of beer. They pass plates of grilled vegetables across the table to each other, one woman holds out a slice of pizza, hands tear pieces off the loaf, and the camera pulls back to show the whole laden table with everyone smiling and reaching over it.

4838.title: throw_4838
4838.asset_description: On a wide sunny beach a young woman in a bikini swings her arm and sends a small ball flying up over the sand. The shot cuts to a yellow ball high against the blue sky over the surf, then to her standing with legs apart and both arms raised as a watermelon-patterned ball drops towards her hands. A large red, white and blue beach ball sails through the air while a man runs under it, and finally she laughs as a rainbow-striped ball comes back at her and the man lands in the sand behind.

4839.title: move_4839
4839.asset_description: A montage of one young man shifting heavy things. He leans into the back of a small silver car on a suburban street and shoves it along the kerb. Next he is behind a supermarket trolley in a car park, driving it forward across the tarmac. Then he stands behind a child on a playground swing and sends him forward. In a warehouse he braces his shoulder against a huge wooden crate and tips it along the floor, and finally a group of friends put their hands on a giant stone ball on a grassy hill and roll it over the grass.

4840.title: hide_4840
4840.asset_description: A dark room where someone is pressed behind a heavy beige curtain with only a hand showing at the gap. Cut to an office, where a grinning man in a blue polo shirt is folded up under a desk with his arms round his knees. Then a small boy in a red shirt presses himself against a wide tree trunk in a park and peers round it with wide eyes. A quiet living room with an empty fireplace swings past, and finally a whole group of people leap up from behind a sofa with their arms in the air as confetti falls.

4841.title: key_4841
4841.asset_description: A woman in a denim jacket stands in a hallway looking around with a frustrated frown. She crouches at an open kitchen drawer and rakes through hair ties, tape rolls, markers and packets. She moves into a walk-in wardrobe and pushes along the rail of hanging clothes, then tips a wicker laundry basket full of clothes upside down onto a chest of drawers. Finally she sits on the floor by a pile of clothes and holds a small metal key up to the camera with her mouth open in triumph.

4842.title: work_4842
4842.asset_description: A woman in a blue t-shirt stands at a white kitchen sink with the tap running hard into the basin. Cut to a workshop, where a woman in dark overalls kneels on a sawdust-covered floor and drives a cordless drill into the leg of a wooden chair. Then a pair of hands on a grey table hold an opened blue phone with its back off, the battery and circuit board exposed. A teenager in a checked shirt leans over the engine bay of an old blue car in a driveway with a spanner, and finally he punches the air and shouts beside the open bonnet.

4843.title: structure_4843
4843.asset_description: On a trestle table in a sunny garden a man taps a hammer against a small wooden birdhouse, holding a finger over the round entrance hole. He steps back and turns the finished birdhouse, with its pitched roof, little porch and railings, to the camera. Cut to a lawn where about eight people crouch around a huge folded grey tarpaulin and spread it out flat. Then the same group heave a tall triangular timber wall frame upright, and finally they stand back on the grass looking up at the finished wooden house frame standing on its slab.

4844.title: half_4844
4844.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

4845.title: cloth_4845
4845.transcript: There we go. Nice and even. Pretty. Ta-da!
4845.asset_description: Close on two hands in a living room stitching a dark button onto the front of a pale blue shirt with a needle. Cut to a workroom where dark hands push a fine needle through the folded hem of a piece of natural linen, with spools of coloured thread on the shelf behind. Then a sewing machine foot runs a line of stitches along a folded cream panel. Next an embroidery hoop holds a big pink and red flower worked in coloured threads with green leaves. Finally a row of people in a hall lift a finished patchwork quilt above their heads and cheer.

4846.title: iron_4846
4846.asset_description: A woman in a kitchen runs a steam iron over a white shirt spread on an ironing board by the window. Cut to a bedroom, where a man in a blue polo presses a pair of dark trousers laid flat across the end of the bed. Then an older woman at a wooden dining table works the iron over a stack of grey linen napkins. Next two women stand at opposite sides of a long table in a bright loft and run an iron each over a big white sheet. Finally the two of them hold the finished sheet up between them, hanging smooth and flat.

4847.title: floor_4847
4847.transcript: So clean. Got it. Almost there. Looking good.
4847.asset_description: A blue spin mop is pushed across beige kitchen tiles, leaving a wet shine between the grout lines. Cut to a woman in a grey shirt bending over a flat mop in a cream-tiled corridor. Then an older woman with white hair drags a wide dust mop down the aisle of a shop between shelves of bottles. Next a woman works a long-handled mop across the vast polished concrete of an empty warehouse, the ceiling lights reflected in it. Finally she sits down on the gleaming warehouse floor with her arms thrown wide.

4848.title: grow_4848
4848.transcript: In you go. Drink up. Ta-da! Look at that.
4848.asset_description: Gloved hands press the soil around a small green seedling just set into a terracotta pot on a patio, with other pots and plants behind. Cut to a watering can pouring a wide spray over a raised bed packed with orange, pink and purple flowers beside a wooden house. Then a woman in gloves closes a pair of red secateurs on a stem inside a tall glossy hedge. Next she bends over a vegetable patch and takes hold of a large orange pumpkin among the broad leaves, and finally she straightens up holding the pumpkin against her chest and grins.

4849.title: summer_4849
4849.transcript: There you go. Drink up. Up here too.
4849.asset_description: A hand tips a metal watering can over two terracotta pots of green herbs on a sunlit window sill, with trees in full leaf outside the open window. Cut to a close shot of a hand turning the knob on a sprinkler head standing in bright green grass. The sprinkler sends a tall jet of water arcing over a lawn with a stone fountain and flower beds behind. Then a girl reaches up to a hanging basket spilling pink and green foliage against a blue sky. Finally a man and two children run through the spray of a garden sprinkler, with a rainbow in the mist.

4850.title: camera_4850
4850.asset_description: Over the top of a camera on a tripod, a woman in a striped summer dress stands smiling on a sunlit park lawn under tall trees. Cut to a macro shot of round dew drops beading along a green leaf in a flower bed. Then two hands hold up a black DSLR with a big flash on top and shoot into a sunset over rolling hills, the sun low and orange on the horizon. The same shot holds as the sun drops further. Finally a young man in a straw hat and green shirt turns a big black camera with a long lens towards the viewer at a red-carpet event.

4851.title: ancient_4851
4851.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a khaki shirt and bush hat lies over a patch of desert sand and sweeps a wide brush across it, uncovering a small round coin. She brushes again and the sand falls away from a flat grey slab. The slab turns out to be a stone tablet carved with rows of hieroglyphs, and she scrapes along its edge with a pointed trowel, mouth open in amazement. Finally she stands in a sandy excavation pit beside a colossal carved pharaoh's head, with other workers climbing over the stone around it.

4852.title: gear_4852
4852.asset_description: A young man in a workshop apron grins as he works an adjustable spanner on a blue circuit board at his bench, tools hanging on the pegboard behind him. Cut to him in goggles with his hair on end, holding the small board up in both hands over a heavy bench vice. Then he stands back with a screwdriver as a small mechanism is clamped in the vice, and next a larger machine with a motor and rails sits on a rolling bench in front of him, his mouth open. Finally he throws both arms up in a garage in front of a huge machine of purple pistons and interlocking metal gears.

4853.title: tiny_4853
4853.asset_description: Extreme close-up of a woman squinting through a gold eye loupe at a minute brass cog held in a pair of tweezers right in front of her eye. She sits back at a workbench covered with tweezers, tins and springs, in a shop whose walls are hung with wall clocks, and holds the loupe up to her eye. Next she points a fine tool into the open case of a mantel clock, its brass wheels visible behind the glass. Then a tall grandfather clock with brass weights and a swinging pendulum fills the frame, and finally she stands with her arms out under the enormous brass gears of a tower clock.

4854.title: solve_4854
4854.asset_description: A young man with wild hair and glasses stands at a huge blackboard in a university lecture hall full of students. He writes chalk equations fast, checks a pocket calculator, keeps writing, punches the air, and by the end the entire wall-sized blackboard is filled with mathematics while he stands back in front of it.

4855.title: remember_4855
4855.asset_description: A young man in glasses with headphones round his neck sits at a desk holding small word cards. He taps his temple, reads a card, flips it over and drops it, and the cards multiply until the desk is buried and the wall behind him is papered with them.

4856.title: teacher_4856
4856.asset_description: A woman with glasses and a pencil in her bun sits at a desk in an empty classroom marking a pupil's paper with a red pen. She corrects sheet after sheet and stacks of marked papers rise on the desk until towers of paper wall her in and she looks up, overwhelmed.

4857.title: worker_4857
4857.asset_description: A man in a yellow hi-vis vest and white gloves stands in a warehouse holding a handheld barcode scanner. He frowns at it, shakes it, then scans the label on a cardboard box and a red VERIFIED stamp appears; he goes on scanning boxes moving along a long conveyor belt between tall storage racks.

4858.title: spiral_4858
4858.asset_description: A young man in a tie-dye shirt kneels on the floor of a big empty hall setting up coloured dominoes. The camera follows winding rainbow lines of standing dominoes across the floor, and a wide shot reveals they form one enormous spiral curling in on itself, with him crouched at the centre.

4859.title: piece_4859
4859.asset_description: A woman in a big cardigan and glasses leans over a table scattered with jigsaw pieces in a bright room full of plants and bookshelves. She picks up single pieces and presses them into the picture, the puzzle grows onto the wall, and finally it covers the whole floor as she fits the last pieces in the middle.

4860.title: bubble_4860
4860.asset_description: In a kitchen a woman in an apron drops a white tablet into a glass of water and small bubbles stream up through the water. She stirs it with a spoon, then lowers a big white block into a large glass tank where it fizzes into a swirling white cloud while she gasps at it.

4861.title: listen_4861
4861.asset_description: A woman in a field vest and big headphones holds a furry microphone and a handheld recorder close to a singing bird in a wood. She crouches to record a stream over stones, raises a long boom microphone up into the green canopy, and finally records beside a thundering waterfall, beaming.

4862.title: choose_4862
4862.transcript: Hmm, this one or this one?
4862.asset_description: At a busy outdoor market a woman in a headwrap holds up two apples, one in each hand, then puts them on the two pans of a brass balance to see which she wants. She does the same with two melons, then two sacks on a market scale, and finally two huge pumpkins on a wooden beam that tips to one side.

4863.title: plan_4863
4863.asset_description: In an office a woman sticks a green sticky note onto a square of a huge wall calendar, then sits and writes in a colour-tabbed planner. She adds more notes to the calendar, and the wall grows into an enormous grid covered with hundreds of coloured notes while she stands with her hands on her hips looking up at it.

4864.title: uniform_4864
4864.asset_description: A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

4865.title: lens_4865
4865.transcript: Perfect. Sharp. Got it. Amazing! Yes!
4865.asset_description: A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.

4866.title: drone_4866
4866.asset_description: A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.

4867.title: thumb_4867
4867.asset_description: A montage of people making videos. A young man in a gaming chair with a headset shouts happily at a ring light, a lit keyboard in front of him. A woman in a kitchen holds up a big pan of chicken and vegetables toward the camera. A girl on a sofa laughs and holds both thumbs up close to the lens. A young man sings loudly into a studio microphone with an electric guitar. Finally a performer stands on a huge arena stage with arms raised, confetti falling, filmed by two camera operators.

4868.title: program_4868
4868.transcript: Aha! Got it! Nice! Almost there... It works!
4868.asset_description: A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.

4869.title: design_4869
4869.transcript: Ooh, nice. This one. Perfect. Love it. Ta-da!
4869.asset_description: A young woman with curly hair draws a swirling logo letter on a tablet with a stylus at a sunny desk. She then stands over a table fanned out with dozens of colour swatch cards and smiles at the camera. At an iMac she arranges a colourful poster layout with a colour wheel open beside it. A hand turns a sketchbook page showing a pencil drawing of a woman in a long flowing gown. Finally she poses in front of a huge colourful mural in a gallery while visitors look at it.

4870.title: foam_4870
4870.asset_description: Close up, a man's face is covered in thick white shaving foam and he draws a straight razor down his cheek, leaving a clean stripe. In a bathroom mirror he trims his beard with an electric trimmer. In a barbershop a barber shaves his beard line with a straight razor while he sits under a white cape. By a swimming pool a bare forearm with a white stripe of foam is shaved smooth. Finally he sits grinning in the barber chair while four men around him applaud.

4871.title: registration_4871
4871.asset_description: A close shot shows a hand writing a name into a spiral-bound book headed REGISTRATION, with other names already filled in. Two smiling staff in lanyards hand a printed name badge across the counter to a guest. Behind the desk more staff work with stacks of forms, badge printers and card scanners while a queue waits. The camera pulls back to show an enormous convention hall with a huge crowd lined up at long check-in tables.

4872.title: rating_4872
4872.asset_description: A woman in a leather cap and khaki jacket sits at a table set with small bowls of food, holding a clipboard and a pen. She stamps rows of stars onto small white cards with a rubber stamp and holds one up, wide-eyed. The table fills with dozens of cards each showing five stars, some black and some gold. The final wide shot reveals the table and the whole wall behind her covered with hundreds of identical five-star cards.

4873.title: study_4873
4873.asset_description: A woman with glasses pushed up on her head sits at a desk walled in by towering stacks of books and bundles of paper. She reads an open book, writes on a small sticky note and looks up in surprise. The camera pulls back and the stacks keep growing until she is a tiny figure in the middle of a wall of books and files reaching the ceiling.

4874.title: traffic_light_4874
4874.asset_description: A cyclist in a yellow jersey and a white-and-yellow helmet is stopped at a big city junction, mouth open in shock; above and beside her a traffic light shows green and amber. The camera pulls back and pedestrians, runners and a dog stream across the striped crossing in front of her while tall buildings rise on both sides.

4875.title: truck_4875
4875.asset_description: Outside a suburban house a woman in work gloves carries a cardboard box down the drive past a wall of stacked boxes, then a tower of five boxes. Behind her a large white box truck stands open with a ramp down; she and two other movers slide boxes and a brown leather sofa up the ramp into the truck's cargo hold, which is already packed with boxes.

4876.title: smile_4876
4876.asset_description: A woman in a yellow raincoat stands under a glass bus shelter in the rain, eyes squeezed shut and teeth showing in a wide smile, while a golden retriever puppy tucked inside her open jacket licks her chin. Behind her two other people wait for the bus with flat, miserable faces, staring down at the wet pavement. Warm yellow shop windows glow behind the rain-streaked glass.

4877.title: sit_4877
4877.asset_description: A woman in a cream jumper and jeans is seated alone in a padded seat in an empty auditorium, blowing out a breath. As the camera pulls back, more and more people are seated in the rows around and behind her, until the whole vast hall is full of people sitting quietly in their seats, all facing the same way.

4878.title: pier_4878
4878.asset_description: A young man in swim shorts dives head first off the end of a wooden platform that runs out from the shore over a green lake, and hits the water with a big splash. He surfaces in the ring of foam, two more people plunge in, and then a long platform on posts over turquoise water appears, lined with dozens of teenagers who all jump off it together.

4879.title: competition_4879
4879.asset_description: At an outdoor strength contest a woman in a black lifting suit and belt presses a loaded barbell overhead, then hauls a huge grey stone up to her chest and above her head. Next she balances a thick length of tree trunk, bark still on and the sawn end showing, across her shoulders, and finally holds a small black car over her head while the crowd watches from behind a rope.

4880.title: bottle_4880
4880.asset_description: From the edge of a tall rooftop the camera looks straight down at a car park deck far below, where a small blue water balloon falls and bursts. A grinning young man leans over the parapet holding a watermelon with the city skyline behind him, drops it, and it splatters on the concrete. Then a sack bursts on the deck and finally he tips a big water bottle over the edge and it explodes into spray far below.

4881.title: bus_4881
4881.asset_description: A woman braces her hands against the back of a small silver car and shoves it along the street. The shot widens and a line of people is pushing the back of a long city bus, number 230, with its destination sign lit, along the road; then a group pushes the back of a lorry trailer, and finally a whole row of people leans into an enormous round boulder in the road.

4882.title: aircraft_4882
4882.asset_description: A line of people in matching gym kit hauls on a thick rope across a mown field, teeth gritted, dragging a wooden sled loaded with people, then an old saloon car. The scene cuts to an airfield where the same line of people pulls the rope hand over hand and drags a huge grey military transport plane, with four jet engines under its wings, along the tarmac towards the camera.

4883.title: reveal_4883
4883.asset_description: A woman in a bright floral sundress walks smiling down a pale hallway; tall carved wooden double doors appear; she strides through the vaulted hall of an Italian villa with her arms flung wide; she pushes two huge studded wooden doors apart, steps outside, and the open doors show a sunlit valley of green hills behind her.

4884.title: point_4884
4884.asset_description: A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.

4885.title: street_4885
4885.asset_description: A woman in a beige utility vest holds a small rainbow flag up high and walks up a sunny cobbled street in an old Italian hill town; stone houses with shutters and balconies line both sides, and a long line of people follows her up the street.

4886.title: steep_4886
4886.asset_description: A young man with a large backpack and trekking poles pushes his way up a steep grassy mountain path; the camera follows him from behind and then from the front while the slope falls away below him to a wide alpine valley and rows of distant peaks.

4887.title: narrow_4887
4887.asset_description: A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.

4888.title: barefoot_4888
4888.asset_description: A blonde young woman in a white sundress walks barefoot along the wet sand at the edge of the sea; shallow waves wash over her bare feet and she leaves footprints behind her; the camera pulls back to show a long line of people walking barefoot on the same shoreline.

4889.title: circular_4889
4889.asset_description: In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.

4890.title: circle_4890
4890.asset_description: A rainbow-striped spinning top spins on the hexagonal paving of a city park while a teenage boy circles around it with one leg swung out; more and more people join in, running in a wide ring around the spinning top while the city skyline glows behind them at sunset.

4891.title: campus_4891
4891.asset_description: On a sunny university lawn a blonde student in a white crop top leans far to one side towards the camera and laughs; her friends lean the same way beside her; the camera pulls back to show dozens of students on the grass all leaning sideways in the same pose, with big shade trees, walkways and university buildings behind them.

4892.title: shorts_4892
4892.asset_description: A first-person ride down a water slide: bare legs in colourful swim shorts race feet-first through a blue chute past palm trees and a bright sky, then down a green flume into a burst of white water; the shot ends on the whole waterslide tower above a busy pool.

4893.title: crowded_4893
4893.asset_description: A young woman in a navy T-shirt sits smiling in the stands of a baseball stadium; the camera pulls back over row after row of seated fans in caps and team shirts, past a packed lower tier, and rises into a wide shot of the whole bowl filled with spectators to the very top.

4894.title: still_4894
4894.asset_description: In a school sports hall a teenage boy in a grey shirt stands motionless on the centre line of the basketball court; the camera pulls back and more and more students appear standing in the same frozen pose, until an aerial view shows the whole hall filled with rows of unmoving students.

4895.title: opposite_4895
4895.asset_description: A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.

4896.title: shadow_4896
4896.asset_description: A group of friends crouches together in a circle on a sunlit cobbled square; a moment later everyone is running outward in every direction in front of a domed basilica, and the low sun throws a long dark shadow with sharp edges behind each runner on the pale stones.

4897.title: join_4897
4897.transcript: Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes!
4897.asset_description: On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.

4898.title: panel_4898
4898.transcript: Close it in. See you later.
4898.asset_description: Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.

4899.title: enormous_4899
4899.asset_description: A hand pulls a carrot out of dark garden soil and it comes up as long as an arm; next two gardeners heave out a white radish taller than they are, with a mass of roots hanging off it; finally a whole group of gardeners lifts a full-grown tree straight out of the ground in a back garden.

4900.title: stack_4900
4900.asset_description: In a sunny back garden a wooden barrel rolls across the grass towards two onlookers; then a folding table with bats and balls appears, then a shopping trolley loaded with grocery bags; finally a very tall neat pile of wooden pallets stands on the lawn and topples into a scattered heap.

4901.title: blue_4901
4901.asset_description: Seen from the top of a pale sea cliff, a woman dives head first off the edge into deep blue water under a blue sky; the sea below shades from turquoise to dark blue, and one after another more people leap off the cliff and hit the blue surface, leaving rings of white foam.

4902.title: submarine_4902
4902.asset_description: Swimmers splash and laugh in a calm blue lake; behind them a long dark grey military submarine rises out of the water with its conning tower streaming water, and then a humpback whale breaches beside it and throws spray over the swimmers.

4903.title: crowd_4903
4903.asset_description: An aerial shot looking down on a wide, sunlit paved plaza in front of a glass building. At first single people walk across the tiles in every direction, casting long shadows. More and more people arrive, and the loose scattering turns into a dense mass that packs together in the middle of the square until the paving is barely visible.

4904.title: risky_4904
4904.asset_description: Three shots of people and objects held up in precarious positions. A young man in black walks a slackline strung between two trees in a park, arms out to keep from falling. Then a very tall stack of wooden chairs balanced one on top of the other sways against a blue sky. Finally a group of men in black kit build a human tower, standing on each other's shoulders several levels high.

4905.title: span_4905
4905.asset_description: Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.

4906.title: tent_4906
4906.asset_description: A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.

4907.title: speaker_4907
4907.asset_description: Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.

4908.title: branch_4908
4908.asset_description: Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.

4909.title: famous_4909
4909.asset_description: A young woman films herself in a packed street party at sunset, laughing into the camera with people pressed all around her. She climbs a green lamppost and pulls herself up above the crowd while people below film her on their phones. A wide shot shows the whole street filled with thousands of people facing the low sun. She grins into the lens, then stands raised above the crowd with her arms up while everyone below cheers with their hands in the air and confetti falls through the golden light.

4910.title: scarf_4910
4910.asset_description: A young man in a packed football stadium films himself in the stands. His face is painted in two halves, blue-yellow and red, and a long striped team scarf in club colours hangs around his neck over his shirt. A wide shot shows the ring of the stadium full of fans with a flag being waved on a pole. He shouts and screams with joy, the fans around him leap up and hold a scarf overhead, and he ends hugging a friend and roaring at the camera.

4911.title: owner_4911
4911.asset_description: A blonde woman holds up a ring of keys in front of her face and smiles behind them. She pushes open the glass door of a small cafe that still has a CLOSED sign hanging on it and steps inside. She ties a grey apron behind her neck over her white shirt, then walks along the wooden counter past the espresso machine and the pastry display case, spreads her arms to show the room, and laughs with her hands raised in the empty cafe that is now hers.

4912.title: instructor_4912
4912.asset_description: In a wooden-floored dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands in front of a class of students in white suits, who all bow together. She then demonstrates for them: she raises one knee and drives a high kick out to the side while the students behind her copy her stance. She holds a wooden board out at arm's length towards the class, calls out an instruction, and finally takes a wide stance with both arms out as the students watch and follow.

4913.title: bracelet_4913
4913.asset_description: Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.

4914.title: guitar_4914
4914.asset_description: A young man sits on a bench in a city plaza between office towers, playing a wooden acoustic instrument with six strings, one hand on the fretboard, the other strumming over the sound hole. A runner in a race bib jogs past. Office workers with shopping bags stop and gather in a half circle around him, clapping and smiling; a toddler dances in front; two people hold up phones to film him as he keeps playing and singing.

4915.title: shoulder_4915
4915.asset_description: Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.

4916.title: bicycle_4916
4916.asset_description: A low camera close to the boards shows two two-wheeled pedal vehicles rolling side by side along a wooden seaside pier, a young man and a young woman pedalling and laughing above them. They hold the camera at arm's length for a selfie with the beach and palm trees behind. They get off, and on the pier she spins and he catches her; they hold each other by the railing, then stand together grinning at the camera with the sun setting over the sea.

4917.title: shoot_4917
4917.asset_description: Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.

4918.title: stairs_4918
4918.asset_description: A young man in a grey hoodie jogs along a suburban pavement in golden evening light. In close-up he takes a full paper grocery bag from an elderly woman's hands. Carrying a bag under each arm, he climbs the flight of steps up to her house, where the white-haired woman waits smiling by the porch railing. His hand steadies a loaded shopping trolley rolling along the pavement. Finally he stands beside her and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

4919.title: membership_4919
4919.transcript: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?
4919.asset_description: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.

4920.title: community_4920
4920.asset_description: In a garden between two apartment blocks, an elderly man, a young woman and a small boy kneel at a raised wooden bed and press a seedling into the dark soil. A striped watering can is passed from hand to hand among the neighbours standing around, adults of different ages plus the little boy. The young woman waters the seedlings, the water streaming from the spout onto the soil. She then holds a hand-painted COMMUNITY GARDEN sign over her head, and the whole group of residents cheers and throws their arms up around her.

4921.title: trail_4921
4921.asset_description: Two young men with big backpacks walk a narrow rough path cut through a spruce forest on a hillside. A selfie shot shows one of them breathing hard; the path behind him is loose dirt and stones. They laugh and point at each other, then climb on over a stretch of the path knotted with tree roots and rocks. At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.

4922.title: host_4922
4922.asset_description: A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.

4923.title: seat_4923
4923.transcript: Right this way, best seat in the house.
4923.asset_description: A blonde young woman in a white shirt and a black waist apron smiles at the camera inside a warm, candlelit restaurant. She walks through the dining room holding leather menu folders under one arm, passing seated guests and a bar. She reaches an empty wooden table, lays the menus down on the two chairs and gestures at the table with an open hand. A couple follows her in and takes the places she has shown them while she stands beside the table.

4924.title: familiar_4924
4924.asset_description: A young woman in an oversized beige sweater stands on a city pavement beside a pastel coffee kiosk, looking down at her phone. She glances up at a man in a denim jacket and her face opens in recognition; both of them point at each other and start talking. They shake hands warmly next to the kiosk window, then stand facing each other holding takeaway coffee cups and carry on chatting.

4925.title: care_4925
4925.asset_description: A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.

4926.title: dentist_4926
4926.asset_description: In a bright dental surgery a woman in teal scrubs reaches up and swings the big round examination lamp over a man lying back in the treatment chair. Wearing latex gloves she leans over him with a small round mouth mirror and looks at his teeth while he keeps his mouth open. A close-up shows a toothbrush with blue bristles brushing along his front teeth. She then holds a round hand mirror up so he can see, and finishes by giving a thumbs-up next to the mirror.

4927.title: lawyer_4927
4927.asset_description: A tall stack of thick hardback volumes sits on a polished wooden table in front of floor-to-ceiling shelves of matching legal books. A woman with a low ponytail in a navy suit and white shirt smiles to one side. She stands behind the table and lifts a black leather briefcase onto it with both hands. Outside, seen from behind, she climbs the wide stone steps of a courthouse with loose papers under one arm and the briefcase in her hand. At the top she shakes hands with a man in a dark suit, smiling.

4928.title: fix_4928
4928.asset_description: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.

4929.title: grade_4929
4929.asset_description: Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.

4930.title: reward_4930
4930.asset_description: A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.

4931.title: diagram_4931
4931.asset_description: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

4932.title: steer_4932
4932.asset_description: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

4933.title: wheel_4933
4933.asset_description: A young man in a light blue shirt and dark tie sits in the driver's seat of a city bus at a depot, both hands on the large black steering wheel. He turns the wheel as the bus rolls out; a low shot from behind the wheel shows the dashboard and the road ahead. Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.

4934.title: headset_4934
4934.asset_description: A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.

4935.title: compass_4935
4935.asset_description: A woman in a white captain's cap, navy jacket and rubber boots walks up a metal gangway in a marina. She takes hold of the big wooden ship's wheel of a boat, with white yachts and masts behind her. A close-up shows her finger touching a brass compass set into the console, its needle and marked dial clearly visible. She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.

4936.title: kitchen_4936
4936.asset_description: A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.

4937.title: ring_4937
4937.asset_description: A young man in a denim apron works the griddle of an American diner with red booths behind him. He cracks an egg onto the hot plate beside frying eggs and pancakes, flips the pancakes with a spatula, and stacks them on a green-rimmed plate. Syrup is poured over a pat of butter on top of the stack. He then leans over the counter, eyes wide, and strikes the metal service bell with his palm to call the order away.

4938.title: waitress_4938
4938.asset_description: On a sunny café terrace a young woman in a white shirt and striped apron carries plates between wooden tables where guests are sitting. A couple at a table laugh and raise their coffee cups. She walks to a table by the railing and sets down a plate of dessert. A close shot shows a hand writing an order in a spiral notepad with a pencil, next to a cappuccino and a jar of white flowers. She turns to the camera and smiles, a pencil stuck in her hair.

4939.title: golden_4939
4939.asset_description: A young baker presses a ball of pale dough on a floured wooden table while low sun pours through the window behind him. A board of dough balls is slid towards the mouth of a glowing brick oven. He wipes his floury forehead with the back of his hand in front of the fire. A tray comes out full of croissants baked to a deep golden brown, and he holds a steaming round loaf with a golden crust towards the camera.

4940.title: butcher_4940
4940.asset_description: A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.

4941.title: firefighter_4941
4941.asset_description: A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. Outside, an extension ladder leans against a tree with a ginger cat sitting on a branch; the firefighter climbs it, lifts the cat down and hands it to a relieved man waiting below. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.

4942.title: luggage_4942
4942.asset_description: A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

4943.title: praise_4943
4943.asset_description: A young man in a striped knitted sweater sits with his eyes closed while a hand dusts powder onto his cheekbone with a make-up brush. He then stands on a film set lit by big softbox lamps, pulls a huge open-mouthed shocked expression twice while a crew member moves equipment behind him, and finally the crew - five people in dark clothes - line up and clap and cheer for him. He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.

4944.title: gown_4944
4944.asset_description: A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.

4945.title: sing_4945
4945.asset_description: A young woman in an oversized band T-shirt presses a pair of big headphones to her ears in a recording booth strung with warm fairy lights. She leans into a large studio microphone behind a pop filter and belts out a note with her eyes shut and her mouth wide open. A cut shows an older man at a mixing desk pushing the faders. She keeps singing with her arms flung out, then laughs and looks over at a screen where the man behind the glass is clapping.

4946.title: ponytail_4946
4946.asset_description: A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.

4947.title: portrait_4947
4947.asset_description: Two hands squeeze a tube of acrylic paint so a ribbon of yellow lands on a wooden board already loaded with blobs of blue, red, purple, orange and white. A young woman in paint-spattered dungarees works at a big canvas on a wooden easel in a sunlit studio, sweeping red and green strokes on with a brush, then stepping back to look at the swirl of colour. The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.

4948.title: skyline_4948
4948.asset_description: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

4949.title: scenery_4949
4949.asset_description: Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.

4950.title: hip_4950
4950.asset_description: In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

4951.title: home_4951
4951.asset_description: A watercolour illustration seen from a dark hallway looking through an open front door into a warmly lit entrance hall. A young man in a dark coat and scarf has just stepped inside, keys still dangling from his hand, and is leaning down towards a golden dog that has run up to him with its tail swinging. Behind him are coats on hooks, boots lined up under a shelf and a wall of framed family photos under a glowing ceiling lamp.

4952.title: bed_4952
4952.asset_description: A hand pushes down a door handle and opens a flat door. A young man with a backpack and a rolling suitcase steps into a narrow hallway; a golden retriever jumps up at him and he crouches to stroke it. An older woman in an apron comes out of the kitchen and they hug for several seconds while the dog sits at their feet. The last shot is a bedroom with a warm lamp and a bookshelf, where he drops backwards onto the bed and lies spread out on the quilt.

4953.title: hope_4953
4953.asset_description: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.

4954.title: visit_4954
4954.asset_description: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.

4955.title: locker_4955
4955.asset_description: A cartoon of a crowded shared dorm room with metal bunk beds on both sides and a bank of tall grey lockers along the back wall. Washing lines strung across the room are hung with socks, underwear and small towels, and backpacks, hiking boots and rolled sleeping mats lie all over the floor and beds. One boy is climbing down from a top bunk and has thrown an orange rolled-up mat through the air; a small child standing on a lower bunk reaches out to catch it, while a boy on the top bunk opposite laughs so hard that tears fly off his face.

4956.title: reception_4956
4956.asset_description: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

4957.title: hotel_4957
4957.asset_description: A three-tier montage of places to stay. A young backpacker with a big rucksack leans out of the doorway of a shabby wooden roadside place under a pink and blue neon HOTEL sign. Cut to a woman in a grey suit wheeling a silver suitcase out of a revolving glass door into a bright marble lobby, with the caption 150 EUR over her. Cut to an elderly man in a dark suit with a walking stick greeted by a uniformed doorman in front of a floodlit palace facade with a fountain, then walking through a chandelier-lit marble hall, caption 2,000 EUR.

4958.title: villa_4958
4958.asset_description: A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.

4959.title: cottage_4959
4959.asset_description: Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

4960.title: cuddle_4960
4960.asset_description: An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.

4961.title: pet_4961
4961.asset_description: A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.

4962.title: binoculars_4962
4962.asset_description: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

4963.title: finger_4963
4963.asset_description: A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face.
