She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.

4964.title: taste_4964
4964.asset_description: In a modern kitchen at dusk, a man in a denim shirt with a towel over his shoulder lifts a spoonful of tomato-vegetable soup from a pot on the stove, blows on it and tastes it, then holds the spoon out for the woman beside him, who leans in and tastes it too. She smiles and nods. He then brings a bouquet of flowers out from behind his back; she gasps in delight, and they step onto the balcony and hug in front of the city lights.

4965.title: bathroom_4965
4965.asset_description: A teenage boy in mint-green pyjamas stands in a tiled bathroom in front of a white washbasin with a mirror, a shower cubicle and a towel rail. He brushes his teeth with a blue toothbrush, leans over the basin and spits, then lathers his hands with soap and rinses them under the tap, splashes water on his face, dries his face with a small towel and smiles at the camera.

4966.title: split_4966
4966.asset_description: A stop-motion style winter scene: a thick white slab of ice hangs over dark water with long icicles under its edge. A hand in a red-and-blue striped mitten presses down on the slab, and the ice separates into two parts along a jagged crack running across it, with small ice crystals and shards flying up. A frozen lake and snow-covered hills sit in the background.

4967.title: identity_4967
4967.asset_description: A neon-lit night scene in comic style: a young woman with dark hair stands at a checkpoint window in the rain, wearing a transparent visor while a glowing grid scans her face. She holds up a plastic card that carries her own photo and printed personal details, and a hand in the foreground points a scanner at the card to check that she is who the card says she is.

4968.title: card_4968
4968.asset_description: In a busy public office a young woman with long red hair stands at a service counter, gasps with excitement and picks up a small plastic card that has just been issued to her. She turns it over, reads it, then holds it up beside her face so the photo on the card and her own face are seen together, gives a thumbs up, and the people waiting behind her clap.

4969.title: cafe_4969
4969.asset_description: At small round tables on the pavement outside a city cafe, an older woman with white hair sits reading a book and sipping a cup of coffee. A young man in a colourful shirt at the next table talks at her, waves his hands, leans over her book and finally holds his phone in front of her, but she never looks up from her page. He slumps back in his chair while a waiter passes behind them.

4970.title: independence_4970
4970.asset_description: A night photo of a packed old-town street: a huge crowd fills the square in front of a stone clock tower, fireworks burst in the dark blue sky and confetti falls over the people. Several people sit on friends' shoulders waving large plain flags in red, blue, green and yellow, and everyone below is cheering with raised fists and open mouths.

4971.title: fireworks_4971
4971.asset_description: Night scene in front of a floodlit domed capitol building: an officer in a white dress uniform hauls a rope and runs a red, white and blue flag up a tall pole while a huge crowd watches; the sky then fills with burst after burst of gold, red, white and blue fireworks over the dome, and the shot ends among the crowd waving small flags and sparklers and cheering.

4972.title: patriotic_4972
4972.asset_description: At night outside a lit domed parliament building, an officer in white uniform raises a pale blue and yellow national flag up a white pole; the crowd below holds up matching flags and phone lights, fireworks fan out over the dome, and a young woman with her country's colours painted on both cheeks screams with delight in the middle of the flag-waving crowd.

4973.title: monument_4973
4973.asset_description: A young traveller films himself in three places: first standing with arms thrown wide in front of a white marble domed mausoleum at the end of a long reflecting pool, then leaning grinning over cones of bright yellow, orange and red spice at a covered market stall, and finally in a street where people in white clothes hurl clouds of pink, yellow and green powder over each other, until his face and shirt are smeared with colour and he laughs into the lens.

4974.title: seller_4974
4974.asset_description: A street tea stall hung with orange marigold garlands: a vendor in an orange kurta lifts a steel pan high above his head and pours a long unbroken stream of milky tea down into a jug at waist height without spilling a drop, repeating the trick while a tight semicircle of young men film him, laugh and applaud; he then fills small steel cups and hands them round.

4975.title: different_4975
4975.asset_description: A tide of commuters in grey and navy suits with briefcases crosses a street between glass office towers; in the middle of them walks one young woman in a bright turquoise coat, red beret, yellow headphones and yellow boots, the only colour in the crowd. She perches on a concrete bollard while the suits stream past behind her, sips an orange juice and smiles into the camera.

4976.title: wade_4976
4976.asset_description: A woodblock-style print of flooded rice terraces: a barefoot farmer in a dark tunic, rolled trousers and a conical straw hat walks along a narrow earth dike, ankle-deep in the shallow water, with ripples and splashes curling around his feet. White long-legged birds lift off from the paddies behind him and a smoking volcano rises above the terraces and palm trees under a pink dawn sky.

4977.title: hand_4977
4977.asset_description: A first-person clip in the tropics: an outstretched arm and open hand with beaded bracelets fills the foreground, leading the camera along a path through misty green rice terraces while a smiling long-haired man holds on at the other end. He then sits on the steps of a carved stone temple beside a monkey, and finally rides a big rope swing out over a jungle valley of palms and terraces, feet bare against the sky.

4978.title: cook_4978
4978.asset_description: A young street-food cook works a wok at a night market stall: a huge column of flame leaps from the pan as he tosses fried rice, he cracks an egg into the wok and stirs it with a ladle, flips the pan into another burst of fire, then plates the rice with a fried egg on top and satay skewers beside it and spreads his arms proudly behind the finished plate.

4979.title: office_4979
4979.asset_description: An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.

4980.title: breathe_4980
4980.asset_description: On a hilltop above green fields under a clear blue sky a woman tilts her head back, closes her eyes and breathes in deeply; a man holds a mug of coffee under his nose and breathes in the steam; a woman with curly hair pushes her nose into a bunch of bright flowers; a man leans open-mouthed over a fresh loaf of bread; finally a group of friends stands in a circle with their arms spread wide, heads back, all taking a deep breath together.

4981.title: vaccine_4981
4981.transcript: Tiny pitch. Done. Ow, not bad. Brave. Yay!
4981.asset_description: In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.

4982.title: ankle_4982
4982.asset_description: On a green football pitch a player in a white kit dribbles the ball, then suddenly pulls up, grimaces and doubles over. He drops onto the grass and grips his leg just above the boot, his face twisted in pain. Two opponents in blue crouch down, take him under the arms and lift him back onto his feet, and he ends up sitting on a wooden bench at the side of the pitch, still holding the same spot above his foot.

4983.title: officer_4983
4983.asset_description: At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.

4984.title: briefcase_4984
4984.asset_description: On a seaside promenade lined with palm trees an older woman with a grey plait, knee pads and elbow pads rolls along on a skateboard, laughing. A jogger passes her, then a man in a dark coat hops onto a board behind her and copies her, and finally a man in a business suit carrying a black briefcase in one hand steps onto a skateboard as well. All of them roll down the promenade together past the benches and the sea, grinning.

4985.title: fix_4985
4985.asset_description: In an office two workers put up screens. A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.

4986.title: bright_4986
4986.asset_description: A woman in a white shirt aims a cordless drill at a wall while a man in a blue polo holds a spirit level against a black bracket and then reaches up towards the ceiling. The two of them carry a large black screen across the room, hang it on the wall and switch it on, and it lights up in strong blue. In the last shot the room is dark and a wall of nine mounted screens glows bright blue, lighting up both of their faces and the plastic sheet spread over the floor.

4987.title: present_4987
4987.asset_description: In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

4988.title: attack_4988
4988.asset_description: A crowd of medieval re-enactors in helmets and tunics pours down a long grassy field toward a camp of white canvas tents. A man in full plate armour runs at the front holding a tall blue banner, and hundreds of fighters with shields and spears follow him downhill while spectators watch from behind ropes at the top of the field.

4989.title: hill_4989
4989.asset_description: Filmed from behind a rope barrier at the foot of a grassy ridge. First one armoured fighter with a red banner appears on the crest, then a long line of re-enactors with coloured flags comes over the top and charges down the slope toward the camera, passing a white canvas tent. Spectators in the foreground film it on their phones.

4990.title: iron_4990
4990.asset_description: A young man in a grey sleeveless top works alone in a launderette in front of a row of big industrial washing machines. He shakes out a striped shirt, lays it flat on an ironing board and presses it with a heavy steam iron, then reaches for the next item beside a tall stack of folded, freshly washed clothes.

4991.title: messy_4991
4991.asset_description: A man in a colourful tie-dye shirt and glasses stands over a bed heaped with a big pile of crumpled clothes. He pulls a badly creased blue shirt out of the heap and pulls a face at the state of it, then irons it flat on a board and finally holds it up, smooth, beside a rail of hanging shirts.

4992.title: busy_4992
4992.asset_description: An older woman in a yellow cardigan carries a big armful of clean laundry across a bright room, opens a tall white cupboard and pulls out a folding ironing board. She sets it up on the wooden floor, spreads its patchwork cover flat, then works through the pile with a steam iron and holds up a finished pale blue shirt.

4993.title: alone_4993
4993.asset_description: A woman in a chunky cream jumper paddles a red canoe straight toward the camera across a huge, glassy blue lake. The drone pulls back and up and she is the only person on the water. She reaches a tiny rock island with a single pine tree on it, steps out and stands there by herself, the whole scene mirrored in the still water.

4994.title: wooden_4994
4994.asset_description: An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.

4995.title: a_sculpture_4995
4995.asset_description: A watercolour cartoon of an Italian town square. In the middle a stone fountain sprays three jets of water over a carved group of human figures on its basin. A young man in a striped shirt rides a red scooter across the wet cobblestones past the fountain, a pizza stall behind him. Pigeons take off in the foreground, an Italian flag hangs on a pole on the left, and the Leaning Tower of Pisa and a cathedral dome rise over the tiled roofs.

4996.title: a_cone_4996
4996.asset_description: A sunny photo on the lawn in front of the cathedral and the Leaning Tower of Pisa. A young woman in a white summer dress and a straw hat walks towards the camera holding a pale ice cream in a pointed wafer cone in her raised hand. Pigeons walk on the grass around her and several take off with spread wings on both sides of her.

4997.title: a_laugh_4997
4997.asset_description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.

4998.title: a_tunnel_4998
4998.asset_description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. A young man in a yellow jacket with a camera round his neck holds the phone out on a crowded city crossing at dusk, with lit screens and pedestrians behind him. Then the camera moves forward down a long shaded passage formed by hundreds of orange shrine gates standing one behind the other, with a bright opening far ahead at the end. Finally he sits at a lit night stall under red paper lanterns and eats a bowl of ramen with chopsticks.

4999.title: to_combat_4999
4999.asset_description: A manga-style drawing inside a wooden training hall. A barefoot young man in a dark blue training robe grips a long bamboo sword in both hands and drives forward against an opponent, whose own bamboo sword and gloved hands come in from the left edge of the frame. Speed lines cut across the whole picture, dust bursts from the floorboards under his heel, and a Japanese flag hangs on the wall behind him with a stone garden visible through the open sliding doors.

5000.title: thin_5000
5000.asset_description: A sushi counter clip. A young chef in a white jacket and a white headband leans over a wooden block and cuts thin flat slices off a long orange fillet of raw fish with a narrow knife. He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.

5001.title: landscape_5001
5001.asset_description: A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.

5002.title: dusk_5002
5002.asset_description: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.

5003.title: explorer_5003
5003.asset_description: An ink-and-wash drawing of a dense green rainforest. A man in a wide-brimmed hat and a dirt-stained shirt stands in the middle of the frame and swings a machete, cutting through the hanging leaves in front of him so that fronds and scraps fly off. Thick vines loop across the whole picture, huge dripping leaves hang on both sides, mist rises off the tangled roots at his feet, and a macaw flies overhead against a pale sky.

5004.title: spring_5004
5004.asset_description: A watercolour of red desert at sunset. A kangaroo is caught in mid-air, both back feet off the ground, driving itself forward in a long bound across the red sand, its heavy tail streaming out behind it for balance. A joey's head pokes out of the pouch on its belly. Dust puffs up where its feet just left the ground, low saltbushes dot the sand and pink clouds fill the sky.

5005.title: bay_5005
5005.asset_description: A young woman in a navy polo shirt sits in a coastal watch station with nautical charts pinned to the wall and a brass bell beside the window. She scans the water through binoculars. Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.

5006.title: kettle_5006
5006.asset_description: An older woman in a patchwork apron fills a stainless steel electric kettle from the kitchen tap, then sets it back on its round base on the worktop, where a red light comes on and it starts to boil. She carries it to a wooden table where five brightly patterned mugs stand in a row, each with a teabag in it, and pours the boiling water into one mug after another.

5007.title: lock_5007
5007.asset_description: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat stands on the step of a blue front door with a brass knocker, digging anxiously through her beige tote bag. She finds a bunch of keys and holds them up in front of her face, grinning with relief. A close shot shows her sliding one key into the round metal lock set in the blue door and turning it. She pushes the door open and steps into the hallway.

5008.title: unlock_5008
5008.asset_description: A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.

5009.title: child_5009
5009.asset_description: A red-haired boy grins as he slides down a blue playground slide on a sunny day. He then runs across the grass of a park lawn and kicks a black-and-white football, and walks back with the climbing frame behind him. The camera pans over an empty park path and ends on the playground with the ball lying on the lawn.

5010.title: king_5010
5010.asset_description: In a stone hall lined with guards in bearskin hats, a man in a red velvet robe walks up a red carpet to a golden throne. He sits down and a gold crown is placed on his head, then he strides back through the hall smiling. He steps onto a castle balcony above a huge crowd and raises his arms while the crowd cheers below the towers and flags.

5011.title: old_5011
5011.asset_description: On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.

5012.title: romance_5012
5012.asset_description: At a Paris cafe two young women in coats lean in close over a marble bistro table holding two cappuccinos. Then an elderly couple at a cafe table hold each other's faces and kiss. Next a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man leaning the woman backwards, and they end in a long hug on the pavement while cafe guests watch.

5013.title: cheap_5013
5013.asset_description: Three kitchens are compared with a price caption over each one. First a frail old man stirs a pot on a single gas burner in a shabby room with peeling walls, captioned 500 euro. Then a woman in a bright white family kitchen pulls a tray of cookies out of the oven, captioned 10,000 euro. Last a man stands at the marble island of a glass-walled penthouse kitchen with the city skyline behind him, captioned 100,000 euro.

5014.title: rich_5014
5014.asset_description: Three cooks in three very different kitchens. An old man in a vest tastes soup from a wooden spoon over a battered pot on a gas ring in a tiled, run-down room, then cracks an egg into it. A woman in a bright white kitchen lifts a baked cheesy dish out of the oven with oven gloves. Finally a man in a black turtleneck tosses peppers in a frying pan in a penthouse kitchen with copper pans hanging overhead and the night skyline in the windows, then spreads his arms wide.

5015.title: homemade_5015
5015.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen with painted pottery on wooden shelves, a young woman in an apron and an older woman in a headscarf stand at a floured wooden table. They push and fold a large pale mass of bread dough with their hands, laughing together, until it is shaped into a smooth round loaf on the flour-dusted table.

5016.title: knee_5016
5016.asset_description: A young man in a white T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot on a clinic examination couch while a doctor in a white coat stands beside him holding a reflex hammer. He stands up, bends his legs and drops into a deep squat facing the camera so his bare knees are in the middle of the frame, then sits back on the couch, puts a hand on his knee and laughs with the doctor.

5017.title: cut_5017
5017.asset_description: Close up, a man's hands slice a tomato into thin rounds with a large kitchen knife on a wooden board. He works along the board slicing cucumber, then yellow pepper, then a red onion, until the board is covered with neat rows of pieces. He straightens up behind the board, which now shows the vegetables laid out in a rainbow-coloured row, and speaks to the camera.

5018.title: tasty_5018
5018.asset_description: A soft watercolour illustration: a young woman in a pale blue traditional Korean dress sits at a table, chopsticks in one hand lifting shredded green and orange vegetables, a spoon in the other carrying a dollop of thick red chilli paste over a steaming stone bowl of rice topped with beef, noodles, greens and a sunny fried egg; small side dishes stand blurred behind, and white steam curls up across the paper.

5019.title: beef_5019
5019.asset_description: In a busy Korean barbecue restaurant a young woman in a white shirt and black apron stands at a round table grill; thick red marbled slices of beef sit on the mesh over a tall flame, ringed by dozens of small dishes of kimchi, greens and sauces. She turns and moves the slices with tongs until they brown, then lays a piece on a lettuce leaf, folds it into a parcel and holds it out to the camera while the guests behind her clap and laugh.

5020.title: replace_5020
5020.asset_description: In a bright flat a young woman points up at a ceiling fitting whose bare bulb is dead. She and a young man carry in an aluminium stepladder and open it under the fitting; she climbs the steps while he steadies the frame, screws a new bulb into the socket and it lights up warm and bright. They look up at the working light, then fold the ladder away.

5021.title: lady_5021
5021.asset_description: An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

5022.title: shine_5022
5022.asset_description: Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.

5023.title: airplane_5023
5023.asset_description: A young man with bleached hair in a blue rain jacket stands at a wire fence beside an airfield under a clear sky, filming himself with a gull perched on a fence post in front of him. A small white propeller plane comes down and touches its wheels on the runway behind him. Then a huge four-engine airliner drops in very low right over his head, wheels out, and lands on the runway; he turns to watch it, throws both fists in the air and shouts in delight.

5024.title: dictionary_5024
5024.asset_description: In a fairy-lit cafe a curly-haired woman sits at a table with small national flags and thick decorated dictionaries, greets the camera brightly, then jumps up and runs across the room. She sits down opposite a woman in a kimono who bows with pressed palms over an open book, then stands holding a huge stack of dictionaries, each spine carrying a different language. At the end the whole cafe raises coffee cups around her and her tower of books.

5025.title: joke_5025
5025.asset_description: In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.

5026.title: hilarious_5026
5026.asset_description: A student with blue hair in a yellow hoodie sits in a lecture hall staring at his phone and laughing so hard that he covers his mouth and wipes tears out of his eyes. A girl with braids leans over to look at the screen and laughs with him, and a classmate behind them roars with his mouth wide open while the rest of the room carries on working.

5027.title: judge_5027
5027.asset_description: A wood-panelled courtroom lit by tall windows. A woman in a black robe sits behind the raised bench and brings a wooden gavel down onto its block, papers spread in front of her and a set of brass scales standing at the edge of the bench. In the foreground a stack of files lies on the counsel table.

5028.title: difficult_5028
5028.asset_description: In a wood-panelled courtroom a man in a grey suit heaves armfuls of heavy leather-bound volumes onto the bench beside a set of brass scales and a gavel, and the pile keeps growing. A close shot shows one thick book lying open on the stack, its pages dense with tiny print, with rows of seated people behind it. In the last shot the stack has become a tower taller than the people, the judge sits beside it and the whole room stands staring.

5029.title: gesture_5029
5029.asset_description: An ink drawing of a courtroom in heavy cross-hatching. A man in a suit and loose tie strides across the floor mid-step, one fist punched high above his head and the other arm swung back holding an open folder. Behind him a judge sits at the bench, a flag stands in the corner and people watch from the benches on both sides.

5030.title: costume_5030
5030.asset_description: A street carnival in a city of tall shuttered houses hung with bunting. A woman in a rainbow feather costume walks down the middle of the road carrying a tall banner on a pole, smiling straight ahead, with a large crowd of people walking close behind her. Drummers in matching yellow and blue tops move along the road in rows with drums strapped to them, and the balconies on both sides are packed with people watching.

5031.title: leader_5031
5031.asset_description: A black-and-white linocut print on tan paper. A bearded man in a fur-lined hood and a heavy coat stands high on a snowy ridge with one boot up on the rock, gripping an ice axe and throwing his free arm out to point at the peak ahead. Below and behind him a roped line of smaller climbers works its way up the slope. Carved swirls of cloud and a low sun fill the sky.

5032.title: ahead_5032
5032.asset_description: On an alpine trail below snowy peaks a woman in a red jacket holds an open map, raises her arm and points along the path, and a line of hikers with poles and backpacks walks behind her. She steps first across a stream on stones while the group waits on the bank and watches her line. Then a women's rowing four cuts across a turquoise lake, the woman in the bow setting the stroke and finally punching a fist into the air.

5033.title: drum_5033
5033.asset_description: A carnival parade fills a wide street hung with rainbow bunting between balconies packed with spectators. A woman in a huge rainbow feather headdress and a silver bodysuit walks down the centre line of the road at the front with her arms flung wide. Behind her, rows of drummers in white outfits and rainbow-striped trousers carry big rainbow-painted drums strapped at the waist and beat them with sticks as they advance, with a dense crowd stretching back down the street.

5034.title: spill_5034
5034.asset_description: A woman in a grey bathrobe holds up a white milk carton that is split at the seam; milk runs out of it and pools in a white puddle on the wooden table while she stares at it in dismay. She then crouches under a kitchen sink where water drips out of the plastic trap into a grey bucket. Finally she stands in a large stucco room where drips fall from the ceiling into a dozen coloured plastic bowls hung from strings, and she reaches up to steady one.

5035.title: talent_5035
5035.asset_description: In a sunny park a young person in a rainbow tie-dye tracksuit bends down and picks up three pastel balls from the grass, then straightens up and juggles them in a smooth cascade. Three friends sit on the lawn behind and watch, smiling. The juggler grins wide as the balls arc above their head.

5036.title: learn_5036
5036.asset_description: In a courtyard between brightly painted apartment blocks a young man in a rust hoodie tries to juggle two balls, fumbles and grabs his head in embarrassment while a young woman in a denim jacket beside him holds more balls and shows him how. He tries again, tossing one ball up and catching it, gets a little further each time, and at the end both of them laugh and she claps.

5037.title: sidewalk_5037
5037.asset_description: A woman in a camel trench coat wheels a grey suitcase across a marble hotel lobby and out through a revolving glass door. She steps onto the wide paved sidewalk of a Paris street, cars passing on the road right beside her, and looks around while other people walk past her on the same pavement. She then comes back in and stops at the reception counter with a document in her hand.

5038.title: pace_5038
5038.asset_description: A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.

5039.title: cage_5039
5039.asset_description: At sunrise on a city rooftop an old man with a white beard stands in front of a tall stack of wooden and wire bird cages with small birds inside, and unlatches the little doors one after another. Birds burst out of the cages and the sky fills with a huge flock. He holds an empty cage in his arms and looks up, and the crowd of people behind him watches the birds circle over the city.

5040.title: armchair_5040
5040.asset_description: At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.

5041.title: flash_5041
5041.asset_description: An anime-style illustration of a night storm over a city. Thick black clouds fill the top of the frame, and a huge white-violet bolt of lightning splits the sky and slams down onto a wet concrete rooftop, bursting into a blinding white flash with sparks and debris flying out sideways. Smaller branching bolts spread across the clouds, rain falls in streaks, and the skyscrapers behind the roof are lit violet by the strike.

5042.title: painful_5042
5042.transcript: Ooh, my legs. Leg day. Ow, ow.
5042.asset_description: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.

5043.title: silent_5043
5043.asset_description: A hand-drawn illustration of a male lion standing on the edge of a rocky cliff above an African savanna. His mouth is wide open in a full roar, showing teeth and tongue, and his dark mane is blown back by the wind, drawn as curling white lines around him. Below and behind him dry grass, flat-topped acacia trees and purple hills stretch to the horizon, where a big orange sun is rising.

5044.title: hear_5044
5044.transcript: God, save that for the camera.
5044.asset_description: A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.

5045.title: sound_5045
5045.asset_description: At night on a neon-lit Korean shopping street, a young man with bleached hair and headphones around his neck cups a hand behind his ear towards the camera, then pulls the headphones up over his ears. The camera swings down to the pavement, where a big silver boombox with two round speakers stands next to a lamppost, playing while shoppers pass behind it. The clip ends at a concert in front of a towering wall of stacked loudspeakers, with a performer on stage and the crowd's hands in the air.

5046.title: television_5046
5046.asset_description: A cartoon illustration of three young people watching television in a living room at night. The glow of the screen, just out of frame at the left, lights the whole room blue. A man in a yellow jumper leaps up off the sofa with both arms raised, sending a bowl of popcorn flying so the kernels rain down through the air, a woman in a blue dress on the sofa punches the air, and a man in a green polo shirt sprawls back laughing. Behind them are a floor lamp with an orange shade, a bookshelf and a striped rug.

5047.title: living_room_5047
5047.asset_description: An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.

5048.title: shut_5048
5048.asset_description: An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.

5049.title: close_5049
5049.asset_description: A montage of things being shut and locked up. Hands hook a brass padlock through the metal hasp of a wooden garden gate and snap it closed. A man in a cream jacket crouches by a bike rack in a town square and threads a lock through his bicycle frame, then spins the dial of a combination padlock on a rainbow cable wrapped around the rack. In the last shots he turns a key in the lock of a wooden front door under a porch light at dusk, pulls the door closed behind him and walks away.

5050.title: lose_5050
5050.asset_description: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.

5051.title: lose_5051
5051.asset_description: A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.

5052.title: light_5052
5052.asset_description: An inked, muted illustration of a railway station hall. A porter's trolley is stacked far too high with battered leather suitcases, canvas bundles and tied sacks, and the whole tower is sliding off. Cases tumble through the air, one lands open on the tiled floor with a wheel spinning away, and a man in a dark jacket throws both hands up as the baggage rains down on him. Blurred travellers and a second trolley stand in the background under the arched glass roof.

5053.title: label_5053
5053.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a hijab loops a clear plastic ID tag onto the pulled-up handle of a black hard-shell suitcase, threads the strap and clicks it shut, then shows the card with her photo and name inside. The scene cuts to an airport baggage hall, where she waits by the carousel with her phone; a black case with a bright pink fluffy tag comes round and she pulls it off the belt.

5054.title: lift_5054
5054.asset_description: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

5055.title: organ_5055
5055.asset_description: A flat cartoon drawing on a mint-green background: a pair of pink lungs seen from the front, with the windpipe branching down into both sides and pale blue airway trees drawn inside each half. Curling light-blue lines and dots swirl around them to suggest air moving in and out. Nothing else is in the frame.

5056.title: maid_5056
5056.asset_description: A hotel housekeeper in a turquoise uniform with a pink-trimmed apron snaps a white sheet out over a bed and lets it settle, plumps and squares up the pillows, then folds two towels into a swan and tucks a pink frangipani flower against its neck. She steps back smiling, then goes back to her trolley of stacked towels and toiletries in the doorway.

5057.title: mail_5057
5057.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a girl on a village path at sunset. She reaches up and pulls open the flap of a big wooden mailbox on a tall post, and a fan of letters bursts out of it; more envelopes drift through the pink sky and one large envelope floats past the bottom of the frame. Hedges, a tiled cottage roof and a half-timbered house sit behind her.

5058.title: postman_5058
5058.asset_description: A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.

5059.title: letter_5059
5059.asset_description: A young man in a navy hoodie stands at a black roadside mailbox with its red flag up and pulls the front hatch open; the box is empty. A postal worker in a blue jacket and cap arrives and pushes a thick block of white envelopes and a brown parcel into the box, filling it completely. The man reaches back in, drags out the enormous stack of letters and holds it against his chest, mouth open in delight.

5060.title: male_5060
5060.asset_description: A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.

5061.title: aquarium_5061
5061.asset_description: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.

5062.title: boss_5062
5062.asset_description: A woman in a burgundy trouser suit strides through a busy open-plan office carrying a tablet, pointing and giving instructions to people at their desks. She stops beside a seated colleague and shows him something on the tablet screen. Next she stands at a whiteboard in front of four colleagues and draws a rising line graph with a blue marker, explaining it and pointing at the peak. Finally she stands among the desks, hands on the tablet, talking to the room while everyone works at their screens.

5063.title: column_5063
5063.asset_description: A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.

5064.title: trumpet_5064
5064.asset_description: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.

5065.title: aisle_5065
5065.asset_description: A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.

5066.title: sample_5066
5066.asset_description: A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.

5067.title: marriage_5067
5067.asset_description: A cartoon bride and groom float in the air in front of a pastel flower arch, kissing. She wears a white gown, a veil and pearls and holds a bouquet up in one hand; he wears a black tuxedo. Confetti and ribbons fall around them while guests in the foreground clap and cheer with their eyes shut.

5068.title: bride_5068
5068.asset_description: A wedding ceremony on a beach under a white rose arch, with the sea and cliffs behind. The bride, in a long white dress and a veil, slides a ring onto the groom's finger while he smiles down at her. He then takes her face in his hands and they kiss; the seated guests stand and applaud, and the two hold hands and laugh together under the arch.

5069.title: enjoy_5069
5069.asset_description: A man in a pale shirt sits in a leather armchair in a lobby with green plants and a small water feature behind him. An older woman in a uniform polo shirt stands behind the chair and kneads his shoulders and neck with both hands. His face goes from a tight grimace to a slack, blissful expression as he tips his head back with his eyes closed and smiles.

5070.title: mattress_5070
5070.asset_description: In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.

5071.title: service_5071
5071.asset_description: A bearded mechanic in blue overalls lies on a creeper and slides out from under a silver car in a busy repair shop. He then works in the open engine bay with a ratchet, loosens the wheel nuts with a red impact driver, tightens them with a long torque wrench, and finally straightens up, wipes his hands on a rag and closes the bonnet with a satisfied look.

5072.title: liquid_5072
5072.asset_description: A painted illustration: a pale woman wrapped in a green and red checked cardigan sits up at a bedside table while a second pair of hands tips a brown glass bottle and pours a thick brown liquid into a metal measuring spoon she is holding. A drop is falling from the spoon; a white mug and a folded blanket stand on the wooden table beside her.

5073.title: medicine_5073
5073.asset_description: A young woman in a grey hoodie sits at a kitchen table with a box of tablets, an open pill case, a glass of water and a brown medicine bottle in front of her. She pours the brown syrup onto a spoon, swallows it, screws up her face in disgust and sticks out her tongue, gulps down the water, shudders, and finally screws the cap back on the bottle.

5074.title: introduce_5074
5074.transcript: Hi there, nice to meet you. Welcome aboard!
5074.asset_description: A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.

5075.title: sticky_5075
5075.asset_description: A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.

5076.title: member_5076
5076.asset_description: A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.

5077.title: recall_5077
5077.asset_description: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.

5078.title: pork_5078
5078.asset_description: At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.

5079.title: pyramid_5079
5079.asset_description: A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.

5080.title: yellow_5080
5080.asset_description: A young woman in a bright yellow sundress stands in a small clothes boutique in front of a tall wooden-framed mirror and looks at her reflection. She takes a mirror selfie with her phone in front of racks of clothes, then leans towards a vanity mirror ringed with bulbs and checks her face, then spins so the yellow skirt flares out between two mirrors. In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.

5081.title: purple_5081
5081.asset_description: A young man in a blue hoodie stands in a hallway and inspects a silver ring through a small jeweller's magnifier, frowning at it. A blonde woman in a grey t-shirt tucks her hair behind her ear in front of a round black-framed bathroom mirror. A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.

5082.title: hairstyle_5082
5082.asset_description: A young woman in a coral top and a chunky yellow bead necklace dabs powder onto her cheek from a compact in a bright hallway, her hair piled up in a high bun. She leans towards a round gold-framed mirror on the wall, smooths her hair back with one hand and talks to her reflection, then adjusts the necklace at her throat. She turns to a large vanity mirror ringed with light bulbs, and in the last shot her hair has been arranged into two big rounded buns, which she shows off to the camera beside her reflection.

5083.title: berry_5083
5083.asset_description: Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.

5084.title: green_5084
5084.asset_description: At a fashion show, a model with a shaved head and large gold hoop earrings walks straight towards the camera down the runway in a floor-length, loose, shiny green gown with wide draped sleeves. Photographers and seated guests along both sides hold up phones to film her. She comes close enough for the green fabric to fill the frame and looks into the lens, then turns and walks away so the back of the gown swings behind her.

5085.title: statue_5085
5085.asset_description: A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.

5086.title: shiny_5086
5086.asset_description: In a high-rise office a woman in a dark uniform, yellow rubber gloves and yellow shoes pushes a flat mop across a wide stone floor. The floor she has already done throws back a clear mirror image of the ceiling lights and the windows. Behind a glass wall a meeting is going on at a long table with people in suits, none of whom look up. She works her way backwards across the hall, leaving one long polished strip after another.

5087.title: dirty_5087
5087.asset_description: A white tiled kitchen floor is covered with a long line of muddy brown animal paw prints leading from the door across the room. An older man in a flat cap and braces dips a string mop into a grey bucket of water, wrings it out, and then pushes a flat mop over the prints. The tiles he has passed over come up white and clean again, until he stands at the far end of a spotless floor that reflects the window.

5088.title: awake_5088
5088.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a wooden farmhouse at sunrise. A boy in a long pale nightshirt leans out of an open window with both arms stretched high above his head, mouth open in a yawn, just out of bed. Outside, the sun is coming up over misty hills and sends long rays across a meadow full of grass and small flowers. A cockerel stands on a fence post with its beak open and a few birds fly in the distance.

5089.title: mother_5089
5089.asset_description: A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

5090.title: nursery_5090
5090.asset_description: A claymation-style scene set in a small baby's room. A woman in a blue jumper kneels on a patterned rug and holds a baby in yellow striped pyjamas up in the air; both are laughing. Behind her stands a wooden cot with white bedding, and around the room there are wooden building blocks on the floor, a knitted purple elephant toy, a chest of drawers, a shelf with potted plants and a curtained window letting in warm light.

5091.title: motorbike_5091
5091.asset_description: A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.

5092.title: helper_5092
5092.asset_description: A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.

5093.title: overgrown_5093
5093.asset_description: A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.

5094.title: skinny_5094
5094.asset_description: In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.

5095.title: awe_5095
5095.asset_description: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

5096.title: ground_5096
5096.asset_description: A pencil sketch of a woodland floor seen close up. A large mushroom with a thick stalk and a smooth domed cap grows straight out of the ground, its gills drawn in fine lines underneath. A hand comes in from the right and a finger touches the base of the stalk at ground level. Fallen leaves, twigs and smaller mushrooms cover the earth all around, with bare trees sketched softly in the background.

5097.title: music_5097
5097.asset_description: A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.

5098.title: national_5098
5098.asset_description: A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.

5099.title: photo_5099
5099.asset_description: In a flat with a huge political world map on the wall, housemates take turns stepping up to it. Each one holds a small square instant print showing their own face and a little paper flag, and presses both onto the map over the country they come from. A man in a green football shirt sticks his onto northern Europe, a woman with a camera round her neck presses hers onto Africa, a long-haired man adds one near Japan, a blonde woman adds one over South America. The map fills up with flags and small portraits, and at the end the whole group crowds behind the framed map, holds it up and takes a selfie with it.

5100.title: stick_5100
5100.asset_description: A big coloured world map hangs on a wall framed by fairy lights. Four flatmates come to it one after another. A man in a green football shirt presses a small green flag and a square instant print of his face onto the map. A woman in a red jumper with a camera round her neck points at a spot, then pushes her own print and a red flag onto it. A man in a yellow t-shirt reaches up and pushes a yellow flag and a print onto Asia. The camera pans across the map showing four portraits, each held on by a coloured flag, and ends with the four of them squeezed together in front of the map, mouths open, cheering at the camera.

5101.title: nausea_5101
5101.asset_description: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

5102.title: alley_5102
5102.asset_description: A woman with a large hiking backpack walks through an old North African medina, following a map on her phone. She turns down a very narrow lane between tall ochre and blue walls, close enough to touch both sides, checking the screen and pointing at it. She keeps walking, squeezes past a man standing in the lane, then passes through a covered market passage hung with clothes and lined with stalls, and out through a low brick archway. At the end she comes out into a huge open square in front of a mosque with a tall minaret, looks at her phone again and smiles.

5103.title: neck_5103
5103.asset_description: A woman in a lilac blouse sits at an office desk in front of a computer monitor, tips her head to one side and rubs the back of her neck with her hand, wincing. She rolls her head and talks to the camera. The shot cuts to a close-up of her chest and shoulders as she loops a thick mustard scarf around her neck and knots it. Then the scene cuts outdoors: she stands at a green fence at a wildlife park in the same blouse and scarf, and a giraffe lowers its very long neck down over her head from above. She turns to the camera with her mouth wide open in astonishment, hand at her chin.

5104.title: talk_5104
5104.asset_description: A hand-drawn cartoon of two neighbours talking over the low wooden fence between their gardens. On the left a man in a straw hat and patched overalls leans on the fence and holds up a teacup, a speech bubble full of squiggles above him. On the right a woman in a floral dress and apron listens with a hand at her cheek, laughing, while her watering can pours onto a flower bed. A black cat sits on a fence post between them, laundry hangs on a line and a smiling sun is in the sky.

5105.title: ditch_5105
5105.asset_description: A painted illustration of flat Dutch countryside. A straight water-filled ditch runs from the foreground into the distance between raised grass banks. Three big windmills with red and white sails stand along the left and centre, a church tower far behind them. Ducks swim on the water and glide down to land on it. On the bank at the right a boy in a cap and red scarf cycles along a dirt path beside a strip of red and yellow tulips, and tall clouds fill the deep blue sky.

5106.title: windmill_5106
5106.asset_description: A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.

5107.title: cradle_5107
5107.asset_description: A mother and father stand cheek to cheek in a bright room, cradling their swaddled newborn in their arms and smiling down at it. The shot changes to the two of them leaning over a clear hospital bassinet with their reflections in the plastic and the newborn asleep inside. The camera then pulls back across a hospital nursery filled with rows and rows of identical bassinets, each holding a sleeping newborn, the rows stretching away down the ward.

5108.title: village_5108
5108.asset_description: A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.

5109.title: sweet_5109
5109.asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at sunset a young woman in a denim jacket carries a tray of a dozen frosted cupcakes, cream swirls topped with chocolate, past strings of bulb lights. She sets the tray on a wooden table beside a small card that reads Welcome, walks to the glass door and knocks, then comes back, sits down alone at the table with the city skyline glowing behind her and reaches for the tray.

5110.title: quiet_5110
5110.asset_description: A watercolour painting of an empty wooden park bench standing on a path in a misty park. Bare grey trees fade into the fog behind it, fallen brown and orange leaves cover the ground, long shadows stretch across the path, and a single dried leaf lies alone on the seat of the bench. There is not a single person anywhere in the scene.

5111.title: nurse_5111
5111.asset_description: A soft cartoon hospital room. A smiling woman in pink scrubs and a white cap, a thermometer tucked behind her ear and a clipboard under one arm, leans over a hospital bed in white gloves and adjusts the pillow of a small child who lies under a yellow blanket with a spotted rash on the arms and face. A drip bag hangs on a stand beside the bed, and a vase with a daisy and a glass of water stand on the bedside table.

5112.title: grain_5112
5112.asset_description: A bold ink illustration over a wave-patterned background. Two hands in blue sleeves have just thrown food into the air above a wooden bowl that tips on a plank table: spinach leaves, halved tomatoes, walnuts and almonds, blueberries and red berries, slices of salmon, halved boiled eggs and a falling shower of small golden grains of rice or oats. A few loose grains have already landed in the empty bowl.

5113.title: advice_5113
5113.asset_description: In a bright consulting room a woman in a teal polo shirt and glasses sets bowls of food down on a wooden table in front of a young man in a yellow t-shirt: a bowl of spinach, tomatoes and a yellow pepper, a bowl of brown rice, a grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of mixed nuts and a tall glass of milk. A food pyramid poster hangs on the wall behind them. She points at the food and talks him through it; he leans in, looks at each dish and nods, and she puts a hand on his shoulder as they finish.

5114.title: flamingo_5114
5114.asset_description: Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

5115.title: study_5115
5115.asset_description: In a meadow full of wild flowers a young woman in an olive rain jacket and a cap, her red hair in plaits, crouches down to a fallen wooden log lying in the grass. She holds a magnifying glass over a small green insect sitting on the bark and moves in close, her eye almost against the lens, studying it from a few centimetres away. Then she turns to an open notebook lying in the grass, full of pencil drawings of insects, and adds a new sketch with her pencil.

5116.title: open_5116
5116.asset_description: A hand pushes a small frosted kitchen window outwards above a steel sink, letting daylight and a potted plant on the outside sill into the dim room. Cut to a young man in a pale linen shirt striding through a bright Paris apartment towards the windows. He grabs the long white curtains and throws them apart, then swings the tall casement windows open over the rooftops. Finally he pushes both leaves of the balcony doors wide open with his arms spread and walks out onto the wrought-iron balcony into full sun.

5117.title: bookstore_5117
5117.transcript: Oh! Oh! Aha! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Whoa!
5117.asset_description: A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.

5118.title: sunlight_5118
5118.asset_description: Low morning sun pours through an open kitchen window over a dark worktop and a sink, with two potted herbs on the sill and rooftops beyond. A young man in a loose white shirt turns and walks down a bright hallway with a strip of sunlight across the parquet floor. He reaches the tall French windows, pushes them open and stands in the doorway as the sun floods over him. He steps out onto the small balcony, arms spread, and looks over the sunlit Paris rooftops with the sun low in a clear blue sky.

5119.title: entrance_5119
5119.asset_description: A large crowd in summer clothes is packed in front of two huge studded wooden gates set in a grey stone archway, with pink and white bunting strung above them. Two members of staff push the gates apart from the inside and a bright strip of the park appears between them. As the gates swing fully open a painted carousel comes into view beyond the archway. The crowd streams forward through the entrance and out into the fairground, a young woman in a red dress laughing and running ahead of them towards the carousel.

5120.title: surgeon_5120
5120.asset_description: A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.

5121.title: remove_5121
5121.asset_description: A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.

5122.title: achieve_5122
5122.asset_description: A short montage of young people finishing hard things. A woman in leggings hangs high on an indoor climbing wall and reaches for the last hold at the top. A young man in a gym drives a loaded barbell up out of a deep front squat, straining. A runner in black crosses a finish line on a red track with both arms thrown up and her mouth open in a shout while spectators watch. A young man in a sports hall presses the last piece into a big floor puzzle and beams straight at the camera. A woman finishes a set of floor exercises on a turf pitch, and finally a group of athletes crowd into a selfie with their fists raised, all shouting in celebration.

5123.title: flood_5123
5123.asset_description: A cup under a coffee machine has filled past the brim and coffee is running out over the black worktop and pouring off the edge onto the kitchen floor. A young man in a purple hoodie rushes in and finds the kitchen sink filled to overflowing, the tap still running and white foam and water sheeting down the cupboard doors onto the tiles. He runs down the hallway to the bathroom, where the bathtub is full to the rim and a wall of foam is pouring over the side and spreading across the floor. He stands in the doorway with his hands in his hair, shouting, as the foam keeps rising out of the tub.

5124.title: marathon_5124
5124.asset_description: A phone-held point-of-view shot from inside a road race: the camera runs with the pack along a narrow cobbled street in an old town, passing other runners in numbered vests. Spectators stand behind metal barriers on both sides and clap as the runners go by. The camera drifts sideways past several runners, then holds on one runner in a blue vest striding away up the street between tall pastel buildings.

5125.title: stage_5125
5125.asset_description: Filmed from the seats of an old theatre, a play is being performed on the lit stage. A costumed actor with a moustache sits on a golden throne wearing a metal helmet while actors dressed as ragged peasants storm him with makeshift weapons. They tip the throne over and he tumbles onto a white mattress laid on the boards; a woman in rags holds the helmet up over her head and the whole auditorium rises, cheering and applauding.

5126.title: business_5126
5126.asset_description: A loose watercolour and ink drawing of a small corner shop with a striped awning and a wide glass front full of shelves of goods. On the stone step in front of the open door a middle-aged man in a shirt, braces and work trousers laughs with his arms flung wide, a key held in one raised hand, as if showing off the place he owns. A geranium in a terracotta pot stands beside him on the pavement.

5127.title: shut_5127
5127.asset_description: In a bedroom papered with travel posters, a young woman kneels over a hard-shell suitcase lying open on the bed. She folds T-shirts and stacks them in until the case is heaped over the rim, then grabs the lid and swings it down. It will not close, so she climbs on top, sits on the lid with her whole weight and presses it down with both hands, pulling faces the whole time.

5128.title: hurt_5128
5128.asset_description: In a bright living room a young man in a grey tracksuit bangs his leg on the corner of the sofa. He throws his head back with his mouth wide open, hops on one foot into the hallway, doubles over and clutches his shin with both hands. He slides down the wall by the doorframe, sits on the floor with his face screwed up and keeps holding the sore leg.

5129.title: cover_5129
5129.asset_description: An empty room being redecorated: the furniture is hidden under grey plastic sheeting and the floor is spread with white dust sheets. A young man in paint-spattered dungarees, headphones round his neck, rolls terracotta paint over a grey wall with a roller on a pole. He works across and up until the whole wall is orange, then reaches up and starts peeling the masking tape off the top edge.

5130.title: kite_5130
5130.asset_description: A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.

5131.title: focus_5131
5131.asset_description: A pen-and-ink drawing of a narrow alley between old brick houses. A young man in a shalwar kameez swings a cricket bat at a tennis ball that is right in front of the bat face; his eyes are locked on the ball and his brow is furrowed. Boys sit on a wall behind him watching, another man watches from a doorstep, tangled electric wires cross overhead and dust puffs up around his feet.

5132.title: mixture_5132
5132.asset_description: In a bright home kitchen a young man in a beanie makes a pancake. A knob of butter melts and slides across a large non-stick pan on the hob.
