He holds a ladle high over the pan and pours a thick pale batter into it in a steady stream; the batter spreads into a wide circle and bubbles rise on its surface. At the end he lifts the pan off the hob and tilts it towards the camera to show the browned pancake.

5133.title: scream_5133
5133.asset_description: In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.

5134.title: parent_5134
5134.asset_description: Four short scenes of a mother and a father looking after their children. The mother spoons food from a bowl into a baby's mouth in a high chair while the father steadies the chair. Both of them kneel on a rug and help two toddlers stack a tall tower of coloured wooden blocks. At night the mother leans over a bed and tucks a boy under a blue duvet, and the father sits beside the next bed reading a picture book to a girl. Finally children run and swing in a sunny playground while the adults stand and watch.

5135.title: space_5135
5135.asset_description: On a narrow town street at golden hour a woman edges a small blue hatchback into a tight kerbside gap between a white car in front and another car behind, leaning out of the open driver's window as she manoeuvres. The car settles into the gap beside the paved pavement, with shop fronts and cafe tables behind it. She then gets out, shuts the door and walks away along the pavement in the low sun.

5136.title: debate_5136
5136.asset_description: A wood-panelled debating chamber with green leather benches. A man in a dark suit stands up on a bench, arm outstretched, arguing loudly across the floor. On the benches opposite, rows of seated politicians shout back and wave sheets of paper in the air. A public gallery runs above, and a brass despatch box sits on the table in the foreground.

5137.title: parliament_5137
5137.asset_description: Inside a large circular legislative chamber. A woman in a black suit stands among the seated members and raises her hand to vote. The camera pulls back to show the whole hall: hundreds of members in curved rows of desks, packed public balconies above, everyone standing and applauding. A man then speaks from the podium at the centre while the seated members listen.

5138.title: train_5138
5138.asset_description: A young woman in a mustard beanie climbs the steps into a train while a member of staff helps lift her hard-shell suitcase; another train and travellers with luggage are on the platform behind her. Inside, she walks down the narrow carriage corridor holding her ticket, heaves the suitcase onto the overhead rack, then sits by the window and watches the platform and rails slide past as the train pulls away.

5139.title: blank_5139
5139.asset_description: A young man in an airport holds an open passport towards the camera and fans the pages: every page is plain white, with nothing on it. He grins, then hands the passport across an immigration counter where an officer's stamp and a screen sit. Later, at a table, he opens the same passport to show pages now crowded with coloured entry stamps and visas, before flicking through it again.

5140.title: allow_5140
5140.asset_description: At an airport border control desk, an officer in a peaked cap and uniform takes a passport, opens it on the black counter and inks a rubber stamp. He presses the stamp down and a large green tick appears on the page. The traveller lifts the passport up: the whole spread is covered in blue ticks, coloured stamps, little aeroplanes and a green cross. A woman in a yellow beanie then holds the stamped passport up to the camera, free to walk on, with the queue of waiting travellers behind her.

5141.title: doctor_5141
5141.asset_description: In a bright surgery, a man in a white coat examines a young man in a checked shirt sitting on the examination couch. He holds the patient's mouth open and looks down his throat, then listens to his back with a stethoscope, then wraps a blue blood-pressure cuff around his upper arm. He gives a thumbs up; the young man laughs and flexes his bicep, and the doctor hands him a small colourful card.

5142.title: neighborhood_5142
5142.asset_description: An older man in denim overalls stands on a stepladder outside a clapboard house and pins a string of red, white and blue triangular bunting under the porch roof, then hangs a large striped flag beside the front door. A wider shot shows the same thing happening along the whole street: other men on ladders at their own porches, flags on the houses opposite, and a small child with painted cheeks running across the front lawn behind a wooden picket fence. In the last shots the man stands on the pavement in the middle of the decorated street, bunting strung above him and neighbours waving from the gardens on both sides, and puts his hand flat on his chest.

5143.title: peace_5143
5143.asset_description: A stained-glass panel in strong leaded colours. Two soldiers in helmets and different uniforms - one in green, one in grey - lean towards each other over a churned strip of ground and shake hands, their heads bowed. Both of their rifles are stuck muzzle-down in the earth in front of them. Above their joined hands a large white dove flies out of a burst of blue and yellow light with a green sprig in its beak. Behind them are broken fence posts and green fields, and red, blue and purple wildflowers grow out of the bare soil in the foreground.

5144.title: dove_5144
5144.asset_description: Two elderly men in suits meet in front of a tall white stone monument under a clear blue sky, shake hands warmly and then pull each other into a long hug while a crowd of onlookers watches. Rows of schoolgirls in navy uniforms line both sides of the paved square, each holding a wicker basket with white birds sitting inside. The girls tip the baskets open and the white birds burst upwards, first a handful and then dozens, until the whole sky above the monument is filled with them. The two men stand together at the centre looking up at the birds.

5145.title: tram_5145
5145.asset_description: A young man in an orange hooded jacket with a bag strapped across his chest walks quickly along a brick pavement in a Dutch city, past shoppers and parked bicycles. He steps off the kerb and crosses a wide zebra crossing while the light shows red for cars, then hurries down a narrow lane lined with flower stalls full of tulips and bunches in buckets. He comes out on a big paved square where a long blue and white electric train runs along rails in the street right behind him, with cyclists passing in front of it. He looks down at his wrist as he keeps walking with the tram still rolling past behind him.

5146.title: strip_5146
5146.asset_description: A woman in a bright headscarf and a floral apron sits on a sunny terrace with a big patterned bowl of apples and potatoes on her lap. She turns a red apple against a small knife so that the skin comes away in one continuous ribbon rather than in pieces. The red and white ribbon gets longer and longer, curling over the edge of the bowl and hanging down past her knees towards the floor while she keeps turning the apple. She looks at the camera with her eyes and mouth wide open at how long the unbroken ribbon has become. Behind her are terracotta roof tiles, red geraniums in pots and washing on a line.

5147.title: people_5147
5147.asset_description: A low shot follows the legs of men and women in dark suits carrying shopping bags as they stride across a wide striped crossing. The camera then moves into a covered market arcade so full that shoulders and backpacks touch: shoppers in coats and school blazers press slowly past stalls hung with food and signs. Finally the view rises above a huge city junction, where hundreds of walkers pour off every kerb at once and fill the whole crossing from both directions under tall buildings and video screens, until the road cannot be seen for the moving mass of them.

5148.title: morning_5148
5148.asset_description: Early light over an empty paved plaza: a person in a mustard coat stands at the edge with a flock of grey birds pecking in front of them, then the birds lift off low across the stones. Inside a deserted station hall the same person stands alone at the foot of a bank of escalators under the bright ceiling lights. They sit by themselves on a long empty row of seats with a canvas bag beside them, sipping from a can. In the last shot they stand in the middle of a wide boulevard, alone on the white stripes of the crossing with no traffic at all, while the sun comes up between the buildings and the trees behind them.

5149.title: pharmacy_5149
5149.asset_description: A young man with a red, sore nose stands at a lit pharmacy window under a green cross sign while a hand behind the glass passes him a small box of medicine. He then waits inside a modern pharmacy under a red digital queue-number display, carrying a paper bag, and pays at a self-service terminal. Finally he stands open-mouthed inside a grand old pharmacy whose walls are floor-to-ceiling wooden drawers, watching a pharmacist in a white coat climb a tall wooden ladder to fetch something from the top row.

5150.title: prescription_5150
5150.asset_description: A young man in a dark red bomber jacket walks into a small pharmacy past a lit green cross. At the counter he holds out a folded white slip of paper to the pharmacist in a white coat, who reads it, turns to the wall of medicine boxes behind her and picks out the packet the paper asks for. She comes back and hands him the medicine across the glass counter, and he takes it and smiles.

5151.title: frame_5151
5151.asset_description: An elderly man in a patterned cardigan stands by a bright window holding up a small painting of a mountain valley in a silver moulded border, turning it so the camera can see it. He carries it to a hallway wall already filled with dozens of bordered landscape pictures, lifts it onto a hook and nudges the edges until it hangs straight among the others. He steps back and stands beside the finished wall, which runs the whole length of the hallway.

5152.title: bedroom_5152
5152.asset_description: A young woman in a white t-shirt and jeans stands in a small yellow-walled room with a curtained window and an empty wooden bed frame, and pats a single white pillow down onto the bare slats. She then starts flinging brightly coloured pillows onto the frame one after another — pink, turquoise, yellow, green, cream — until they are heaped high above the bed. She walks up to the heap, laughing, and finally drops backwards into it so that only her face and one hand still show above the colours.

5153.title: bed_5153
5153.asset_description: Two young people work outdoors in a sunny hillside garden, bent over a long raised wooden bed filled with dark soil. He presses small green seedlings into the soil one by one while she loosens the earth beside him with a hand trowel, and a row of identical seedlings appears down the length of the bed. A wide shot shows several parallel raised beds, one of them already planted, and the two of them stepping back with their tools to look at the finished rows.

5154.title: houseplant_5154
5154.asset_description: A man in a white linen shirt stands at an open window with jungle and rice terraces behind it. He presses a tiny seedling into the soil of a terracotta pot standing on the windowsill, then lifts a metal watering can and pours water over it. The shot opens onto a room crowded with indoor plants - monsteras, ferns and trailing vines in pots on the floor, on stands and hanging in baskets from the ceiling - and he stands among them looking up at them.

5155.title: lunch_5155
5155.asset_description: A woman in a blue shirt lowers a large empty white plate onto a wooden dining table by a sunny window. A serving spoon lifts rigatoni and spaghetti in tomato sauce out of a pan and sets a portion on the plate, finished with a basil leaf. The camera pulls back over a long table laid with cutlery and many identical plates of pasta, a family already seated around it in the midday light, and the woman spreads her arms to invite everyone to eat.

5156.title: kneel_5156
5156.asset_description: Under floodlights on a small caged pitch, a footballer in a yellow number 10 shirt takes the ball past a defender in dark blue, drives into space and finishes. He runs towards the goal, drops down onto his knees on the grass and stays there, head back, mouth wide open, shouting, until a teammate in the same yellow shirt arrives and grabs him round the shoulders while spectators press against the fence behind them.

5157.title: neighbourhood_5157
5157.asset_description: On a cobbled street in a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses, a young man in a yellow vest keeps a football up with his foot while a bigger man in a dark T-shirt watches him. People come out of the doorways and windows of the houses around them and a game starts in the middle of the street, with folded shirts and a small metal frame for goals and women watching from balconies and doorsteps. It ends with all the players running together into one laughing huddle in the road.

5158.title: connect_5158
5158.asset_description: A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.

5159.title: wet_5159
5159.asset_description: A cartoon kitchen: a plumber in blue overalls and a red cap lies on his back on the tiled floor under an open sink cupboard, holding a big red pipe wrench. A pipe under the sink has burst and a jet of water hits him full in the face and soaks him while he grins. Puddles spread over the tiles, an open red toolbox stands beside him, a hammer and pliers lie on the floor, and an elderly woman in an apron watches from the doorway with a worried face.

5160.title: dash_5160
5160.asset_description: A black-and-white ink drawing of a rainy night on an old European market square: a young man in a long open coat runs at full stride across the wet cobbles, arms swinging, while a dozen pigeons burst into flight around him. Rain streaks down the sky, a tall church tower, a clock tower and an arcaded market hall stand behind him, a lit street lamp glows on the right, and the lamplight reflects in the puddles between the cobblestones.

5161.title: cathedral_5161
5161.asset_description: A young man in an orange rain jacket with a backpack films himself on a big city square in front of a brick church tower while pigeons take off around him, then at a wooden railing above a turquoise mountain lake ringed with rock walls, then at a wooden table in a restaurant where he lifts a spoonful from a plate piled with fried dumplings and eats with wide, delighted eyes.

5162.title: beautiful_5162
5162.asset_description: A young man in an orange jacket stands with both arms spread wide on a cobbled square in front of a twin-towered brick church while a flock of pigeons flies up around him, then looks back at the camera from a wooden fence above a bright turquoise lake ringed with pine trees and mountains, then sits at a wooden table in a log restaurant behind a big white plate stacked with browned dumplings and forks them into his mouth with wide eyes.

5163.title: politician_5163
5163.asset_description: A black-and-white comic panel of a political meeting: two men in suits stand on wooden podiums either side of a flight of steps in a hall with tall columns and hanging banners, leaning forward and pointing at each other with angry faces. Below them a packed crowd in suits raises fists and blank white placards, and a giant wooden gavel comes down into the frame from the top right corner.

5164.title: campaign_5164
5164.asset_description: A woman in a red campaign T-shirt pastes election posters onto a city wall with a wide brush, smoothing down a blue poster with a candidate's silhouette; then two candidates in suits argue from glass lecterns on a brightly lit debate stage in front of a seated audience and a moderator; then, at a night rally, a crowd holds up red and blue placards, confetti falls, and a young woman in a red shirt cheers with her fist in the air.

5165.title: plastic_5165
5165.asset_description: A woman in navy overalls and work gloves stands knee-deep in a brown river whose surface is covered with floating plastic bottles, plastic cups, plastic bags and white foam; a factory with a smoking chimney and pipes stands on the bank behind her. She bends down, pulls a plastic bottle out of the water, grimaces at it, and straightens up holding it while more rubbish drifts past along the shore.

5166.title: track_5166
5166.asset_description: An illustrated hillside street in an old Portuguese city at sunset. Washing hangs on lines strung between the pastel houses. A yellow tram comes down the slope on the right with sparks flying from the wheel where it meets the metal rails set into the cobbles. A young woman with a shoulder bag is caught mid-leap off the tram's step onto the street, and the sea and the setting sun fill the gap at the end of the road. Two parallel rails run from the bottom of the frame up the middle of the cobbled street.

5167.title: tile_5167
5167.asset_description: A selfie-POV clip through a Portuguese city. A young man holds the camera at arm's length while riding on the open step of a yellow tram down a steep narrow street at sunset. Next he walks along a building whose whole facade is covered in blue-and-white painted tiles; he presses his palm flat against them and looks up the wall. Then he is at a marble cafe table, breaking into a sugar-dusted custard tart with a fork beside an espresso, and eating it with a delighted look at the camera.

5168.title: batch_5168
5168.asset_description: In a small tiled bakery a woman in a white shirt, apron and headscarf slides a tray of custard tarts out of a wood-fired oven whose flames are still burning. She sets the tray on the marble counter, straightens the tarts in their tins and sprinkles powder over them. She then carries the tray to the shop front and holds it out to a small girl, who takes a tart and bites into it, while a crowd of people behind the girl claps and shouts its approval.

5169.title: mail_5169
5169.asset_description: A young man in glasses and a cardigan sits at a metal cafe table by the sea, writing on the back of a picture postcard with a blue biro; a stamp lies on the table beside it. He then stands at a rotating rack of postcards on a village street, turning it and pulling out a fan of cards. Finally he stands at a yellow street postbox, holds the postcard to his lips, pushes it through the slot and pats the box.

5170.title: package_5170
5170.asset_description: A postman in a bright red high-visibility uniform and red cap wheels a red bicycle along a street of English terraced houses; a red bag stuffed with letters hangs from the handlebars. He pushes a bundle of letters through the letter slot of a red front door, knocks on the door, waves to a woman watering her front garden, hands a wrapped birthday parcel over a brick garden wall to a resident, then rides off smiling at the camera.

5171.title: add_5171
5171.asset_description: A grey-haired man in a striped shirt and apron stands at a hob in a small kitchen with a tall stainless steel stockpot in front of him. He tips a board of chopped carrots, potatoes and red peppers into the empty pot, then pours a jug of golden stock in on top of them. Wearing a padded oven glove he lowers the lid onto the pot; steam rises when he takes it off again, and he stirs the finished vegetable stew with a wooden spoon, smiling at the camera.

5172.title: bang_5172
5172.asset_description: A rustic farm-shop kitchen with shelves of jars and crates of fruit. A young man in an apron slams both palms down onto a round of bread dough on a floured table. Then a pair of hands drives a heavy stone pestle down again and again into a mortar full of peppercorns and dried chillies. A woman in denim beats a djembe drum hard with her palms, laughing. Another man swings a heavy rubber mallet down onto the dough, and then pounds the pestle into the mortar with both fists.

5173.title: raincoat_5173
5173.asset_description: A hand holds a metal bottle under a thin fall of water trickling off a mossy cliff and fills it; then a woman in a bright red hooded raincoat with an orange backpack walks along a wet path, reaches into the spray of a small waterfall, and finally stands in front of a huge waterfall, mouth open, looking up at it.

5174.title: cheerful_5174
5174.asset_description: At an outdoor dinner table at dusk a young woman in a bright patterned dress pours orange juice from a glass jug into tall glasses while older relatives sit around the loaded table, laughing and clapping; she finally lifts the jug high over her head and pours a long stream into a glass.

5175.title: moustache_5175
5175.asset_description: In a busy restaurant a waiter with a thick black moustache, in a white shirt and dark apron, sets down a glass, then lifts a metal pot high above his head and pours a long thin stream of tea into a small tulip glass on the table without spilling, and finally lowers the pot and looks up.

5176.title: mug_5176
5176.asset_description: A run of pours in a kitchen: dark coffee streams from a carafe into a big white mug standing on the counter, pale pancake batter is poured into a black frying pan on the stove, golden syrup is drizzled over a tall stack of pancakes, and finally sparkling wine is poured into the top glass of a champagne tower.

5177.title: teapot_5177
5177.asset_description: A young woman with red braids in denim dungarees leans over a wooden garden table and pours tea from a white teapot into a small cup on a saucer, then pours orange juice from a glass jug into a row of tall glasses, and finally tips a clay pitcher of juice into a large glass bowl.

5178.title: headscarf_5178
5178.asset_description: In a white kitchen a woman in a navy headscarf opens the door of a tall built-in oven, turns to a baking tray of chocolate chip cookies on the counter beside her, lifts it, and slides it onto the rack inside the lit oven.

5179.title: reach_5179
5179.asset_description: A woman in a navy headscarf and lilac sleeves stands beside an open built-in oven that glows orange inside; she carries a metal tray of pale dough balls over, stretches her free hand out toward the open oven to feel the heat, then slides the tray onto the rack and closes the door.

5180.title: speaker_5180
5180.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a man in a dark suit and tie standing at a tall wooden lectern on a stage; a spotlight falls on him from behind heavy drawn curtains, flags stand on either side, and he raises one open hand as he talks into a slim microphone.

5181.title: signature_5181
5181.asset_description: A grey-haired woman in a burgundy suit steps out of a black limousine onto a red carpet in front of a white palace lined with flags and guards and waves to the cameras, then sits at a desk and signs a document with a black fountain pen, holds the open folder up to show the fresh blue signature, and finally raises both arms to a cheering crowd from a balcony.

5182.title: achievement_5182
5182.asset_description: A woman in paint-spattered dungarees and a headband paints the last strokes of a huge mural of suns and waves on a city wall from a stepladder, then climbs down, backs onto the pavement and stands with her hands on her hips, looking up at the finished painting and smiling.

5183.title: passionate_5183
5183.asset_description: A charcoal sketch of a lecture hall. An elderly man with wild white hair, round glasses and a long flowing coat strides at a blackboard, one arm flung out to write while a piece of chalk flies through the air behind him and his other hand is spread wide. The board is packed with arrows and diagrams; rows of students sit at desks behind him writing. His whole body is thrown into the explanation.

5184.title: romantic_5184
5184.asset_description: On a cobbled stone bridge at sunset a young man in a grey suit drops onto one knee and holds up an open ring box to a young woman in a yellow dress. She claps both hands over her mouth in tears. A close-up shows the diamond ring in the black velvet box against the golden sunset; an accordion player and passers-by watch from behind. She says yes, they laugh, and she throws her arms around him as strangers applaud.

5185.title: kindness_5185
5185.asset_description: Heavy rain on a city street. A frail elderly man in a dark jacket stands soaked, clutching a paper bag with two baguettes in it. A young person in a black raincoat steps in behind him and holds a big yellow umbrella over his head, taking all the rain themselves, then puts an arm around his shoulders. Water pours off the umbrella. The two walk on together under it and the old man smiles.

5186.title: public_5186
5186.asset_description: A colourful cartoon of a busy town square seen from above. Ordinary people of every age fill it: two old men feed pigeons from benches, a jogger in a headband runs past, a woman pushes a pram, a man in a suit checks his watch, a boy cycles by in a green helmet, a long-haired busker plays guitar by a stone fountain, teenagers chat at the fountain rim, and shoppers walk in front of a row of pastel shopfronts. A pigeon sits on the frame at the top.

5187.title: wagon_5187
5187.asset_description: A sunny mown grass field under a clear blue sky. A teenage boy in a white t-shirt and black shorts leans right back and hauls a thick rope towards himself hand over hand, face screwed up with the strain. The camera pulls back and the other end of the rope turns out to be tied to a green two-wheeled farm wagon, which rolls slowly across the grass behind him. He gets it moving, drops the rope and grins.

5188.title: disappointment_5188
5188.asset_description: Two men on a wooden jetty on a still lake at dusk. A bearded man in a bucket hat fights a deeply bent fishing rod, winding the reel hard, sure he has a big fish. His friend sprints up the jetty with a landing net ready. What breaks the surface and swings up onto the planks is a green rubber boot full of water and weed. Both men stop dead and stare at it, the friend lowering the useless net.

5189.title: weather_5189
5189.asset_description: A wet cobbled street outside a Paris cafe under a grey sky. An elderly man with a white moustache, a flat cap and a beige trench coat holds his bare palm out flat to feel whether it is still raining, a folded red umbrella under his arm. Drops keep falling, so he lifts the umbrella, opens it with a snap over his head and stands under it, smiling at the camera while rain streaks past and other people pass behind him with their own umbrellas up.

5190.title: windy_5190
5190.asset_description: A young woman stands in the pouring rain on a wet village street wearing a clear plastic rain jacket, grinning at the camera. She then appears in a bright yellow raincoat, doing up the front and pulling the hood up over her hair while rain falls around her. In the last part she stands on a seafront promenade in an orange raincoat and spotted rubber boots, grey sky above, big waves smashing over the railing behind her, and she spreads her arms wide as the wind and spray hit her.

5191.title: snowy_5191
5191.asset_description: On a flat white plain that is covered in snow to the horizon, a woman in a thick orange polar parka with a fur-trimmed hood holds a rope on a metal flagpole. A Norwegian flag climbs the pole against a deep blue sky. Two more people in the same orange parkas pull on the rope together to hoist the flag while others stand around holding mugs, a small hut on the snow behind them. The flag reaches the top and flaps in the wind above the group.

5192.title: horizon_5192
5192.asset_description: Close up on black gloved hands gripping a white rope on a flagpole, a red flag bunched at the top of the frame; behind, a flat field of snow runs out to a straight line where the white ground meets the blue sky. Three people in orange polar suits pull the rope together and the red flag climbs the pole. In the wide shots the empty snow plain stretches to that same distant line in every direction, with one small dark hut on it. The four of them finish standing at the foot of the pole, looking up at the flag.

5193.title: rash_5193
5193.asset_description: Two young women in gardening dungarees sit on a wooden bench in a green garden. One of them, red-haired, screws her face up in pain and holds out her bare forearm, which is covered in a patch of angry red blotchy spots, and scratches at it with her fingers. Her friend uncaps a white tube of cream and squeezes a blob onto the red patch, then it is rubbed into a white circle over the spots. The red-haired one winces and grimaces at the sting while her friend laughs beside her.

5194.title: novel_5194
5194.asset_description: A young blonde woman sits curled up on a grey sofa in a bright living room, a white curtained window behind her. She holds a thick paperback open in both hands and reads it, her lips moving slightly as her eyes track the lines. She smiles at something on the page and turns over a page. At the end she closes the book, holds it on her lap and looks up and away with a satisfied smile.

5195.title: bench_5195
5195.asset_description: A young man in a yellow beanie and denim jacket sits on a long wooden slatted seat in a green park, trees and paths behind him. Several books are spread out along the seat next to him and a huge open volume lies across his knees. He picks up a small dark red book, then bends over the big open one, flipping through its pages faster and faster with his mouth open. At the end he lifts the enormous brown book right up over his head with both hands and stares up at it.

5196.title: bun_5196
5196.asset_description: A young woman with glasses and her blonde hair twisted up into a round knot on top of her head stands reading a paperback in a moving tram, city buildings sliding past the windows. She then sits cross-legged on a park bench in autumn sunshine, the same knot of hair on top, reading and yawning behind her hand. In the last shots she is under a blanket in the dark with a single candle burning beside the open book, eyes wide behind her glasses, then grinning as she reads on.

5197.title: rebel_5197
5197.asset_description: In a big open-plan Japanese office full of identical grey cubicles, a woman in a company uniform climbs up and stands on top of her desk, glaring down at the room while the other workers sit at their screens. One by one the workers stop working: sheets of paper and a necktie fly up into the air as men and women jump to their feet and punch their fists upward. At the end the whole floor is standing between the desks with their arms folded, staring straight ahead at the camera while loose paper lies scattered on the carpet.

5198.title: sheet_5198
5198.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a desk seen from the side. A doctor in blue scrubs with a stethoscope round her neck holds out a small written sheet of paper across the wooden table, and a man in a brown jacket reaches his hand out to take it. An open spiral notepad lies on the desk with a black fountain pen beside it, and a potted plant stands behind them.

5199.title: follow_5199
5199.asset_description: In a sunny kitchen a young woman in an apron and a green headscarf works through a handwritten page step by step. She leans over it and points at a line, chops cherry tomatoes on a board, tips them into a big bowl of cut vegetables, holds the page up and reads the next step, pours olive oil over the salad, then lays the page flat on the worktop and smiles at the finished bowl.

5200.title: lively_5200
5200.asset_description: Inside a bright living room several young people burst into motion one after another. A woman throws off a grey blanket on the sofa with a huge grin, a man springs forward out of an orange armchair, another drops to the carpet and pumps out press-ups, and then the whole group jumps, high-fives, claps and cheers around the coffee table.

5201.title: reflect_5201
5201.asset_description: A woman in a pink jacket and a woollen bobble hat stands on a flooded salt flat so still that it works like a mirror: her whole body, the snow-capped volcano and every cloud appear again upside down in the water below her. She crouches down, touches the surface with one fingertip so rings spread out, then stands up and walks away, small against the doubled sky.

5202.title: put_5202
5202.asset_description: A woman opens a big double-door fridge and finds it almost bare, with only one jar of pickles on a shelf. Then hands start placing food inside: an apple onto a glass shelf, a bag of lettuce and cucumbers onto the shelf below, jars and a juice carton into the door racks. At the end she steps back in front of a fridge packed with fruit, vegetables, milk and juice and her mouth falls open.

5203.title: relative_5203
5203.asset_description: A family arrives at a front door hung with a Christmas wreath. A man in a patterned jumper carries an iced cake in while more people come up the path behind him. Inside the hallway there are hugs and kisses on the cheek between grandparents, parents, teenagers and children, the hall fills up, and the whole group raises glasses together for a toast.

5204.title: improve_5204
5204.asset_description: Two people in paint-spattered dungarees work on a wrecked room whose walls are bare plaster with old paint peeling off in sheets. One hammers at a battered built-in shelf unit, the woman rolls fresh paint onto a wall while the man smooths the plaster beside her with a trowel, the camera pans across the wet cream paint, and then the same room appears finished: smooth painted walls, new wooden shelves, a plant and a clean tiled floor, with the two of them standing in it looking pleased.

5205.title: oath_5205
5205.asset_description: At an outdoor ceremony in front of a domed parliament building a woman in a dark suit raises her right hand and lays her other hand on a book held open in front of her while she speaks into a microphone. The crowd behind the barrier waves small red-white-and-blue flags and confetti drifts down. She then appears wearing a tricolour sash, waving to the cheering crowd, and finally turns on the stage and spreads both arms while photographers shoot from below.

5206.title: evidence_5206
5206.asset_description: In a library aisle a young woman in glasses builds an investigation board on a cork wall: she pins up notes and photographs, links them with red string, gasps as something clicks, flips through a sheaf of papers with a pen in her mouth, and steps back to look at the finished web of pinned pages, printed photos and sticky notes. Bookshelves, a laptop and stacks of books and papers surround her.

5207.title: sweat_5207
5207.asset_description: On a sunny alpine meadow below a wall of snow-covered peaks, two shirtless hikers with big backpacks toil up the grassy slope on trekking poles, skin glistening. One mops his face with his cap and sits down on a boulder, breathing hard; the other drops flat on his back in the grass with his arms out. They drink from water bottles and rest side by side, one sprawled on a wooden bench, the other on the rock.

5208.title: cuisine_5208
5208.asset_description: A young man in a suit sits down to three very different meals in three countries. At a blue plastic table on a narrow southern street a pan of meatballs in tomato sauce lands in front of him; in a trattoria with red checked cloths a waiter lifts the lid of a steaming tagine of stew; at a rooftop restaurant above a night skyline a plated steak with vegetables is uncovered under a silver cloche. Each time his eyes go wide with amazement.

5209.title: lounge_5209
5209.asset_description: A run of people settling into total idleness: a construction worker in a hi-vis vest drops back onto a living-room sofa with his boots up; a woman lies stretched out in a white hammock under palm trees with her hands behind her head; a shirtless man reclines on a striped beach lounger under an umbrella, sipping from a can; a man lies flat in a green field under a blue sky; a woman lounges in a hammock on the sand as the sun sets over the sea.

5210.title: retreat_5210
5210.asset_description: Three friends are having a picnic on a checked blanket in a park by a pond when a big white goose marches straight at them. They shuffle backwards with their hands raised, one still clutching a sandwich; as the goose spreads its wings they scramble to their feet and run off across the grass, abandoning the blanket. The goose stands on the blanket over the sandwiches, honking, while the group watches from a safe distance further down the path.

5211.title: return_5211
5211.asset_description: Keys hang in the lock of a wooden front door. A girl with braided hair hauls a sticker-covered suitcase in over the threshold, pulls it past the fridge into the flat, and stops in the middle of the living room with her arms spread wide, grinning as she takes in the familiar rooms. She spins round barefoot on the rug and then drops backwards onto her own bed, arms flung out.

5212.title: station_5212
5212.asset_description: Under the glass roof of a big railway station a family waits on the platform: a father in a cap, a mother in tears and a teenage son holding up a hand-drawn welcome sign, trains standing at the platforms behind them. A young woman with a rucksack and a duffel bag comes running out through the Arrivals doorway, drops her bag and throws herself into their arms. The four of them stand hugging on the platform, crying and laughing.

5213.title: railway_5213
5213.asset_description: On a covered platform a boy holds a blank white sign above his head and a woman waits beside him with a bouquet, a red train standing at the platform edge and the rails running away past them. Passengers come out of the train and walk down the platform with their cases; a young woman in a denim jacket runs along the platform towards a man with a rucksack and jumps into his arms. The whole group closes around them in a hug, the flowers still in someone's hand.

5214.title: desert_5214
5214.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat travels through three places. She cycles along an Amsterdam canal past gabled houses and rows of parked bicycles, then rides an electric scooter down a palm-lined seaside boardwalk under a blue sky, and finally sits on a camel plodding over bare orange sand dunes at sunset, a line of other camels behind her in the empty desert.

5215.title: cycling_5215
5215.asset_description: A woman in a colourful cycling kit and a white helmet rides a road bike fast along a coastal mountain road; the camera tracks her from the front while grey cliffs, a fjord and green slopes pass behind her, other riders roll along the road ahead, and she finishes by riding across a bridge over the water, still pedalling hard.

5216.title: stroll_5216
5216.asset_description: A woman in a long yellow dress with a film camera round her neck walks slowly through a narrow lantern-lit alley at dusk, then wanders between the stalls of a night flower market, and finally steps out onto a rooftop and spreads her arms in front of a city skyline at sunset.

5217.title: vest_5217
5217.asset_description: A smiling man in a yellow high-visibility vest pulled on over his t-shirt stands on a terracotta tiled roof above an Italian old town; the camera pans away from him across a sea of red-tiled roofs, bell towers and a green dome under a clear blue sky, then comes back to him as he throws an arm out toward the view.

5218.title: room_5218
5218.asset_description: A girl in a mustard cardigan opens one door after another in an old house: a dark panelled study, a small yellow kitchen, a bedroom with a patchwork quilt on the bed, and finally a tall vaulted hall with arched windows, which she walks into and turns around in.

5219.title: roommate_5219
5219.asset_description: Two young men who share a flat argue over a full black bin bag and settle it with rock-paper-scissors; one of them lifts the bag to take it out, then the two cook a big pot of pasta together and hold up plates, and finally sit side by side on the sofa with a bowl of crisps, playing a video game and shouting at the screen.

5220.title: clip_5220
5220.asset_description: A woodblock-style print of a deep red rose with a dew drop on one petal; a pair of iron garden shears is held open around the thorny green stem just below the flower, about to snip it off, while a single petal falls away through the air and leaves and a patterned sky fill the background.

5221.title: wind_5221
5221.asset_description: A woodblock-style print seen from above: a sandy path twists in long S-curves from the bottom of the picture, up and across green mountain ridges, and away toward a snow-capped peak in the distance. A lone traveller with a straw hat, cloak and walking staff is partway along it, small stone cairns mark the bends, and a blue lake with birds over it lies in the valley to the left.

5222.title: steps_5222
5222.asset_description: A hiker with a rucksack traces a red line across a laminated map with her finger, checks a trail information board at the edge of a forest, runs up a dusty path past a boulder painted with a red-and-white waymark, then climbs a long flight of stone steps built into the mountainside, and at the top holds the map up to the camera and points at the line she has just walked.

5223.title: route_5223
5223.asset_description: A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.

5224.title: royal_5224
5224.asset_description: A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.

5225.title: finish_5225
5225.asset_description: A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.

5226.title: carriage_5226
5226.asset_description: Under the glass-and-iron roof of a station, a man in a beige trench coat with a green duffel bag runs down the platform beside a long dark green train while other travellers walk the other way with suitcases. He reaches an open door in the side of the train, grabs the frame and hauls himself in as it starts to move. The last shot is from the platform looking into the open doorway: he is standing inside the lit interior of the train, holding his bag against his chest and looking back out.

5227.title: several_5227
5227.asset_description: A young woman in a neon yellow crop top and shorts jogs towards the camera along a wide paved seafront promenade lined with palm trees, with a beach and blue sea on one side. At first a single black-and-white border collie runs beside her. As she keeps going, more dogs of different breeds and colours appear from both sides and fall in with her, until she is jogging in the middle of a small group of about six dogs, laughing and throwing her arms up.

5228.title: snow_5228
5228.asset_description: A drawn illustration of a wide open city square in the middle of a heavy snowfall: thick white flakes fall across the whole picture and the cobblestones are buried under deep snow. A woman in a fur hat, a long fur-trimmed coat, mittens and boots pushes forward through the snow, her long scarf and coat blown sideways by the wind. Behind her stand a many-domed cathedral, a red brick tower and a flag on a pole, all of them white with settled snow, under a grey sky.

5229.title: handful_5229
5229.asset_description: A photograph taken on a bright, freezing winter morning in a snow-covered public square. A woman in a long dark fur coat, black gloves and a patterned fringed shawl stands side-on to the camera, has just scooped up as much powdery snow as her two hands could hold and thrown it upwards; the small cloud of snow hangs in the sunlight in front of her while the rest falls back down. Behind her rises a cathedral with brightly painted onion domes, with bare birch trees and snow-covered ground around it.

5230.title: doll_5230
5230.asset_description: A woman in a fur-flapped hat and a burgundy winter coat stands with her arms spread wide in a snowy square in front of a cathedral with coloured onion domes. She is then on a train, holding a glass of black tea in a metal holder and sipping it while snow-covered birch woods slide past the window. Finally she is at an evening winter market strung with fairy lights, smiling as she twists open a small painted wooden doll and holds up the two halves and the smaller doll from inside it.

5231.title: hospitality_5231
5231.asset_description: A big family sits along both sides of a long wooden table inside a log house with a lit stove behind them. A tall brass samovar steams in the middle of the table, which is loaded with a platter of dumplings, a stack of pancakes, dark rye bread, jars of pickles, radishes, cucumbers and jam. An elderly woman in a headscarf and apron works the samovar tap, filling glasses of tea and handing them round to the children and adults; at the end everyone reaches in and clinks their glasses together over the food.

5232.title: yacht_5232
5232.asset_description: A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.

5233.title: military_5233
5233.asset_description: Rows of young officers in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold shoulder cords and shiny buttons stand at attention and hold a salute, with rows of blue and yellow flags on poles behind them. The shot pulls back to a huge parade ground where hundreds of soldiers stand in straight blocks across the tarmac, a single officer in a beret out in front of them, while a crowd of spectators watches from behind steel barriers in the sunshine.

5234.title: rank_5234
5234.asset_description: Row after row of young women in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold cords and white gloves stand shoulder to shoulder in a parade square, each row exactly level with the next. They all hold a salute with the white-gloved hand at the cap. The camera moves back over the block of them, showing a packed stand of spectators and a line of national flags on tall poles behind the formation.

5235.title: cargo_5235
5235.asset_description: A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.

5236.title: distance_5236
5236.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a desert at sunset. A man in a white robe and red-and-white headscarf walks along the crest of a tall red dune, leading two loaded camels behind him. Sand sprays off the ridge under his feet. Far away across the flat desert, small in the haze, stands a cluster of glass office towers.

5237.title: star_5237
5237.asset_description: A short travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and a checked headscarf sprints up the crest of a red dune at dusk, then stands at a sandstone cliff face and touches carved figures and inscriptions cut into the rock. The clip ends at night by a campfire in the desert, under a sky thick with stars, where someone pours tea from a brass pot into his small cup and he lifts it towards the camera.

5238.title: dune_5238
5238.asset_description: A selfie-style travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and checked headscarf holds the camera at arm's length on a red dune with the sun setting behind him, laughing and turning. He then stands at a sandstone cliff and runs his hand over huge human figures carved out of the rock, tilting his head back to see the top of them. At night he sits by a campfire under a starry sky while tea is poured into his cup, and he holds the cup up smiling.

5239.title: release_5239
5239.asset_description: A charcoal sketch. A young man in a long robe and a checked headscarf strides forward across desert ground with his gloved arm thrown up and out. A falcon is lifting off his glove, wings fully open, its leash swinging loose from his hand. A pickup truck waits on the sand behind him.

5240.title: wing_5240
5240.asset_description: A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.

5241.title: chamber_5241
5241.asset_description: A science-fiction illustration of a sealed medical room. A young woman in a pale blue gown lies on a padded table that slides into the mouth of a large white ring-shaped machine; the opening glows with blue and green light. Cables and control panels line the metal walls. Behind a thick window on the left, a technician in dark uniform watches her and works at a lit console.

5242.title: elegant_5242
5242.asset_description: A woman in a silky champagne slip dress with a matching long satin robe stands at an open window in a Paris apartment. She sprays perfume onto her wrist, rubs her wrists together and sprays her neck, then walks slowly through the perfume mist, flicks her hair back and turns to the camera smiling. A table beside her is crowded with perfume bottles, and Paris rooftops are visible through the window.

5243.title: schedule_5243
5243.asset_description: A woman in a beige blazer works at a huge blank month calendar drawn on a white office wall. She writes in a tabbed spiral notebook on the desk, then presses coloured sticky notes into the empty date squares one after another until the whole month is covered in pink, orange, green and blue notes, and steps back to look at the finished plan.

5244.title: classmate_5244
5244.asset_description: Two teenage boys in navy school hoodies meet in a school corridor lined with coloured lockers and do a clasped-hand shake, laughing. Outside they sit on a wooden bench with their backpacks open, unwrapping a sandwich and holding a red apple while they talk. The shot then widens to the school field, where a crowd of students in the same navy uniform play football on the grass in front of the school building.

5245.title: chemical_5245
5245.asset_description: A cartoon laboratory: a young person in a white lab coat, orange goggles and rubber gloves holds a round flask of glowing purple liquid up above their head, mouth open in excitement, while swirling blue and pink smoke and floating bubbles rise out of it. Their other hand turns a dial on a big grey machine. The bench in front is covered with beakers and conical flasks of bubbling green and yellow liquid, and behind them stand test tubes of pink and purple liquid, boxy old monitors and shelves of jars.

5246.title: flask_5246
5246.asset_description: A young woman in a white lab coat, white cap and safety goggles works in a busy laboratory. She pipettes bright blue liquid into a rack of test tubes, swirls a conical glass flask of blue-green liquid over a hotplate, then holds the flask up to the light and smiles at it. She bends to a microscope with a flask of blue liquid beside her, and at the end holds up a flask of glowing pink liquid while a colleague at the next bench watches.

5247.title: footprints_5247
5247.asset_description: A trail of big muddy footprints runs the whole length of a white tiled hallway. A small elderly woman in an apron stands at one end holding a mop and wags her finger at a large young man in a black T-shirt who is holding a motorcycle helmet; his boots and his dog are both caked in mud. She hands him the mop, he lowers his head and takes it, and starts pushing it over the prints while the dog sits and watches.

5248.title: rent_5248
5248.asset_description: A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.

5249.title: wash_5249
5249.asset_description: A young man in a grey sweatshirt and mint-green rubber gloves stands at a kitchen sink and works on a blackened cast-iron frying pan, rubbing it hard with a soapy steel-wool pad until foam covers it. He lifts a heavy sooty pot out of the sink and scours its round underside, grimacing with the effort. He then hauls a cast-iron grill pan with a ridged rack out of the water, sets it over the sink and scours the black bars of the rack with both hands, foam and grime running off into the basin.

5250.title: call_5250
5250.asset_description: A drawn illustration of a smiling woman sitting at a wooden desk in a bright office. She wears a headset and also holds the handset of a corded desk telephone to her ear with one hand while she writes in an open notebook with the other. Behind her a round wall clock hangs above a filing cabinet stacked with coloured ring binders, and a window throws pale light across the wall. On the desk stand a coffee mug, a wooden paper tray holding a stack of blank sheets, a small potted plant and the edge of a keyboard.

5251.title: type_5251
5251.asset_description: An older woman with short white hair and red glasses sits behind a curved wooden reception counter in a busy open-plan office. She holds a corded telephone handset to her ear with one hand while her other hand moves over the keys of a keyboard on the counter in front of her. She then leans over an open ring notebook and writes in it with a pencil, still on the phone, and presses a rubber stamp down onto a sheet of paper. At the end she laughs and raises her hand to greet someone off camera. Behind her, colleagues work at desks with monitors and rows of files.

5252.title: tropical_5252
5252.asset_description: A street fruit seller in a conical straw hat stands behind an enormous pyramid of yellow and green mangoes stacked on her stall on a hot Vietnamese street, with scooters and shophouses passing behind her. A brass pan balance hangs on chains beside the fruit. She smiles, takes a mango, and holds open a brown paper bag; a close-up shows hands dropping spiky red rambutans into the bag over a bed of more rambutans and mangoes. A wide shot shows the whole mango pyramid with a pineapple perched on top under a blue awning. At the end she laughs happily and reaches across the wooden counter to hand the bag over.

5253.title: senior_5253
5253.asset_description: In a sunny green park, an old man with white hair, a flat cap and a beige suit strides and bounces along the path with his arms swinging, laughing at the camera. A grey-haired man in a cycling jersey pedals a bicycle along the same tree-lined path. Then a group of about ten white-haired women and men in summer dresses and light clothes stand spread out on a paved square doing a dance-exercise class together, arms stretched out to the side, all moving in time under the trees.

5254.title: partner_5254
5254.asset_description: In a green park an old man in a flat cap and tweed jacket dances along a path with his fists up, beaming. An old woman with white hair in a lilac cardigan leans down over a bed of bright orange marigolds and looks at them closely while a cyclist rides past behind her. Then several elderly couples dance together on a wide paved terrace under a blue sky with white clouds: one white-haired man holds his wife by the hand and waist and turns her, and the pair in the foreground hold each other by the shoulders, laughing into each other's faces as they dance.

5255.title: guilty_5255
5255.asset_description: A courtroom. An elderly judge in a red robe and white wig sits at a high wooden bench and reads a document aloud. A young man in a dark suit stands in the dock below her and stares up, shaken, as she speaks. She lifts a wooden gavel and strikes it on its block. A wide shot shows the packed court, barristers in wigs and gowns at their tables and a full public gallery.

5256.title: address_5256
5256.asset_description: A large wood-panelled hall of a court. A judge in a red robe and white wig stands at a raised lectern and speaks to the room from written notes. Five more judges in wigs and black gowns sit in a row behind him. In front of him a packed hall of seated people listens; a man at a table in the front row stands up while the judge is still speaking.

5257.title: butler_5257
5257.asset_description: A pencil and charcoal drawing of a man in a black tailcoat, white waistcoat and bow tie standing in the hall of a grand house. He holds a silver tray with a teapot, a milk jug and a cup on it in one raised hand, a folded white cloth over his forearm and his other hand behind his back, his head bowed towards the tray. Behind him a chandelier hangs above a curving staircase between marble columns.

5258.title: bar_5258
5258.asset_description: A rooftop bar at sunset. A laughing young woman in a bright patterned shirt stands behind a long counter and shakes a metal cocktail shaker beside her ear. A whole row of people along the counter shakes shakers with her in the same rhythm. Strings of light bulbs hang overhead, the sea and a pink sky are behind them, and glasses, juice bottles and steel tins stand on the counter.

5259.title: fur_5259
5259.asset_description: A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.

5260.title: shame_5260
5260.asset_description: A kitchen. A young man in a grey T-shirt sits at a counter and shovels a slice of strawberry cream cake into his mouth with a fork, cream smeared on his lips. A young woman in a purple cardigan appears in the doorway behind him and stands with her arms folded, staring at him. He freezes mid-bite, looks at her wide-eyed, pushes the plate away and finally hangs his head and hides his mouth behind his hand.

5261.title: share_5261
5261.asset_description: A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.

5262.title: stable_5262
5262.asset_description: A cartoon-style illustration of a room where a long wooden shelf has torn loose from its metal wall bracket and tipped downwards. Books, a framed picture, a ceramic vase and a potted plant slide off the tilted board and fall through the air. A young woman in an orange jumper and jeans throws herself backwards with her mouth open and her hands raised, and one book tumbles past the camera in the foreground.

5263.title: photograph_5263
5263.asset_description: A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.

5264.title: shift_5264
5264.asset_description: In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.

5265.title: container_5265
5265.asset_description: A young man with a camera round his neck stands on a wooden jetty in a container port. A small motorboat passes behind him while gantry cranes and stacks of steel shipping containers fill the far bank. He raises a pair of binoculars and watches a green ship loaded with containers glide past, then the white bow of an enormous cruise ship slides in right beside the jetty and he tips his head further and further back, open-mouthed, as its decks pass above him.

5266.title: telephone_5266
5266.asset_description: A retro cartoon illustration of a living room. A woman in a blue jumper and brown skirt bends forward with both gloved hands pressed to her open mouth, her eyes wide and her hair flying back, with jagged shock lines drawn around her head. On the floor beside her stands a cream rotary telephone; its handset has been dropped and hangs swinging on its coiled cord, with motion lines showing it still moving. A brown sofa and a table lamp stand behind her.

5267.title: gun_5267
5267.asset_description: At a biathlon shooting range, a female athlete in a turquoise race suit lies prone on a mat in the snow with her rifle resting on its stand. She sights along the barrel at a row of five round metal targets set out across the snow, works the bolt and fires. Officials and other athletes stand behind her by the fencing, and at the end she pushes herself up off the mat, smiling.

5268.title: rifle_5268
5268.asset_description: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.

5269.title: purchase_5269
5269.asset_description: A young woman in a beige coat and orange beret shops her way through a city: first in a wood-panelled chocolate shop where she holds up a chocolate bar, then at a clothes rail where she takes down an olive coat, then at the till where she hands the coat over and pays at the card terminal, then walking through the glass atrium of a shopping centre, and finally out through the doors holding a large white gift bag tied with a gold ribbon.

5270.title: supermarket_5270
5270.asset_description: A young woman in a supermarket aisle grabs cereal boxes off the shelves and throws them into her trolley as she pushes it down the aisle. The pile in the trolley grows shot by shot until, at the checkout, she stands beside a trolley stacked with a tower of cereal boxes far above her head.

5271.title: cry_5271
5271.asset_description: Three hikers with big backpacks stand at a wooden railing on the rim of the Grand Canyon under a clear blue sky. One after another they cup their hands round their mouths and yell out over the canyon with their mouths wide open, then all three yell together with their arms flung out towards the drop.

5272.title: hiker_5272
5272.asset_description: The same three backpackers at the Grand Canyon railing, filmed closer. The woman calls out over the canyon, the bearded man lets out a roar while she points at him laughing, and then all three throw their arms and fists up in the air and whoop together over the view.

5273.title: model_5273
5273.asset_description: A male model walks a fashion-show runway in a yellow denim jacket over a purple shirt and green trousers with white and yellow trainers. The catwalk is painted in soft colour blocks and rows of guests sit along both sides filming him. He walks towards the camera, turns at the end, checks the watch on his wrist and poses smiling in sunglasses.

5274.title: soaked_5274
5274.asset_description: A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.

5275.title: selfish_5275
5275.asset_description: A claymation scene in a living room: a boy in a striped jumper and a girl in dungarees each grip one end of a TV remote and pull it towards themselves, scowling at each other. Two bowls of popcorn are knocked over and popcorn is flying through the air. A clay dog stands beside them watching, and a blank TV glows on the stand behind the sofa.

5276.title: sibling_5276
5276.asset_description: Two young sisters chase each other around the sofa of a bright living room. They then drape a big white blanket over the dining chairs to build a den and grin out at the camera from the gap underneath. Next they face each other across a kitchen counter, snarling over a single chocolate-chip cookie on a paper plate, and finally each of them bites into her own cookie, laughing at the camera above the empty plate.

5277.title: agree_5277
5277.asset_description: A boy and a girl run through a living room, then whisper and laugh together under a white sheet stretched into a den. At a table they both grip the same chocolate-chip cookie and pull, faces screwed up, until it breaks into two halves and each keeps one. The clip ends in a sunny back garden where a big group of children run across the grass and then flop down in one laughing pile.

5278.title: corner_5278
5278.asset_description: A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.

5279.title: scroll_5279
5279.asset_description: A man in a dark suit sits at a polished wooden desk in a grand hall with EU and French flags behind him and writes a looping signature on a sheet of paper with a gold fountain pen. He works through a tall stack of pages, lifting each one as he signs. Then two aides unroll an enormous roll of paper the whole length of the table, and while photographers film he leans over it and signs it with an oversized pen.

5280.title: signpost_5280
5280.asset_description: A woman in a green fleece stands on a country lane beside a weathered wooden post whose two arms read VILLAGE and LAKE, and she touches one arm as she reads it. Next she stands in a town square under a tall metal post covered in arms pointing to MUSEUMS, HARBOUR and OLD BRIDGE, looking up at them. Finally the same kind of post stands on a grassy clifftop above the sea and she throws both arms up beside it, holding a water bottle.

5281.title: star_5281
5281.asset_description: A bright neon poster shows a young man in a shiny jacket on stage, eyes shut and mouth wide open as he belts into a hand-held microphone. Crossed beams of pink, yellow and blue spotlight sweep behind him and one arm is flung up above his head. Along the bottom the black silhouettes of a packed audience reach their hands up towards him.

5282.title: song_5282
5282.asset_description: Four scenes of people performing music with words. A grey-haired busker plays an acoustic guitar and sings into a microphone on a cobbled Lisbon street while a crowd stands round listening. A woman in a colourful apron sings into a wooden spoon in her kitchen while pots simmer behind her. Four friends belt out a number together in a car at night with the city lights behind them. Finally a performer in a white suit sings into a microphone on a huge arena stage in front of a packed, floodlit crowd.

5283.title: tower_5283
5283.asset_description: A woman in a bright patchwork shirt and headwrap lowers a huge column of colourful plates into a steel kitchen sink, adding more plates to the top of the stack. Water pours over the tall pile and white foam runs down its sides. She rinses the plates one by one and slots them into the draining rack, and the camera ends on the empty gleaming sink and its drain as she smiles down at it.

5284.title: metal_5284
5284.asset_description: An oil painting of a knight standing in a castle courtyard. He wears a full suit of polished plate armour that catches the light, a dark red cloak hangs behind him, he rests both gauntleted hands on the pommel of a long sword whose point is set on the ground, and he holds a feathered helmet under one arm. Castle towers, a banner and a flag stand behind him.

5285.title: happiness_5285
5285.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a young woman in a long blue-and-yellow dress swinging a small girl around by both hands in a sunny garden. Both are laughing, the girl's legs fly out behind her and her hair and ribbon stream sideways. Washing hangs on a line behind them, flowers grow at the edges and an empty wooden swing hangs from a tree.

5286.title: sweatshirt_5286
5286.asset_description: Two young women in a bedroom hung with fairy lights play tug-of-war over a lilac hooded sweatshirt, both laughing. They then bunch it up between them and pull faces at a phone held out at arm's length for a selfie. In the last third they sit on the bed and one plaits the other's hair while she gives a thumbs-up.

5287.title: silence_5287
5287.asset_description: Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.

5288.title: ski_5288
5288.asset_description: A skier in a red one-piece suit and helmet carves down a wide groomed piste in bright sun, throwing up a spray of snow on every turn. The camera follows from the side; behind him are snow-covered alpine peaks, a chairlift line and dozens of other skiers spread across the slope.

5289.title: moisture_5289
5289.asset_description: A soft painted illustration of a bare forearm and open hand against a cream background. A single clear drop of liquid sits on the inside of the forearm. In the top left a round magnifying inset shows the same skin close up, dry and cracked into a fine network of lines with visible pores.

5290.title: skyscraper_5290
5290.asset_description: A young woman in a beige trench coat with long braids walks along a palm-lined street in a hot, sunny Gulf city, tipping her head back to look up. Behind her rises a huge curved glass residential tower, and the clip ends on a slow tilt up the mirrored flanks of an enormous spire-topped skyscraper against the blue sky.

5291.title: businessman_5291
5291.asset_description: Inside a full airliner cabin. A blonde woman sleeps slumped against the window with her mouth open, then the shot pans back through the rows: a bearded man in a suit sleeps with a grey neck pillow, a man in a hoodie sleeps behind him, and further back rows of men in suits and jackets doze in their seats down the length of the dim cabin.

5292.title: productive_5292
5292.asset_description: A montage of people falling asleep where they should be awake: a young man at a computer in an open-plan office yawns hugely, then drops face down onto his keyboard; a student in a grey hoodie and glasses sleeps on an open book in a library; a man in a jacket sits slumped back on a park bench in bright sunshine with his head tipped back, asleep; a man in a grey tracksuit sprawls yawning on a sofa beside a coffee table holding a twin-bell alarm clock and a phone.

5293.title: glove_5293
5293.asset_description: Baseball action in a sunlit stadium: a runner in a white uniform slides feet first through the dirt towards the plate in a cloud of dust; an infielder in a colourful cap crouches low with a leather mitt on his hand as the umpire watches; the runner dives full length head first and reaches the base; the fielder scoops the ball into his glove; a final dive sends dust flying across the base line.

5294.title: slippers_5294
5294.asset_description: A woman in checked pyjamas and a beige cardigan stands barefoot on a cold tiled hallway floor, hopping from foot to foot and hugging herself, shivering. A close-up shows her feet stepping into a pair of white fluffy sheep-face slippers on the wooden floor. She then walks comfortably down the hallway towards the camera in the slippers, relaxed and smiling.

5295.title: horn_5295
5295.asset_description: A blue ballpoint drawing in a notebook: a smiling man in an embroidered folk costume and sheepskin waistcoat stands on a patterned hillside, leaning back and blowing into a very long curved horn decorated with folk carvings that rises high above his head. Sheep run and graze around him, and wooden log cottages with smoking chimneys sit on the slope behind, under stylised clouds and rolling hills.

5296.title: traditional_5296
5296.asset_description: Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.

5297.title: ruin_5297
5297.asset_description: A woman with a backpack walks up a cobbled path to a hilltop castle that has fallen apart - roofless stone shells, broken walls and empty window holes standing against a sunrise. She stops among the broken walls and throws both arms open. The clip then cuts to her at a railing above a mountain lake, and finally to her leaning over the side of a wooden boat drifting through a narrow gorge, trailing her hand in the turquoise water.

5298.title: blazer_5298
5298.asset_description: A young woman in a beige tailored jacket over a white top stands at a perfume counter in a brightly lit shop. She holds a paper test strip to her nose, then lifts a glass bottle and sniffs it, closes her eyes, waves the scent toward her face with her hand and reaches for another bottle on the display.

5299.title: illegal_5299
5299.asset_description: An elderly woman in a headscarf pushes a checked suitcase onto the belt at an airport checkpoint while a long queue waits behind her. An officer in uniform opens the case and it is packed with sausages, cheese and jars of pickles - none of it allowed through. On the scanner monitor the outline of a chicken leg shows up inside the bag. The officer holds the case open and speaks to her while she clutches a jar and looks up at him.

5300.title: threat_5300
5300.asset_description: An ink-and-wash illustration of a large patterned viper coiled on sunlit rocks. Its body is wound in thick loops over the stone, the tail runs across the foreground, and the head is reared up high with the mouth wide open, fangs bared, ready to strike at whoever is looking. Dry bushes and a grey sky fill the background and a few leaves blow past the open jaws.

5301.title: allergy_5301
5301.asset_description: A young woman in a yellow dress stands in a huge summer meadow full of yellow, white and blue wildflowers. She sneezes hard into her cupped hands, screws her eyes shut, wipes under her nose and presses a hand to her chest with a miserable, streaming-eyed face while the pollen-heavy field goes on around her and other people wander through the flowers in the background.

5302.title: blossom_5302
5302.asset_description: A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.

5303.title: snowflake_5303
5303.asset_description: A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.

5304.title: dirt_5304
5304.asset_description: A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime.
