She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.

5305.title: society_5305
5305.asset_description: A cream-and-black woodcut-style print showing a whole town at work at once, laid out as one connected scene. At the top a fisherman hauls a net from a rowing boat while the sun rises over a village of small houses and a town hall. Below, a driver leans out of a steam locomotive holding a lantern. In the middle a teacher stands at a blackboard with a book, pointing, while two children write on it. A baker in an apron pulls loaves from a brick oven and hands a wrapped parcel to a young workman, who in turn passes bread on. A doctor in a white coat listens to a seated patient's chest. At the bottom a bricklayer builds a wall and a farmer in a straw hat swings a scythe through wheat, with tied sheaves stacked beside him.

5306.title: comfortable_5306
5306.asset_description: A man in a denim shirt is slouched deep into a brown armchair in a carpeted room, knees up and socked feet resting on the seat, talking to someone off camera. The shot cuts to a living room where he sits sunk into a patterned sofa beside a woman while a small boy leans against them. The room then fills: more and more people arrive and drop onto the sofas, sprawling across the cushions and each other, laughing, until the whole sectional is packed with a dozen or more friends lying back with their legs stretched out over the arms and over one another.

5307.title: spacious_5307
5307.asset_description: A man in a denim shirt sits alone in a grey armchair in a bright open-plan home, drinking from a white mug. He leans back on a colourful patchwork sofa and stretches both arms out along the backrest, taking up the whole seat. The shot then opens onto a very large, almost empty living room with a huge grey sectional sofa running around three sides of the floor, the man sitting by himself in the middle of it with a wall-mounted television behind him. People run in from both sides and throw themselves onto the sectional, kicking their legs up and cheering, and by the end a dozen friends are spread out around the whole sofa with room to spare, waving at the camera.

5308.title: sunflower_5308
5308.asset_description: A young woman in a cream cardigan sits at a kitchen table biting into a chocolate-chip cookie, a plate of more cookies in front of her and fairy lights strung on the wall behind. Something makes her look up; she gets up, still holding the cookie, and pads down the hallway to the front door in slippers. She presses her face to the peephole and squints through it. She opens the door and a delivery man in an orange high-visibility jacket and helmet is standing there holding an enormous bunch of sunflowers — big round yellow heads on long green stems. Her mouth falls open in delight and she takes the bunch in both arms.

5309.title: note_5309
5309.asset_description: A woman in a grey blazer and glasses sits at her desk in a large open-plan office and looks down in surprise: a takeaway coffee cup and a wrapped pastry have appeared next to her keyboard. She picks up a small white card propped against them and holds it up — a smiley face is drawn on it in pen. She looks around over the top of her monitor at the rows of cubicles where her colleagues are working, then stands holding the coffee, scanning the room to work out who left it. She ends up back at her desk with the cup in both hands, smiling.

5310.title: son_5310
5310.asset_description: A boy stands with his father at the open bonnet of a car in a bright garage; the father hands him a spanner and both grin. The same boy is then hugged tight by his mother in a white kitchen, kicks a football back and forth with his father on the driveway, and finally plays with other children on a park lawn while the parents watch.

5311.title: calm_5311
5311.asset_description: A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.

5312.title: backyard_5312
5312.asset_description: In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.

5313.title: neon_5313
5313.asset_description: A young woman in a pink and mint traditional Korean dress spins in front of a tiled palace gate in daylight. She then sits at a night street-food market strung with paper lanterns, eating an orange rice cake from a paper cup and pulling a wide-eyed face at the taste. The last shot is a night city crossing where whole building fronts are covered in glowing electric signs in red, blue and yellow; a bus passes behind her while she makes a small finger heart.

5314.title: basket_5314
5314.asset_description: A young woman with a camera round her neck browses a souvenir stall on a Paris riverside. She picks up a small metal Eiffel Tower, then lifts a snow globe with a tower inside and looks at it up close. In the last shots she holds a large woven straw basket with two round handles, loaded with metal towers, fridge magnets and postcards, while an older woman behind the stall puts a red beret on her head.

5315.title: postcard_5315
5315.asset_description: A young woman stands in a souvenir kiosk hung with racks of picture cards, holding up a small metal Eiffel Tower keychain while the smiling stallholder watches. She holds a snow globe up against the sky by the river, then tries on a red and a navy beret in front of a mirror. At the end she carries two straw baskets and a thick fan of picture cards showing Paris landmarks, spreading them out towards the camera.

5316.title: curly_5316
5316.asset_description: A young woman in a red dress with a backpack twirls under tiled arches beside a fountain. She then sits close to the camera at a bar counter with a glass of red wine, a plate of thin cured ham and a dish of fried potatoes; her thick dark hair grows in tight rings and springs around her face as she leans in, laughs and drinks. The clip ends on a mosaic rooftop terrace at sunset with her arms thrown open over the city.

5317.title: ruffle_5317
5317.asset_description: On a wooden stage at dusk, under a web of small hanging bulbs, a flamenco dancer performs in a black dress whose skirt is built from tier after tier of folded red and black frills. A guitarist plays seated at the side and two women watch and clap. As she turns and stamps, the layered frills lift and swirl out around her legs, filling most of the frame.

5318.title: speak_5318
5318.asset_description: A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.

5319.title: web_5319
5319.asset_description: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing: a wide spider web is strung between bare tree branches, and a large spider hangs on a thread just below it. Drops hang along the web threads, a single leaf drifts down, and patterned flowers fill the bottom of the page.

5320.title: demonstrate_5320
5320.asset_description: In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.

5321.title: skate_5321
5321.asset_description: A figure skater in a navy outfit glides across an ice rink with one leg stretched out behind him, pulls his arms in to his chest and spins fast on one skate, then slows, straightens up and glides away across the ice.

5322.title: spit_5322
5322.asset_description: A man in a dark red T-shirt sits at a kitchen counter and tastes a bowl of green soup. He pulls a face and sticks his tongue out, gulps water from a glass, wipes his mouth with a napkin, drinks from a white mug, and finally spits the soup out of his mouth over the counter.

5323.title: stone_5323
5323.asset_description: Two children sit on a wooden jetty at a turquoise mountain lake. A man picks up a large grey stone lying on the boards, carries it to the edge with both hands and hurls it into the water, throwing up a huge white splash. He then jumps in himself and surfaces in the lake.

5324.title: sponge_5324
5324.asset_description: A young woman stands at a kitchen sink and squeezes a white drop of dish soap from a blue-capped bottle onto a yellow-and-green sponge she holds over a large steel pan crusted with red tomato sauce. She scrubs the inside of the pan with the sponge under the running tap until foam covers the surface and the sauce washes away. She rinses the pan, then turns to the camera holding the clean, shining pan in one hand and the sponge in the other.

5325.title: spouse_5325
5325.asset_description: A man and a woman, both wearing wedding rings, walk together down the hallway of a house carrying a paper grocery bag between them. In the kitchen they stand side by side at a wooden counter, each signing an official-looking document with a blue pen and smiling at each other's page. They high-five in the hallway, then walk to the front door hand in hand.

5326.title: coach_5326
5326.asset_description: In a gymnastics hall with a vaulting horse, a balance beam and blue landing mats, a young gymnast in training kit lands badly and sits down on the mat with her face screwed up in pain, clutching her bare foot. An older woman in a grey training shirt kneels beside her, takes the foot in her hands and winds a beige elastic bandage around the ankle, fastening it with tape. When the ankle is strapped the woman puts an arm around the gymnast's shoulders and holds her while she cries.

5327.title: cape_5327
5327.asset_description: In a brightly painted hair salon a client sits in the styling chair with a black sleeveless salon cape fastened at her neck and hanging over her shoulders and arms down to her lap. The stylist stands behind her and sprays a can of hairspray over the client's large curled updo, holding a comb in the other hand; a cloud of spray drifts over the hair. At the end the camera holds on the finished updo and the black cape covering the seated client's back.

5328.title: blouse_5328
5328.asset_description: A young woman in a walk-in wardrobe lifts a loose peach-coloured women's shirt with ruffles down the front off the rail and holds it up in front of her, sniffing it and smiling. She sprays it with a small glass atomiser, then takes a large white spray bottle and mists the whole rail of hanging clothes, walking along the rack from the pale shirts to the bright dresses. At the end she stands back in the middle of the wardrobe, phone in hand, looking pleased at the rows of clothes.

5329.title: seed_5329
5329.asset_description: A man's open palm fills the frame holding one small pale seed that has split open, with a white root curling out of it and two tiny green leaves. He crouches over a black seed tray of soil blocks where the same seeds have pushed up as bent green shoots, laughing and pointing at one of them with his finger. The shot pulls back to show him standing behind the tray of seedlings with a large green field stretching to the horizon behind him at dusk.

5330.title: spy_5330
5330.asset_description: At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.

5331.title: fitness_5331
5331.asset_description: A very muscular young woman stands at a thatched beach bar in front of a big glass jug on a wooden table. She squeezes an orange in her bare hands until the juice runs into the jug, then picks up a whole watermelon and crushes it between her hands until it bursts and its juice pours into the jug. At the end she turns to the camera and flexes her bicep while the guests behind her laugh and cheer with their drinks.

5332.title: unity_5332
5332.asset_description: Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.

5333.title: staircase_5333
5333.asset_description: A young man with a backpack films himself from below as he climbs one staircase after another inside four different buildings: first a plain grey concrete stairwell, then a white spiral staircase, then a wooden staircase under a crystal chandelier, and finally a huge marble staircase covered in red carpet in a grand opera-house foyer. His eyes widen and his mouth opens further at every new staircase.

5334.title: respect_5334
5334.asset_description: In a packed floodlit stadium at night a big bearded man in a denim jacket gets to his feet and lays his hand flat on his chest. Around him the whole block of spectators does the same - older men in team hoodies, a woman in a black coat - all standing still and looking towards the pitch while flags are held up behind them. The camera then pulls back to show the entire stadium on its feet.

5335.title: enthusiastic_5335
5335.asset_description: A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.

5336.title: loyalty_5336
5336.asset_description: In a floodlit stadium at night a grey-bearded man in a flat cap and black denim jacket takes off his cap, holds it against his chest and lays his hand over it. He looks up towards the stands and sings along with the anthem while the men and women around him stand with their hands on their hearts. The camera drifts back to show a long row of supporters all doing exactly the same.

5337.title: rail_5337
5337.asset_description: A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.

5338.title: stay_5338
5338.asset_description: A price caption rises with every scene. At 10 euros a backpacker climbs barefoot onto a metal bunk in a crowded hostel dormitory. At 100 euros a woman in a suit opens the door of a bright hotel room with a city view and walks in past the big white bed. At 10,000 euros an older couple step out through glass doors onto the deck of an overwater villa with a glass floor over turquoise water, then sit together on the bed above the sea, laughing.

5339.title: control_5339
5339.asset_description: A woman in a denim shirt sits in the driver's seat of a small parked car with her seat belt on, both hands on the steering wheel, turning it one way and then the other and watching where the car points. The shot cuts to the same woman in the driver's cab of a city bus, taking hold of a huge flat steering wheel with both hands and turning it, grinning at how big it is, with buses and the depot visible through the windscreen.

5340.title: garage_5340
5340.asset_description: Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.

5341.title: nail_5341
5341.asset_description: A pencil sketch on white paper. In a workshop a bearded man kneels beside a half-built wooden go-kart and tightens a bolt on its frame with a wrench. Next to him a boy in a baseball cap kneels on the floor and swings a hammer down onto a nail he is driving through a plank beside the kart's wheel. Behind them stands a workbench with a pegboard of spanners, an angled lamp and a shelf, and wood shavings and a screw hang in the air around them.

5342.title: tongue_5342
5342.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a woman helps a girl hold a piping bag and pipe pink swirls onto a tray of cupcakes. The woman then dabs a fingerful of frosting onto the girl's outstretched tongue and both of them laugh. Later the woman braids the girl's hair while a man watches from the background; the girl holds up a crayon drawing of three figures under a red heart and shows it to her, they talk, and the two end in a long hug.

5343.title: twin_5343
5343.asset_description: Two girls play in a bedroom that holds two identical white beds side by side, matching headboards and matching bare mattresses. They flop back onto one bed each, laughing at the camera. Sitting cross-legged on the beds they thread coloured beads into bracelets from a tray and fasten one onto the other girl's wrist. Then they pull jackets on in front of a tall mirror and dance together on the carpet.

5344.title: quilt_5344
5344.asset_description: Close-ups of hand sewing: a needle and white thread pull a button tight on a checked shirt, a needle closes a rip in blue jeans, and a colourful flower is embroidered on white linen; a pocket knife points at a denim jacket button. Then a bright room of young women sitting on the floor with fabric squares, who lift a big finished patchwork quilt of many coloured pieces and cheer behind it.

5345.title: lean_5345
5345.asset_description: A blonde woman in an orange running top jogs along a riverside bridge beside a running partner. Her face twists, she grabs her side and slows to a halt, then lays her forearm on the white bridge railing and rests her weight against it, bent forward and screwing up her face while her partner stops next to her.

5346.title: stomach_5346
5346.asset_description: A curly-haired young man stands in a school canteen queue with both hands flat on his middle, wincing and talking as the line shuffles past trays of food. He then sits at a table and forks up a huge mouthful of spaghetti in tomato sauce, chews with his eyes shut, and finally leans back and pats his middle with both hands, satisfied.

5347.title: stop_5347
5347.asset_description: A traffic policeman in a khaki uniform and peaked cap stands on the centre line of a busy Indian street. He raises a white-gloved palm towards the oncoming traffic and the scooters, motorbikes and cars slow and come to a halt in front of him. A city bus rolls up and stops right behind him, and he then stretches both arms out sideways to hold the two lanes still.

5348.title: thank_5348
5348.asset_description: On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.

5349.title: award_5349
5349.asset_description: A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.

5350.title: creek_5350
5350.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a wooded valley in summer. A narrow, shallow run of clear water winds between mossy boulders and pebbles, dropping over a small ledge into little waterfalls. A girl in a blue jacket, brown trousers and boots is caught in mid-air as she springs from one mossy rock to the next, arms flung out for balance, water splashing under her feet. Ferns, tree trunks and dappled green foliage fill the background and a few orange leaves drift on the surface.

5351.title: streetlight_5351
5351.asset_description: Dusk on a road beside a bare-treed park. A woman in a red beret, a knitted scarf and a fur-hooded parka holds the camera at arm's length and pulls it along behind her, glancing back and laughing. Above and behind her an ornate cast-iron lamp on a tall post burns orange against the deep blue evening sky, and a line of the same lamps recedes along the road, their light pooling on the tarmac and the pavement. She leads on into a wide open square where strings of white lights hang overhead and more lit lamps stand along the edges.

5352.title: frustration_5352
5352.asset_description: A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.

5353.title: paperwork_5353
5353.asset_description: An open-plan office. A woman in a rust-coloured blouse sits at a desk with a corded handset wedged against her ear, talking into it while she reaches for a pink sticky note and taps at her keyboard. Around her the desk fills up with towers of loose printed sheets and ring binders - one stack to her left, another rising in front of the monitor, more piling up until they reach above her head and box her in. Colleagues move about in the background. She stops, puts the handset down and slumps forward onto the desk between the paper towers.

5354.title: class_5354
5354.transcript: That's the spot. Mmm, that feels good. So good.
5354.asset_description: A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.

5355.title: trainer_5355
5355.asset_description: Early morning in a misty park among tall thin trees, the sun burning through the haze. A woman in a coral top and leggings stands on a low stone platform leading a group of mostly older people through an exercise routine: arms stretched overhead with hands clasped, then a side bend, then bending down to touch her toes, with the whole group copying her behind. A large ginger cat walks along the stone ledge right beside her and stretches its front legs out with its back arched, matching her movement, then sits calmly at her feet while she and the group raise both arms to the sky.

5356.title: yoga_5356
5356.asset_description: A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.

5357.title: fancy_5357
5357.asset_description: A battered pram with patched fabric and rusty wheels rolls along a park path. Then a woman in a beige blazer pushes a plain modern grey stroller with a small fluffy dog sitting in it and the caption 500 euro appears. Finally a man in white robes pushes an ornate chrome carriage-style stroller with buttoned leather upholstery, the same dog inside wearing sunglasses, captioned 5000 euro, while the woman stares open-mouthed.

5358.title: peek_5358
5358.asset_description: A young woman in glasses and a beige cardigan sits at a long wooden table in a grand library, writing in an open textbook with a blue pen while other students work behind her. She piles more and more thick books on the table until the stacks form a wall taller than she is, and at the end she is hidden behind it, only her eyes showing as she looks out through a gap between the piles.

5359.title: hippo_5359
5359.asset_description: A ranger in a khaki uniform and cap stands on a wooden jetty over green river water and points behind her, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise. A large grey hippo floats just off the deck with its head and back above the water, then sinks lower and lower until only its nostrils and finally just ripples are left on the surface, while she keeps staring at the camera.

5360.title: metro_5360
5360.asset_description: A young man with bleached hair, glasses and a varsity jacket films himself pulling the camera along by the hand through an underground station. He taps through the ticket gate, stands on the platform as a train rolls in, steps into the carriage among other passengers, and then walks down a long underground corridor packed shoulder to shoulder with commuters, looking back at the camera with an astonished face.

5361.title: easy_5361
5361.asset_description: A woman in a striped top stands in a hallway with a small teal hard-shell cabin case, pulling its handle up, then heaves a much bigger navy soft suitcase down next to it and gestures at the two. The shot cuts to an airport hall where she is pushing a trolley loaded with six stacked suitcases in different colours, leaning into it with a strained face while the top case tips off the pile.

5362.title: silly_5362
5362.asset_description: A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.

5363.title: aid_5363
5363.asset_description: An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.

5364.title: assist_5364
5364.asset_description: A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.

5365.title: weapon_5365
5365.asset_description: A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.

5366.title: surrender_5366
5366.asset_description: A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.

5367.title: stuff_5367
5367.asset_description: At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.

5368.title: suffer_5368
5368.asset_description: A cartoon-style illustration of a young person outdoors in blazing heat. The face is flushed deep red, big drops of sweat run down the forehead, cheeks and neck and fly off in all directions, the eyes are half shut and the teeth are clenched in a grimace. One hand is pressed against the forehead pushing the damp hair back, and the background is a blurred golden street glaring with sunlight.

5369.title: tough_5369
5369.asset_description: A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.

5370.title: canoe_5370
5370.asset_description: A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.

5371.title: garland_5371
5371.asset_description: At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.

5372.title: broom_5372
5372.asset_description: A young man in a grey vest and shorts works his way across a white-tiled outdoor terrace, pulling a brush on a long wooden handle over the tiles and pushing scattered dry leaves into a growing heap. Palm trees, a parked car and a street are visible behind him; he works in flip-flops and the wet tiles reflect his shadow.

5373.title: expand_5373
5373.asset_description: In a sunny back garden, three people stand at a picnic table watching a striped beach ball get bigger and bigger until it fills the frame. A glass bowl of dough on the same table then rises until it bulges over the rim. Next a woman on the lawn watches a blue paddling pool grow out to its full size, and finally the whole group stands watching a yellow and blue bouncy castle rise up into a full castle with towers.

5374.title: shallow_5374
5374.asset_description: A man swims front crawl through bright turquoise sea that is so low and clear that the sandy bottom and his own shadow are visible right underneath him. Boats sit on the horizon and a dolphin leaps out of the water behind him. At the end he stops swimming and kneels beside a pale sandbank, the water reaching only to his chest.

5375.title: swing_5375
5375.asset_description: A blonde woman in an orange shirt stands in a bay at a golf driving range and takes a full shot: the club travels in a wide arc over her shoulder and she watches the ball fly out over the green. The clip then cuts to a lake, where she grips a thick rope hanging from a gum tree, runs off the bank and rides the rope out over the water in a long curve before hanging from it above the lake.

5376.title: switch_5376
5376.asset_description: A young man in a denim shirt stands in a dark flat at night and reaches for a white plate on the wall by the door. The lights come on and he grins into the camera in the warm light. A close-up shows his hand pressing the small white rocker on the wall plate, and the last shot pans across the now brightly lit living room with its ceiling spots, floor lamp and dining table.

5377.title: collect_5377
5377.asset_description: A hand-drawn kitchen scene: a dark-haired girl in a flowered apron leans right across a long wooden farmhouse table and stretches her arm out over the boards. In front of her the dirty plates from the meal have been gathered into one leaning stack with forks and knives laid on top; a linen cloth is still in the air above the pile and dust puffs off the wood. Behind her are painted wooden chairs, a dresser full of crockery, a jug and a bowl of apples on a sunlit windowsill.

5378.title: set_5378
5378.asset_description: Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.

5379.title: alter_5379
5379.asset_description: In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.

5380.title: take_5380
5380.asset_description: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

5381.title: conversation_5381
5381.asset_description: Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.

5382.title: discuss_5382
5382.transcript: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?
5382.asset_description: At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.

5383.title: avenue_5383
5383.asset_description: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.

5384.title: champion_5384
5384.asset_description: A cartoon drawing of a sports team on a green pitch just after winning. Ten players in red-and-yellow striped shirts and shorts pile together, mouths open in a roar, fists in the air. One player is hoisted above the others, arms spread wide, laughing; a ball and a water bottle fly through the air over his head. Behind them a blurred crowd in the stands cheers and the goal posts rise into an orange sunset sky.

5385.title: win_5385
5385.asset_description: A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.

5386.title: tear_5386
5386.asset_description: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.

5387.title: sorrow_5387
5387.asset_description: An extreme close-up of an eye with a tear welling up and rolling down the cheek. The shot widens to two friends lying together on a sofa at night under a thick knitted blanket, both crying, faces screwed up. One pulls tissues from a box on the blanket and hands one over; they dab their eyes and blow their noses, then lean their heads together and keep watching, still in tears.

5388.title: packet_5388
5388.transcript: Nope. Was always one step ahead. All good.
5388.asset_description: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.

5389.title: dodge_5389
5389.asset_description: In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.

5390.title: youth_5390
5390.asset_description: Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

5391.title: stare_5391
5391.asset_description: Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.

5392.title: terror_5392
5392.asset_description: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.

5393.title: calm_5393
5393.asset_description: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.

5394.title: claim_5394
5394.asset_description: A two-colour woodcut print. A person in a heavy padded coat, knitted hat and thick gloves leans their whole weight onto a tall flagpole and drives it down into the frozen ground. A ragged ochre flag snaps out sideways in the wind at the top of the pole. Splinters of ice burst up where the pole strikes and cracks run out across the white surface. Behind them lie empty snow dunes and, far off, a second small flag already standing in the snow.

5395.title: ranch_5395
5395.asset_description: A wide dry plain under a pale sky. A young ranch hand in a canvas jacket, denim shirt and leather chaps rides a bay horse at a trot along a barbed-wire fence, one gloved hand brushing the top of a fence post as he passes. The fence runs dead straight away to the horizon, dust drifts up behind the horse, and a windmill and flat-topped mesas stand far off in the haze.

5396.title: mark_5396
5396.asset_description: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.

5397.title: mighty_5397
5397.asset_description: A woodblock-style print of an enormous dark blue wave rearing up over a rough sea. The crest curls right over and breaks into white foam and scattered droplets; smaller waves roll away behind it towards a flat horizon, and four seagulls glide against a pale, streaked sky.

5398.title: chain_5398
5398.asset_description: A woodcut-style print of the Earth as a globe, its continents and swirling blue oceans carved in fine lines, with tall sailing ships crossing the water. A ring of people of many ages and skin tones stands right around the rim of the globe, each holding the hands of the two beside them so the ring is unbroken all the way round. Behind them the dark sky is full of stars, crescent moons and a few birds.

5399.title: play_5399
5399.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a theatre seen from the side. Two actors in tunics, boots and capes perform on a wooden stage: one stands with his arm flung out and his cloak flying, the other strides towards him. Heavy red curtains are drawn back on either side, a painted forest backdrop hangs behind them, footlights glow along the front edge of the stage, and rows of seated people and gilded balcony boxes fill the auditorium.

5400.title: opera_5400
5400.asset_description: A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.

5401.title: wonder_5401
5401.asset_description: A black-and-white montage of five people puzzling over something they want to figure out: a young woman in a kitchen holds a pen against her chin and stares upward with a frown; a man at a chess board in a library hovers his hand over a piece; a teenager in a hoodie presses a hand over his eyes; a student in a jumper bites her pen over an open notebook; finally a young woman at a kitchen table gasps with delight and starts writing on her papers.

5402.title: throat_5402
5402.asset_description: In a clinic a female doctor in a white coat and headscarf holds a wooden tongue depressor and looks into the wide-open mouth of a young man in a pink polo shirt. He then stands at a water cooler and drinks from a bottle with his hand on his chest; a close-up shows his neck and Adam's apple moving as he swallows, his head tilted back. At the end he faces the camera and speaks, looking relieved.

5403.title: time_5403
5403.asset_description: A young woman in a beige trench coat stands at a glass tram shelter and runs her finger down a printed timetable, then looks at her wristwatch and smiles. At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.

5404.title: greedy_5404
5404.asset_description: A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.

5405.title: toddler_5405
5405.asset_description: A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.

5406.title: toe_5406
5406.asset_description: A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.

5407.title: toilet_5407
5407.asset_description: At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.

5408.title: kit_5408
5408.asset_description: A woman in a denim shirt and a patterned headband stands in an open garage with a wooden kitchen chair in front of her; she presses on the seat and it wobbles. She turns to a red hard case on the bench and opens it: inside, held in moulded slots, are rows of screwdrivers, spanners, pliers and sockets. She lifts one screwdriver out of the case, tightens the loose joint under the chair, stands the chair back up and sits down on it to show it holds.

5409.title: tooth_5409
5409.asset_description: A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.

5410.title: toothbrush_5410
5410.asset_description: A close shot shows a blue-and-white tube squeezing a stripe of pale blue paste onto the bristles of a small green-and-white brush. A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.

5411.title: swirl_5411
5411.asset_description: A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.

5412.title: pillar_5412
5412.asset_description: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.

5413.title: hopeless_5413
5413.asset_description: A dark ink-and-wash comic panel of a city gridlock at dusk. Cars, vans and a box lorry stand nose to tail across every lane under an elevated flyover, tail lights glowing red and exhaust smoke drifting between them, with the jam stretching away to the horizon. In the foreground a driver has climbed halfway out of his car window and raised an open hand at the unmoving queue, a man in a cap leans out of the van beside him, and a motorcyclist edges along the narrow gap between the lanes. Blank billboards and tower blocks fill the smoky skyline behind, and nothing in the picture has any way out.

5414.title: rail_5414
5414.asset_description: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.

5415.title: red_5415
5415.asset_description: A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.

5416.title: locomotive_5416
5416.asset_description: A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.

5417.title: depot_5417
5417.asset_description: A young woman in a mustard coat with a canvas tote bag steps up to an old red wooden tram standing in a cobbled old-town street and boards it, her mouth open in delight. Inside the carriage she leans towards the window and watches pastel-coloured townhouses slide past. The tram then runs into a large tram yard: several trams stand on parallel rails under a web of overhead wires, and she stands on the narrow platform between the tracks looking around at them.

5418.title: interior_5418
5418.asset_description: A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.

5419.title: transfer_5419
5419.asset_description: A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.

5420.title: vessel_5420
5420.asset_description: A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.

5421.title: garbage_5421
5421.asset_description: A drawn grey-green kitchen scene. A metal bin stands in the middle of the floor, so full that its lid has been pushed off and hangs to one side; empty milk and juice cartons, a tin and crumpled paper stick out of the bag inside it. More screwed-up paper and food packaging lies scattered across the tiled floor. On the right a young man in a jacket and boots pulls back with both hands raised as a crumpled paper ball flies past him towards the viewer.

5422.title: recycling_5422
5422.asset_description: A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

5423.title: worldwide_5423
5423.asset_description: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.

5424.title: treaty_5424
5424.asset_description: A low, wide shot straight down a polished wooden table in a wood-panelled hall. Two men in dark suits lean in from opposite sides and shake hands above the table. Between them, open leather folders hold a signed document and a blank sheet, with a black fountain pen resting on the near folder. Behind them stand two flags on poles, one navy and one dark red, and two press photographers firing their camera flashes.

5425.title: deal_5425
5425.asset_description: Outdoors in a sunny garden full of palms, a young woman in a teal blazer and a young man in a grey suit sit side by side at a long wooden table, each with an open document folder in front of them. A crowd of colleagues in business clothes stands packed behind their chairs. Two small desk flags, one teal and one orange, sit at the front edge of the table. Both sign their documents, the colleagues clap, and then the two stand up and shake hands.

5426.title: delegation_5426
5426.asset_description: In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.

5427.title: seal_5427
5427.transcript: I'm shaking. So nervous. I can't.
5427.asset_description: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.

5428.title: freight_5428
5428.asset_description: A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.

5429.title: trust_5429
5429.asset_description: In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.

5430.title: fast_5430
5430.asset_description: A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.

5431.title: balloon_5431
5431.asset_description: A travel montage. A red-haired woman films herself from the wicker basket of a hot air balloon at dawn over Cappadocia, with dozens of striped balloons drifting at different heights above the rock valley and its stone spires. The clip then cuts to a covered bazaar lined with blue patterned ceramics and hanging glass lamps, where her finger points at the shelves, and finally to her on a ferry deck at dusk sipping a tulip glass of Turkish tea while gulls fly past over the water.

5432.title: trick_5432
5432.asset_description: An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.

5433.title: turn_on_5433
5433.asset_description: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

5434.title: electricity_5434
5434.asset_description: Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.

5435.title: alike_5435
5435.asset_description: Phone footage of two young red-haired women walking side by side across a sunny university campus. They are dressed exactly the same: white polo crop tops, blue jeans, white trainers and black backpacks, and they wear their hair in the same ponytails, so from behind and from the front they look like one person doubled. They stop, open a bag of crisps together and share it, then walk on laughing at each other while other students pass on the lawn behind them.

5436.title: twist_5436
5436.asset_description: A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.

5437.title: courtyard_5437
5437.asset_description: A travel reel in three parts. First a young woman in a white embroidered shirt leads the camera by the hand through a field of sunflowers at sunset. Then she walks across a cobbled cathedral square as a flock of pigeons takes off around her in front of a white church with golden domes. Finally the clip ends in the paved courtyard of an old manor: the walls and arcades of the building close the space in on every side, strings of warm lights hang overhead, and a long table of guests in embroidered shirts claps and cheers as she lifts a big braided loaf of bread above her head.

5438.title: filling_5438
5438.asset_description: A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.

5439.title: grey_5439
5439.asset_description: A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.

5440.title: nephew_5440
5440.asset_description: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing on cream paper. A grown bearded man in a denim jacket runs across a meadow with a kite reel in his raised hand, his cap blowing off behind him, and a small laughing boy in dungarees runs along beside him holding the string of a second kite. Two patterned diamond kites with long curling ribbon tails climb into a sky of drawn swirls above a low sun; dandelions and daisies fill the grass in the foreground.

5441.title: uncle_5441
5441.asset_description: A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.

5442.title: sleeve_5442
5442.asset_description: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.

5443.title: solidarity_5443
5443.asset_description: A city street at low golden-hour sun, filled end to end with people. In the foreground two hands clasp each other tightly, and behind them the crowd stretches away in two long facing rows, every person reaching across to grip the hand of the person opposite, forming an unbroken human chain down the middle of the road. The faces are serious and calm and all turned the same way. Behind the chain, plain coloured banners in red, blue and green are held up above the heads of the crowd, with city buildings and bare trees on both sides.

5444.title: cooperate_5444
5444.asset_description: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.

5445.title: useless_5445
5445.asset_description: A comic-style drawing of a city street in heavy rain. A man in a beige trench coat runs across the flooded road, splashing through a deep puddle. In his right hand he holds up a black umbrella that the wind has blown completely inside out, its ribs bent backwards into a bowl so that the rain falls straight past it onto him; his coat and scarf are flying and his hair is soaked. Behind him a big clock tower rises into the grey sky, a red double-decker bus and a black taxi drive through the standing water, a red phone box stands on the pavement and a flag whips on its pole. Diagonal rain streaks cover the whole picture.

5446.title: misty_5446
5446.asset_description: A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.

5447.title: remote_5447
5447.asset_description: A single dusty old pickup truck is parked on the shoulder of a two-lane road that runs dead straight into an empty desert, with nothing else in sight in any direction: no houses, no other cars, no people, just scrub, sand and huge red rock buttes standing far off on the horizon in the low evening sun. A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans steps up onto the truck's front wheel and reaches for the roof, her hair blown sideways. A small flag on a pole is fixed behind the cab and flaps in the wind. The road's faded yellow centre line runs away to the far horizon.

5448.title: billboard_5448
5448.asset_description: A young man in a red jacket with a backpack turns on the spot in the middle of a busy city crossing, arms flung wide and mouth open in delight. All around and above him the building fronts are covered floor to roof in enormous lit advertising boards - bright pink, blue and white panels the size of whole walls, stacked one above the other and wrapped around the corners of the towers - while yellow taxis and crowds pass behind him. The clip then cuts to him leaning on the rail of a ferry, grinning, with a tall green statue on an island behind him, and finally to him standing on a rock at the rim of a huge red canyon at sunset with his arms raised.

5449.title: doorway_5449
5449.asset_description: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.

5450.title: device_5450
5450.asset_description: A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.

5451.title: injection_5451
5451.asset_description: In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.

5452.title: peaceful_5452
5452.asset_description: A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.

5453.title: vase_5453
5453.asset_description: An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.

5454.title: ink_5454
5454.asset_description: A close photo of a wooden desk where a hand in a khaki sleeve presses a round rubber stamp down onto the open page of a passport. The other hand holds the booklet flat. The page already carries one black rectangular stamp mark, and fresh black drops have splattered around the one being pressed, with a dark stamp pad standing at the top left of the desk.

5455.title: approval_5455
5455.asset_description: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.

5456.title: permission_5456
5456.asset_description: A young man in a grey shirt sits at an outdoor counter under palm trees with a passport, an envelope and printed forms in front of him, pressing his hands together hopefully. Inside an airport terminal he then holds the passport open to a page with his photo on it, eyes wide. He steps up to an officer beside a metal detector, who reaches out for the document, and finally he walks through the gateway grinning and holding up a small card.

5457.title: visitor_5457
5457.asset_description: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.

5458.title: vitamin_5458
5458.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a grey sports top tips an orange jar labelled with a vitamin label and shakes a large white tablet into her palm. She drops the tablet into a tall glass of water on the counter; it fizzes hard, filling the glass with bubbles until the water turns bright orange. She stares at the glass with wide eyes, then lifts it, drinks, and pulls a satisfied face. A bowl of oranges and kiwis sits beside her.

5459.title: lava_5459
5459.asset_description: A dark ink-style illustration of an erupting mountain at night. A huge boiling cloud of ash rises from the crater, lit orange from below, and glowing molten streams run down every slope of the mountain in bright branching lines. Burning lumps of rock fly through the black sky trailing smoke. In the foreground the ground is cracked into plates with orange-hot rivers glowing in every crack.

5460.title: sickness_5460
5460.asset_description: At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.

5461.title: ballot_5461
5461.asset_description: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.

5462.title: democracy_5462
5462.asset_description: In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.

5463.title: journal_5463
5463.asset_description: A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.

5464.title: slim_5464
5464.asset_description: A watercolour and ink drawing of a woman's body from the neck to the knees. She wears a fitted blue-grey long-sleeved top and dark grey jeans. Her build is narrow and slender: the top follows a thin torso that pulls in above the hips. Her right hand rests flat on her side just above the hip, her left arm hangs down. The background is a plain cream wash.

5465.title: waist_5465
