5465.asset_description: In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

5466.title: formal_5466
5466.asset_description: An illustration of a smart restaurant dining room in warm orange light, with brass chandeliers, wood panelling and tables under white cloths. A young waiter walks through it in the strict uniform of the trade: white shirt, black bow tie, black waistcoat, long white apron and black trousers, a folded white cloth over his forearm. He balances a tray of stacked plates and wine glasses high on one hand and sets a plate down with the other. Seated guests in jackets and dresses dine at candlelit tables.

5467.title: awake_5467
5467.asset_description: A brightly painted bunk room at a summer camp with open windows onto trees. A teenage boy on a top bunk jolts out of sleep with his eyes wide and his mouth open, then sits up and rubs his face with both hands while another child still lies asleep on the bunk below. The camera moves across the room and the whole dormitory comes out of sleep: children push back their duvets, sit up on the edges of their bunks and rub their eyes, with sandals and flip-flops on the floor beside the beds.

5468.title: sign_5468
5468.asset_description: A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

5469.title: walker_5469
5469.asset_description: An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.

5470.title: downtown_5470
5470.asset_description: A montage of people walking. First a low shot follows a woman in a navy business suit and nude high heels striding along a city sidewalk past taxis and office workers; then she is seen from behind crossing a street between glass skyscrapers in the financial district. The scene cuts to a bald hiker with a big backpack and trekking poles climbing a forest trail towards a mountain; then to a man in a blue t-shirt walking a golden retriever on a leash across a sunny park lawn; and finally to a high aerial view of a huge crowd streaming across the Shibuya-style crossing between illuminated billboards downtown.

5471.title: level_5471
5471.asset_description: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

5472.title: bill_5472
5472.asset_description: A black-and-white ink drawing seen from close up: two hands hold an open leather wallet upside down over a shop counter, and several banknotes slide out of it, one of them tumbling away through the air. Below the wallet a small clasp coin purse hangs open and a coin drops out of it towards the floor, with another coin already lying on the wooden counter. Behind the hands the blurred checkout of a shop is drawn, with a cash register, a customer display screen and a long printed receipt curling out of the till.

5473.title: wealthy_5473
5473.asset_description: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.

5474.title: coin_5474
5474.asset_description: A close shot shows a man's hands sliding a blue-green card out of a brown leather wallet beside a payment terminal with a glowing green ring in a shop. He looks up and smiles, holding the open wallet. At an open-air market he hands the card across crates of oranges, apples and plums to the stallholder while holding a paper bag. Then, over a wooden table, he holds a small brown coin purse upside down and a stream of coins pours out of it into a spreading heap. In the last shot he pushes the coins apart with one finger, sorting the copper and silver pieces on the table while the empty purse hangs in his other hand.

5475.title: tank_5475
5475.asset_description: A pencil sketch on yellowed paper shows a battlefield. A line of soldiers in round steel helmets, with packs on their backs and rifles in their hands, runs forward through churned mud, the leading man leaping over a shell crater as earth sprays up around his boots. Behind them a heavy armoured vehicle with a long gun barrel, a turret and caterpillar tracks pushes through the smoke. Thick black smoke rises from a burning ruined town on the horizon, shattered tree stumps and torn barbed wire stand on the left, and a great coil of barbed wire fills the foreground.

5476.title: debris_5476
5476.asset_description: A photograph of a destroyed street in daylight. A woman in a dusty beige utility vest and dark trousers walks towards the camera over a slope of broken concrete, carrying a bundle of grey blankets pressed against her chest; her face and clothes are grey with dust. On both sides stand bombed concrete buildings with their fronts torn open and their floors collapsing, a burnt-out car sits on the left, and pale smoke drifts down the street. The whole foreground is a field of smashed concrete blocks, twisted steel reinforcing rods, broken cables and dust.

5477.title: fort_5477
5477.asset_description: In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.

5478.title: stuff_5478
5478.asset_description: A colour comic-style illustration of a bedroom. A young woman with brown hair has pulled both mirrored doors of a tall wooden wardrobe wide open and stands in the opening with her arms stretched out, eyes wide, as a mass of assorted things bursts out over her: shirts, jumpers, trousers and skirts in red, green, blue, yellow and pink, folded stacks toppling off the shelves, and a brown leather shoe flying out of the frame towards the viewer. Empty wooden hangers swing on the rail above her, a battered suitcase sits on top of the wardrobe, and a patterned rug, a potted plant and a pair of jeans lie on the floor.

5479.title: robe_5479
5479.asset_description: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.

5480.title: task_5480
5480.asset_description: A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.

5481.title: pink_5481
5481.asset_description: A smiling young woman with long bright pink hair kneels in a tiled laundry room beside an open front-loading washing machine. Her pink hair fills most of the frame as she lifts coloured clothes out of a laundry basket and pushes them into the drum. The camera then shows the closed machine with the wash turning behind the round glass door, and finally, filmed from inside the drum, she pulls out a clean white t-shirt and holds it up to her face.

5482.title: bath_5482
5482.asset_description: A short montage of things being washed. First two hands scrub a white plate with a sponge under a running kitchen tap. Then a jet of water sprays the front of a dark car on a driveway. Then a hand lifts a pale shirt out of a big metal tub filled with white suds. Then a woman kneels on a lawn laughing while she washes a golden retriever sitting in a large grey plastic tub of water. Finally a group of people soap up cars at a car wash in a car park.

5483.title: scan_5483
5483.asset_description: A young woman with curly hair and a yellow top stands at a seafront railing at sunset holding binoculars. She points at something far off on the beach, then raises the binoculars to her eyes and searches along the shore. The scene changes to a packed stadium at dusk where she lowers the binoculars with her mouth open in surprise, and fireworks then rise and burst above the crowd while she stares up at them.

5484.title: gaze_5484
5484.asset_description: A boy, a woman and a man stand side by side at the wooden railing of a rooftop terrace at night, with the roofs of a town behind them. Fireworks climb and burst in the dark sky above them. All three keep their heads tilted back and their eyes fixed on the sky for the whole clip, mouths open in wonder, the boy pointing upwards once as another rocket goes up.

5485.title: watering_can_5485
5485.asset_description: On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.

5486.title: flowerpot_5486
5486.asset_description: An elderly man in a flat cap and body warmer stands at a greenhouse windowsill holding a metal watering can over a terracotta flowerpot with a pale green succulent growing in it. He then waters a garden bed full of pink, yellow and red zinnias and pansies from the same can, moves on to a raised bed of leafy vegetables and waters those too, and finally stands back with a hand on his hip looking over the watered garden.

5487.title: surfing_5487
5487.asset_description: A high-contrast black-and-white illustration of a giant ocean wave curling over into a hollow barrel; inside the glowing turquoise tube a tiny silhouetted surfer crouches on a surfboard, riding along the face of the wave. Spray flies off the crest above and dark rocks and choppy water fill the foreground.

5488.title: farewell_5488
5488.asset_description: On a sunny quay a small group of people stand at the railing waving both arms at a white passenger ferry. An older woman in a flowered headscarf and a young man grin at the camera with their hands raised; others beside them swing pink scarves overhead. The ferry pulls away from the ramp, passengers crowded on its decks waving back, and it shrinks into the blue water towards the city skyline as the group on the quay keeps waving.

5489.title: wear_5489
5489.asset_description: In a bright clothing boutique lined with rails of coats, a woman poses for the camera in one outfit after another. She is first dressed in an oversized denim jacket and a colourful scarf, then in a long red coat, then in a silver sequinned mini dress, then in a thick knitted coat, and finally in an enormous feathered coat with a matching feather hat. Between each look the shot cuts and she is dressed in the next piece.

5490.title: weed_5490
5490.asset_description: A young man in a straw hat and a football shirt kneels in a vegetable bed between rows of leafy green plants, a tall corn field behind him. He digs his gloved hands into the dark soil around the base of a big unwanted plant, works it loose, grips it low down and pulls hard. He rocks back, drags the plant out of the ground and stands up holding it above the bed, its long soil-covered roots and leafy top hanging down.

5491.title: welcome_5491
5491.asset_description: A young traveller with a rucksack and a suitcase arrives at the carved wooden gate of a tropical guesthouse. A smiling woman in a batik dress lifts a chain of white flowers over his head and settles it on his shoulders while the hosts laugh around him. A man carries out a tray of green coconuts with straws and hands him one, which he takes gladly and drinks. The whole household lines the path clapping and cheering, arms in the air, as he walks through the gate holding the coconut and grinning at the camera.

5492.title: spoke_5492
5492.asset_description: A rough charcoal drawing of a big tyred wheel standing upright on a workshop floor. The thin metal spokes run out from the central hub in a criss-cross pattern to the rim, and the axle stub sticks out of the middle. A gloved hand reaches in from the right and holds the wheel steady; behind it a car body is dimly sketched and spanners and other tools lie scattered on the ground.

5493.title: hub_5493
5493.asset_description: In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.

5494.title: disabled_5494
5494.asset_description: A soft watercolour illustration: a young man in a green jacket and patched brown corduroy trousers sits in a wheelchair and drives it forward himself, gripping the hand rim of the big spoked wheel, which is blurred with motion. A girl in a knitted scarf runs laughing beside him with her arms out. Autumn leaves fall around them onto a leaf-covered path; behind them are yellow trees and an old stone arch bridge.

5495.title: rumor_5495
5495.asset_description: In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.

5496.title: adjust_5496
5496.asset_description: A young couple's morning at home. She stands at the stove in his oversized blue shirt, flipping a pancake in a frying pan while he dances up behind her in a white shirt and tie. She then turns to him, holding a big mug of coffee, and carefully straightens the knot of his tie against his collar until it sits right. Later they kneel at a low table in the living room holding hands over two slices of cake, and finally they flop onto the sofa laughing, she raising the TV remote in the air.

5497.title: candidate_5497
5497.asset_description: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.

5498.title: window_5498
5498.asset_description: A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.

5499.title: woman_5499
5499.asset_description: A sunny open-air street market lined with fruit and vegetable stalls and tall old apartment blocks. A young woman in a red summer dress spins round on the pavement, hair flying, laughing. A second woman in a neon-yellow sports top and black leggings jogs towards the camera down the same street. An elderly white-haired woman leans out of a first-floor window onto a balcony packed with red geraniums, watering can in hand, smiling down. Back at street level the woman in red meets a woman in a navy business suit carrying a briefcase; they talk face to face beside a stall of tomatoes, then stand together with shopping bags while the woman in red waves at the camera.

5500.title: timber_5500
5500.asset_description: A muted woodcut-style illustration of an open-sided timber shed at the edge of a misty forest. A young man in a flat cap and patched work clothes swings an axe down into a log standing on a chopping block; splinters fly and a split log falls away to the left. Behind him a sawhorse and a stack of round logs sit under the shed roof. In the foreground lies a neat pile of freshly sawn planks with visible grain, plus more cut logs and curls of wood shaving on the ground.

5501.title: industry_5501
5501.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a large dim factory hall with a steel roof truss, hanging lamps and heavy machinery lining both walls. In the middle a man in a hard hat, dirty overalls and thick gloves leans into a hand truck loaded with wooden crates and a metal drum, pushing it forward across the concrete floor. Dust hangs in the light. More crates and a second hand truck stand in the foreground.

5502.title: storage_5502
5502.asset_description: A large warehouse aisle with tall steel racking on both sides, full of shrink-wrapped pallets. A woman in a hi-vis vest and work gloves lifts cardboard boxes onto a wooden pallet beside a conveyor, building the load up layer by layer until it is chest high and wrapped in clear plastic film. She then takes the handle of an orange pallet truck, pumps it, and pulls the finished pallet away down the aisle past the racking, a forklift moving in the background.

5503.title: position_5503
5503.asset_description: A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.

5504.title: send_5504
5504.asset_description: A young woman with a black bob sits at a wooden desk by a bright window, a green cardigan on, tapping a black fountain pen against her lips while she thinks over a sheet of writing paper. She then writes a handwritten letter across the page, folds the finished sheet, slides it into a cream envelope and presses the flap down flat with both hands. In the last shot she stands in the street at a red pillar postbox, smiling as she pushes the envelope through the slot.

5505.title: film_5505
5505.asset_description: A comic-style illustration of a dark, teal-lit hospital imaging room. A young medic in a glowing jacket holds a chest X-ray film up against a bright lightbox and studies it; a second X-ray film showing a hand floats in front of her, and the monitors around her display ECG traces and readouts.

5506.title: dance_5506
5506.asset_description: Outdoors at sunset on a street basketball court beside a graffiti wall. A girl in a tie-dye set dances and dribbles a basketball while the friends around her clap and dance with her; the camera pulls back and the gathering keeps growing until a huge crowd fills the whole street, everyone dancing with their arms in the air, while a skateboarder rolls through the middle.

5507.title: zoo_5507
5507.asset_description: A young man in a bright palm-print shirt tours a zoo holding a spotting sheet of animal pictures. He crouches on the grass and lets a goat eat a handful of hay out of his hands, then stands at a glass pool where penguins stand on the rocks and swim past him, and finally holds a leafy branch up to a giraffe that leans over the wooden fence and takes the leaves with its tongue.
